title: Build on Priors: Vision--Language--Guided Neuro-Symbolic Imitation Learning for Data-Efficient Real-World Robot Manipulation
summary: Enabling robots to learn long-horizon manipulation tasks from a handful of demonstrations remains a central challenge in robotics. Existing neuro-symbolic approaches often rely on hand-crafted symbolic abstractions, semantically labeled trajectories or large demonstration datasets, limiting their scalability and real-world applicability. We present a scalable neuro-symbolic framework that autonomously constructs symbolic planning domains and data-efficient control policies from as few as one to thirty unannotated skill demonstrations, without requiring manual domain engineering. Our method segments demonstrations into skills and employs a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to classify skills and identify equivalent high-level states, enabling automatic construction of a state-transition graph. This graph is processed by an Answer Set Programming solver to synthesize a PDDL planning domain, which an oracle function exploits to isolate the minimal, task-relevant and target relative observation and action spaces for each skill policy. Policies are learned at the control reference level rather than at the raw actuator signal level, yielding a smoother and less noisy learning target. Known controllers can be leveraged for real-world data augmentation by projecting a single demonstration onto other objects in the scene, simultaneously enriching the graph construction process and the dataset for imitation learning. We validate our framework primarily on a real industrial forklift across statistically rigorous manipulation trials, and demonstrate cross-platform generality on a Kinova Gen3 robotic arm across two standard benchmarks. Our results show that grounding control learning, VLM-driven abstraction, and automated planning synthesis into a unified pipeline constitutes a practical path toward scalable, data-efficient, expert-free and interpretable neuro-symbolic robotics.
tldr: This paper introduces a neuro-symbolic framework that uses a Vision-Language Model to autonomously construct symbolic planning domains and control policies from few demonstrations, enabling data-efficient learning for long-horizon robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架，利用视觉语言模型从少量演示中自主构建符号规划域和控制策略，用于数据高效的长期机器人操作任务学习。
summary_zh: 让机器人通过少量演示学习长时程操作任务，仍然是机器人技术领域的核心挑战。现有的神经符号方法通常依赖手工设计的符号抽象、语义标注的轨迹或庞大的演示数据集，这限制了其扩展性和实际适用性。我们提出了一种可扩展的神经符号框架，它能够从少至一个到三十个未标注的技能演示中自主构建符号规划领域和数据高效的控制策略，而无需人工领域工程。我们的方法将演示数据分割为技能，并利用视觉语言模型对技能进行分类并识别等效的高层状态，从而自动构建状态转移图。该图由答案集编程求解器处理以合成PDDL规划领域，规划领域中的预言函数则用于为每个技能策略提取出最小化、任务相关且与目标相关的观察和动作空间。策略在控制参考层面而非原始执行器信号层面进行学习，从而获得更平滑且噪声更少的学习目标。通过将单个演示投影到场景中的其他物体上，可以利用已知控制器进行现实世界数据增强，同时丰富图构建过程与模仿学习的数据集。我们主要在一台真实工业叉车上通过统计严谨的操作实验验证了该框架，并在Kinova Gen3机械臂上通过两个标准基准测试展示了其跨平台通用性。结果表明，将控制学习、VLM驱动的抽象与自动规划综合统一到同一流程中，为实现可扩展、数据高效、无需专家且可解释的神经符号机器人学提供了一条切实可行的路径。

title: Human-Robot Copilot for Data-Efficient Imitation Learning
summary: Collecting human demonstrations via teleoperation is a common approach for teaching robots task-specific skills. However, when only a limited number of demonstrations are available, policies are prone to entering out-of-distribution (OOD) states due to compounding errors or environmental stochasticity. Existing interactive imitation learning or human-in-the-loop methods try to address this issue by following the Human-Gated DAgger (HG-DAgger) paradigm, an approach that augments demonstrations through selective human intervention during policy execution. Nevertheless, these approaches struggle to balance dexterity and generality: they either provide fine-grained corrections but are limited to specific kinematic structures, or achieve generality at the cost of precise control. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Human-Robot Copilot framework that can leverage a scaling factor for dexterous teleoperation while maintaining compatibility with a wide range of industrial and research manipulators. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves higher performance with the same number of demonstration trajectories. Moreover, since corrective interventions are required only intermittently, the overall data collection process is more efficient and less time-consuming.
tldr: A human-robot copilot framework enhances data-efficient imitation learning by enabling dexterous teleoperation and intermittent human intervention, improving performance and reducing data collection burden for robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种人机协作框架，通过灵巧遥操作和间歇性人工干预，提高模仿学习的数据效率，在相同演示轨迹下获得更高性能，减轻数据收集负担，适用于广泛的机械臂。
summary_zh: 通过遥操作收集人类示范是教授机器人任务特定技能的一种常用方法。然而当示范数量有限时由于误差累积或环境随机性策略往往容易陷入分布外状态。现有的交互式模仿学习或人在回路方法试图通过遵循人类门控DAgger范式来解决这一问题该范式通过在策略执行期间进行选择性人工干预来扩充示范。然而这些方法难以在灵巧性与通用性之间取得平衡：它们要么提供精细的纠正但受限于特定运动结构要么以牺牲精确控制为代价实现通用性。为克服这一局限我们提出了人机协同框架该框架可通过调节灵巧遥操作的缩放因子同时保持与各类工业和科研机械臂的广泛兼容性。实验结果表明在相同示范轨迹数量下我们的框架实现了更高性能。此外由于仅需间歇性纠正干预整体数据收集过程效率更高且耗时更少。

title: CRAFT: Video Diffusion for Bimanual Robot Data Generation
summary: Bimanual robot learning from demonstrations is fundamentally limited by the cost and narrow visual diversity of real-world data, which constrains policy robustness across viewpoints, object configurations, and embodiments. We present Canny-guided Robot Data Generation using Video Diffusion Transformers (CRAFT), a video diffusion-based framework for scalable bimanual demonstration generation that synthesizes temporally coherent manipulation videos while producing action labels. By conditioning video diffusion on edge-based structural cues extracted from simulator-generated trajectories, CRAFT produces physically plausible trajectory variations and supports a unified augmentation pipeline spanning object pose changes, camera viewpoints, lighting and background variations, cross-embodiment transfer, and multi-view synthesis. We leverage a pre-trained video diffusion model to convert simulated videos, along with action labels from the simulation trajectories, into action-consistent demonstrations. Starting from only a few real-world demonstrations, CRAFT generates a large, visually diverse set of photorealistic training data, bypassing the need to replay demonstrations on the real robot (Sim2Real). Across simulated and real-world bimanual tasks, CRAFT improves success rates over existing augmentation strategies and straightforward data scaling, demonstrating that diffusion-based video generation can substantially expand demonstration diversity and improve generalization for dual-arm manipulation tasks. Our project website is available at: https://craftaug.github.io/
tldr: CRAFT uses video diffusion models conditioned on edge cues to generate diverse, photorealistic bimanual robot manipulation videos and action labels from simulated data, improving policy robustness and generalization without real-world replay.
tldr_zh: CRAFT利用基于边缘线索的引导视频扩散模型，从模拟数据生成多样化的、真实感强的机器人双手操作视频和动作标签，无需真实世界重放，提升了策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 基于演示的双臂机器人学习从根本上受到现实世界数据成本高昂和视觉多样性有限的制约，这限制了策略在不同视角、物体配置及机器人形态下的鲁棒性。我们提出CRAFT（基于视频扩散变换器的边缘引导机器人数据生成框架），该框架利用视频扩散技术实现可扩展的双臂演示生成，在合成时序连贯的操作视频的同时产生动作标签。通过将基于模拟器生成轨迹提取的边缘结构线索作为视频扩散的条件，CRAFT能够生成物理可信的轨迹变体，并支持涵盖物体姿态变化、相机视角切换、光照与背景变化、跨形态迁移以及多视角合成的统一增强流程。我们借助预训练视频扩散模型，将模拟视频及其对应仿真轨迹的动作标签转化为动作一致的教学演示。仅需少量真实世界演示作为起点，CRAFT即可生成大规模、视觉多样化的逼真训练数据，从而避免了在真实机器人上重复演示的需求（Sim2Real）。在模拟与真实世界的双臂任务中，CRAFT相较于现有增强策略和直接数据扩增方法显著提升了成功率，证明基于扩散的视频生成技术能有效拓展演示多样性，并提升双臂操作任务的泛化能力。项目网站详见：https://craftaug.github.io/

title: Drift-Based Policy Optimization: Native One-Step Policy Learning for Online Robot Control
summary: Although multi-step generative policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by modeling multimodal action distributions, they require multi-step iterative denoising at inference time. Each action therefore needs tens to hundreds of network function evaluations (NFEs), making them costly for high-frequency closed-loop control and online reinforcement learning (RL). To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage framework for native one-step generative policies that shifts refinement from inference to training. First, we introduce the Drift-Based Policy (DBP), which leverages fixed-point drifting objectives to internalize iterative refinement into the model parameters, yielding a one-step generative backbone by design while preserving multimodal action modeling capacity. Second, we develop Drift-Based Policy Optimization (DBPO), an online RL framework that equips the pretrained backbone with a compatible stochastic interface, enabling stable on-policy updates without sacrificing the one-step deployment property. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework across offline imitation learning, online fine-tuning, and real-world control scenarios. DBP matches or exceeds the performance of multi-step diffusion policies while achieving up to $100\times$ faster inference. It also consistently outperforms existing one-step baselines on challenging manipulation benchmarks. Moreover, DBPO enables effective and stable policy improvement in online settings. Experiments on a real-world dual-arm robot demonstrate reliable high-frequency control at 105.2 Hz.
tldr: The paper introduces Drift-Based Policy Optimization (DBPO), a method for training one-step generative policies for robot control that matches the performance of slower multi-step methods while enabling high-frequency real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于漂移的策略优化方法，用于训练一步生成式机器人控制策略，在性能上匹敌多步方法的同时，实现了高速率的实时部署。
summary_zh: 尽管多步生成策略通过建模多模态动作分布在机器人操作中实现了强劲性能，但它们在推理时需要多步迭代去噪处理。因此每个动作需要进行数十至数百次网络函数评估（NFEs），这使其难以适用于高频闭环控制和在线强化学习（RL）。针对这一局限，我们提出了一个用于原生单步生成策略的两阶段框架，将优化过程从推理阶段转移到训练阶段。首先，我们引入基于漂移的策略（DBP），该方法利用不动点漂移目标将迭代优化内化至模型参数中，从而在保持多模态动作建模能力的同时，通过设计实现单步生成主干网络。其次，我们开发了基于漂移的策略优化（DBPO），这是一个在线RL框架，为预训练主干网络配备兼容的随机接口，使其在不牺牲单步部署特性的前提下实现稳定的同策略更新。大量实验验证了所提框架在离线模仿学习、在线微调以及真实世界控制场景中的有效性。DBP在推理速度提升高达$100\times$的同时，达到或超越了多步扩散策略的性能。在具有挑战性的操作基准测试中，它也持续优于现有的单步基线方法。此外，DBPO能够在在线环境中实现有效且稳定的策略改进。在真实世界双机械臂机器人上的实验表明，该系统能以105.2 Hz的频率实现可靠的高频控制。

title: Optimizing Neurorobot Policy under Limited Demonstration Data through Preference Regret
summary: Robot reinforcement learning from demonstrations (RLfD) assumes that expert data is abundant; this is usually unrealistic in the real world given data scarcity as well as high collection cost. Furthermore, imitation learning algorithms assume that the data is independently and identically distributed, which ultimately results in poorer performance as gradual errors emerge and compound within test-time trajectories. We address these issues by introducing the "master your own expertise" (MYOE) framework, a self-imitation framework that enables robotic agents to learn complex behaviors from limited demonstration data samples. Inspired by human perception and action, we propose and design what we call the queryable mixture-of-preferences state space model (QMoP-SSM), which estimates the desired goal at every time step. These desired goals are used in computing the "preference regret", which is used to optimize the robot control policy. Our experiments demonstrate the robustness, adaptability, and out-of-sample performance of our agent compared to other state-of-the-art RLfD schemes. The GitHub repository that supports this work can be found at: https://github.com/rxng8/neurorobot-preference-regret-learning.
tldr: Proposes a self-imitation framework (MYOE) and a preference-based world model (QMoP-SSM) to enable robotic agents to learn from limited demonstration data by optimizing a policy using a 'preference regret' objective.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种自我模仿框架（MYOE）和基于偏好的世界模型（QMoP-SSM），通过优化使用'偏好后悔'目标的策略，使机器人代理能够从有限的演示数据中学习复杂行为。
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人通过演示进行强化学习（RLfD）通常假设专家数据充足，但在现实世界中，由于数据稀缺且采集成本高昂，这一假设往往不成立。此外，模仿学习算法通常假定数据是独立同分布的，这会导致测试轨迹中逐渐出现并累积误差，最终影响性能表现。为解决这些问题，我们提出了“自主精进”（MYOE）框架，一种自我模仿框架，使机器人能够从有限的演示数据样本中学习复杂行为。受人类感知与行动的启发，我们设计了一种可查询的偏好混合状态空间模型（QMoP-SSM），该模型能够在每个时间步估计期望目标。这些期望目标被用于计算“偏好后悔”，进而优化机器人控制策略。实验表明，与其他先进的RLfD方案相比，我们的智能体在鲁棒性、适应性和样本外性能方面均表现优异。支持本工作的GitHub代码库地址为：https://github.com/rxng8/neurorobot-preference-regret-learning。

title: Do Robots Need Body Language? Comparing Communication Modalities for Legible Motion Intent in Human-Shared Spaces
summary: Robots in shared spaces often move in ways that are difficult for people to interpret, placing the burden on humans to adapt. High-DoF robots exhibit motion that people read as expressive, intentionally or not, making it important to understand how such cues are perceived. We present an online video study evaluating how different signaling modalities, expressive motion, lights, text, and audio, shape people's ability to understand a quadruped robot's upcoming navigation actions (Boston Dynamics Spot). Across four common scenarios, we measure how each modality influences humans' (1) accuracy in predicting the robot's next navigation action, (2) confidence in that prediction, and (3) trust in the robot to act safely. The study tests how expressive motions compare to explicit channels, whether aligned multimodal cues enhance interpretability, and how conflicting cues affect user confidence and trust. We contribute initial evidence on the relative effectiveness of implicit versus explicit signaling strategies.
tldr: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of different signaling modalities, including expressive motion, lights, text, and audio, on a quadruped robot (Boston Dynamics Spot) to improve human legibility and trust in shared spaces.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了不同信号模态（包括表达性运动、灯光、文本和音频）对四足机器人（波士顿动力 Spot）在共享空间中提高人类可理解性和信任度的效果。
summary_zh: 共享空间中的机器人往往以人类难以理解的方式移动，这迫使人们不得不主动适应其行为。高自由度机器人的运动（无论是否出于设计意图）常被人类解读为具有表达性，因此理解这类运动线索如何被感知至关重要。本研究通过在线视频实验，评估了不同信号传递方式（包括表达性动作、灯光、文字和音频）如何影响人类对四足机器人（波士顿动力Spot）即将执行的导航动作的理解能力。针对四种常见场景，我们测量了每种方式如何影响人类：（1）预测机器人下一步导航动作的准确性；（2）对预测结果的置信度；（3）对机器人安全行动的信任度。实验对比了表达性动作与显性信号通道的效果，检验了多模态线索一致时是否提升可解释性，并探究了冲突线索如何影响用户置信度与信任水平。本研究为隐性与显性信号传递策略的相对有效性提供了初步证据。

title: Neural Operators for Multi-Task Control and Adaptation
summary: Neural operator methods have emerged as powerful tools for learning mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces, yet their potential in optimal control remains largely unexplored. We focus on multi-task control problems, whose solution is a mapping from task description (e.g., cost or dynamics functions) to optimal control law (e.g., feedback policy). We approximate these solution operators using a permutation-invariant neural operator architecture. Across a range of parametric optimal control environments and a locomotion benchmark, a single operator trained via behavioral cloning accurately approximates the solution operator and generalizes to unseen tasks, out-of-distribution settings, and varying amounts of task observations. We further show that the branch-trunk structure of our neural operator architecture enables efficient and flexible adaptation to new tasks. We develop structured adaptation strategies ranging from lightweight updates to full-network fine-tuning, achieving strong performance across different data and compute settings. Finally, we introduce meta-trained operator variants that optimize the initialization for few-shot adaptation. These methods enable rapid task adaptation with limited data and consistently outperform a popular meta-learning baseline. Together, our results demonstrate that neural operators provide a unified and efficient framework for multi-task control and adaptation.
tldr: This paper introduces a neural operator framework for learning solution operators in multi-task optimal control, demonstrating generalization, efficient adaptation, and strong performance on locomotion and other control tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多任务最优控制的神经算子框架，展示了其在任务泛化、高效适应和包括运动控制在内的各类任务中的强大性能。
summary_zh: 神经网络算子方法已成为学习无限维函数空间之间映射的强大工具，但其在最优控制领域的潜力尚未被充分探索。本文聚焦于多任务控制问题，其核心解为从任务描述（如成本函数或动态函数）到最优控制律（如反馈策略）的映射关系。我们采用一种置换不变的神经网络算子架构来逼近这些解算子。在多种参数化最优控制环境与运动控制基准测试中，通过行为克隆训练的单一算子能够精确逼近解算子，并泛化至未见任务、分布外场景以及不同任务观测条件下。我们进一步证明，该神经网络算子的分支-主干结构能够实现高效灵活的任务适应能力。我们开发了从轻量级更新到全网络微调的结构化适应策略，在不同数据与计算设置下均表现出优异性能。最后，我们提出元训练算子变体，通过优化初始化实现少样本快速适应。这些方法能够在有限数据条件下实现快速任务适应，其性能始终优于主流元学习基线方法。综上，我们的研究表明神经网络算子为多任务控制与适应提供了统一且高效的理论框架。

title: A Multi-View 3D Telepresence System for XR Robot Teleoperation
summary: Robot teleoperation is critical for applications such as remote maintenance, fleet robotics, search and rescue, and data collection for robot learning. Effective teleoperation requires intuitive 3D visualization with reliable depth cues, which conventional screen-based interfaces often fail to provide. We introduce a multi-view VR telepresence system that (1) fuses geometry from three cameras to produce GPU-accelerated point-cloud rendering on standalone VR hardware, and (2) integrates a wrist-mounted RGB stream to provide high-resolution local detail where point-cloud accuracy is limited. Our pipeline supports real-time rendering of approximately 75k points on the Meta Quest 3. A within-subject study was conducted with 31 participants to compare our system to other visualisation modalities, such as RGB streams, a projection of stereo-vision directly in the VR device and point clouds without providing additional RGB information. Across three different teleoperated manipulation tasks, we measured task success, completion time, perceived workload, and usability. Our system achieved the best overall performance, while the Point Cloud modality without RGB also outperforming the RGB streams and OpenTeleVision. These results show that combining global 3D structure with localized high-resolution detail substantially improves telepresence for manipulation and provides a strong foundation for next-generation robot teleoperation systems.
tldr: The paper introduces a multi-view VR telepresence system for robot teleoperation, combining 3D point-clouds with a high-resolution RGB stream for enhanced manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于机器人遥操作的多视图VR远程呈现系统，结合了3D点云与高分辨率RGB流，以提升操控性能。
summary_zh: 机器人遥操作在远程维护、集群机器人、搜索救援以及机器人学习的数据收集等应用中至关重要。有效的遥操作需要具备可靠深度信息的直观三维可视化，而传统的基于屏幕的界面往往无法满足这一需求。我们提出了一种多视角虚拟现实（VR）遥临系统，该系统能够（1）融合三个摄像头的几何数据，在独立式VR硬件上实现基于GPU加速的点云渲染；（2）集成腕部安装的RGB视频流，在点云精度受限的区域提供高分辨率的局部细节。我们的系统在Meta Quest 3上实现了约7.5万个点的实时渲染。我们开展了一项包含31名参与者的受试者内研究，将本系统与RGB视频流、VR设备内直接立体视觉投影、以及未提供额外RGB信息的点云等多种可视化模式进行比较。在三种不同的遥操作任务中，我们测量了任务成功率、完成时间、感知工作量及可用性。实验结果表明，本系统取得了最佳的综合性能，而纯点云模式的表现也优于RGB视频流和OpenTeleVision。这些结果证明，将全局三维结构与局部高分辨率细节相结合，能够显著提升用于操作的遥临体验，并为下一代机器人遥操作系统奠定坚实基础。

title: Towards Edge Intelligence via Autonomous Navigation: A Robot-Assisted Data Collection Approach
summary: With the growing demand for large-scale and high-quality data in edge intelligence systems, mobile robots are increasingly deployed to collect data proactively, particularly in complex environments. However, existing robot-assisted data collection methods face significant challenges in achieving reliable and efficient performance, especially in non-line-of-sight (NLoS) environments. This paper proposes a communication-and-learning dual-driven (CLD) autonomous navigation scheme that incorporates region-aware propagation characteristics and a non-point-mass robot representation. This scheme enables simultaneous optimization of navigation, communication, and learning performance. An efficient algorithm based on majorization-minimization (MM) is proposed to solve the non-convex and non-smooth CLD problem. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves superior performance in collision-avoidance navigation, data collection, and model training compared to benchmark methods. It is also shown that CLD can adapt to different scenarios by flexibly adjusting the weight factor among navigation, communication and learning objectives.
tldr: This paper proposes a communication-and-learning dual-driven (CLD) autonomous navigation scheme for mobile robots to efficiently collect data for edge intelligence, jointly optimizing navigation, communication, and model learning performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种通信-学习双重驱动的自主导航方案，用于移动机器人为边缘智能高效收集数据，联合优化导航、通信和模型学习性能。
summary_zh: 随着边缘智能系统对大规模高质量数据的需求日益增长，移动机器人越来越多地被主动部署用于数据采集，尤其在复杂环境中。然而，现有机器人辅助数据采集方法在实现可靠高效性能方面面临显著挑战，特别是在非视距环境中。本文提出一种通信与学习双驱动的自主导航方案，该方案融合了区域感知的传播特性和非质点机器人表征，能够同步优化导航、通信与学习性能。通过提出一种基于主最小化的高效算法，解决了非凸非光滑的通信与学习双驱动问题。仿真结果表明，相比基准方法，所提方案在避障导航、数据采集和模型训练方面均实现了更优性能。研究还表明，该方案可通过灵活调整导航、通信与学习目标间的权重因子，适应不同应用场景。

title: Sim2Real-AD: A Modular Sim-to-Real Framework for Deploying VLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Autonomous Driving
summary: Deploying reinforcement learning policies trained in simulation to real autonomous vehicles remains a fundamental challenge, particularly for VLM-guided RL frameworks whose policies are typically learned with simulator-native observations and simulator-coupled action semantics that are unavailable on physical platforms. This paper presents Sim2Real-AD, a modular framework for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of CARLA-trained VLM-guided RL policies to full-scale vehicles without any real-world RL training data. The framework decomposes the transfer problem into four components: a Geometric Observation Bridge (GOB) that converts monocular front-view images into simulator-compatible bird's-eye-view (BEV) observations, a Physics-Aware Action Mapping (PAM) that translates policy outputs into platform-agnostic physical commands, a Two-Phase Progressive Training (TPT) strategy that stabilizes adaptation by separating action-space and observation-space transfer, and a Real-time Deployment Pipeline (RDP) that integrates perception, policy inference, control conversion, and safety monitoring for closed-loop execution. Simulation experiments show that the framework preserves the relative performance ordering of representative RL algorithms across different reward paradigms and validate the contribution of each module. Zero-shot deployment on a full-scale Ford E-Transit achieves success rates of 90%, 80%, and 75% in car-following, obstacle avoidance, and stop-sign interaction scenarios, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this study is among the first to demonstrate zero-shot closed-loop deployment of a CARLA-trained VLM-guided RL policy on a full-scale real vehicle without any real-world RL training data. The demo video and code are available at: https://zilin-huang.github.io/Sim2Real-AD-website/.
tldr: This paper presents a modular framework for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of VLM-guided RL policies from CARLA to full-scale autonomous vehicles, achieving high success rates in real-world driving tasks without any real-world RL training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个模块化框架，用于将CARLA训练的VLM引导的强化学习策略零次泛化到真实世界的全尺寸自动驾驶汽车上，在无需真实世界RL训练数据的情况下，在跟车、避障和停车标志交互等任务中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 将强化学习策略从仿真环境迁移到真实自动驾驶车辆中仍面临根本性挑战，这对于VLM（视觉语言模型）引导的强化学习框架尤为突出。这类策略通常在仿真环境中习得，依赖仿真器原生观测数据以及与仿真器耦合的动作语义，而这些信息在物理平台上无法获取。本文提出Sim2Real-AD，这是一个模块化框架，旨在实现CARLA训练出的VLM引导强化学习策略向实车零样本仿真到现实的迁移，无需任何真实世界强化学习训练数据。该框架将迁移问题分解为四个组成部分：几何观测桥接模块，将单目前视图像转换为仿真器兼容的鸟瞰图观测；物理感知动作映射模块，将策略输出转化为与平台无关的物理控制指令；两阶段渐进式训练策略，通过分离动作空间与观测空间的迁移来稳定适应过程；以及实时部署流水线，集成感知、策略推理、控制转换与安全监控以实现闭环执行。仿真实验表明，该框架在不同奖励范式下均能保持代表性强化学习算法的相对性能排序，并验证了各模块的贡献。在全尺寸福特E-Transit实车上的零样本部署测试中，车辆在跟车行驶、避障和停车标志交互场景中的成功率分别达到90%、80%和75%。据我们所知，本研究首次实现了CARLA训练的VLM引导强化学习策略在全尺寸真实车辆上无需真实世界强化学习训练数据的零样本闭环部署。演示视频与代码发布在：https://zilin-huang.github.io/Sim2Real-AD-website/。

title: Learning-Based Fault Detection for Legged Robots in Remote Dynamic Environments
summary: Operations in hazardous environments put humans, animals, and machines at high risk for physically damaging consequences. In contrast to humans and animals, quadruped robots cannot naturally identify and adjust their locomotion to a severely debilitated limb. The ability to detect limb damage and adjust movement to a new physical morphology is the difference between survival and death for humans and animals. The same can be said for quadruped robots autonomously carrying out remote assignments in dynamic, complex settings. This work presents the development and implementation of an off-line learning-based method to detect single limb faults from proprioceptive sensor data in a quadrupedal robot. The aim of the fault detection technique is to provide the correct output for the controller to select the appropriate tripedal gait to use given the robot's current physical morphology.
tldr: This paper presents a learning-based method for detecting single limb faults in quadrupedal robots using proprioceptive sensor data, enabling the controller to switch to an appropriate tripedal gait.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的方法，利用本体感知传感器数据检测四足机器人的单肢故障，使控制器能够切换至合适的三足步态。
summary_zh: 在危险环境中的操作会给人类、动物和机器带来极高的物理损伤风险。与人类和动物不同，四足机器人无法自然地识别其肢体严重受损情况并相应地调整步态。对于人类和动物而言，检测肢体损伤并适应新物理形态的移动能力关乎生死存亡。同样，对于在动态复杂环境中自主执行远程任务的四足机器人也是如此。本研究开发并实现了一种基于离线学习的方法，通过本体感知传感器数据检测四足机器人单肢故障。该故障检测技术的目标是为控制器提供正确输出，使其能够根据机器人当前物理形态选择合适的三角步态。

title: Multi-Robot Multi-Queue Control via Exhaustive Assignment Actor-Critic Learning
summary: We study online task allocation for multi-robot, multi-queue systems with asymmetric stochastic arrivals and switching delays. We formulate the problem in discrete time: each location can host at most one robot per slot, servicing a task consumes one slot, switching between locations incurs a one-slot travel delay, and arrivals at locations are independent Bernoulli processes with heterogeneous rates. Building on our previous structural result that optimal policies are of exhaustive type, we formulate a discounted-cost Markov decision process and develop an exhaustive-assignment actor-critic policy architecture that enforces exhaustive service by construction and learns only the next-queue allocation for idle robots. Unlike the exhaustive-serve-longest (ESL) queue rule, whose optimality is known only under symmetry, the proposed policy adapts to asymmetry in arrival rates. Across different server-location ratios, loads, and asymmetric arrival profiles, the proposed policy consistently achieves lower discounted holding cost and smaller mean queue length than the ESL baseline, while remaining near-optimal on instances where an optimal benchmark is available. These results show that structure-aware actor-critic methods provide an effective approach for real-time multi-robot scheduling.
tldr: This paper proposes an actor-critic learning method for real-time multi-robot task allocation in systems with multiple queues and stochastic arrivals, ensuring exhaustive service at assigned locations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于演员-评论家学习的方法，用于具有多队列和随机任务到达的多机器人系统实时任务分配，确保机器人在指定位置进行彻底服务。
summary_zh: 摘要：本文研究多机器人、多队列系统中具有不对称随机到达和切换延迟的在线任务分配问题。我们采用离散时间框架建模：每个时段每个位置至多容纳一个机器人；任务处理消耗一个时段；位置间切换会引及时段旅行延迟；各位置的任务到达为独立伯努利过程且到达率具有异质性。基于我们先前关于最优策略具有穷尽服务性质的结构性结论，我们构建了折扣成本马尔可夫决策过程，并设计了一种穷尽分配演员-评论家策略架构。该架构通过构造保证穷尽服务，仅需学习空闲机器人的下一队列分配策略。相较于仅能在对称条件下证明最优性的穷尽服务最长队列（ESL）规则，该策略能自适应到达率的不对称性。在不同服务器-位置比例、负载水平和不对称到达场景下，该策略始终比ESL基线获得更低的折扣持有成本和更小的平均队列长度，并在可获得最优基准的实例中保持接近最优性能。这些结果表明，结构感知的演员-评论家方法为实时多机器人调度提供了有效途径。

title: A Novel Hybrid PID-LQR Controller for Sit-To-Stand Assistance Using a CAD-Integrated Simscape Multibody Lower Limb Exoskeleton
summary: Precise control of lower limb exoskeletons during sit-to-stand (STS) transitions remains a central challenge in rehabilitation robotics owing to the highly nonlinear, time-varying dynamics of the human-exoskeleton system and the stringent trajectory tracking requirements imposed by clinical safety. This paper presents the systematic design, simulation, and comparative evaluation of three control strategies: a classical Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller, a Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR), and a novel Hybrid PID-LQR controller applied to a bilateral lower limb exoskeleton performing the sit-to-stand transition. A high-fidelity, physics-based dynamic model of the exoskeleton is constructed by importing a SolidWorks CAD assembly directly into the MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Multibody environment, preserving accurate geometric and inertial properties of all links. Physiologically representative reference joint trajectories for the hip, knee, and ankle joints are generated using OpenSim musculoskeletal simulation and decomposed into three biomechanical phases: flexion-momentum (0-33%), momentum-transfer (34-66%), and extension (67-100%). The proposed Hybrid PID-LQR controller combines the optimal transient response of LQR with the integral disturbance rejection of PID through a tuned blending coefficient alpha = 0.65. Simulation results demonstrate that the Hybrid PID-LQR achieves RMSE reductions of 72.3% and 70.4% over PID at the hip and knee joints, respectively, reduces settling time by over 90% relative to PID across all joints, and limits overshoot to 2.39%-6.10%, confirming its superiority over both baseline strategies across all evaluated performance metrics and demonstrating strong translational potential for clinical assistive exoskeleton deployment.
tldr: The paper presents a novel Hybrid PID-LQR controller for a lower-limb exoskeleton performing the sit-to-stand transition, showing superior trajectory tracking and disturbance rejection in high-fidelity simulations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于坐站转换的下肢外骨骼混合PID-LQR控制器，在高保真仿真中展示了优越的轨迹跟踪和抗干扰能力。
summary_zh: 在康复机器人领域，由于人机系统高度非线性、时变的动力学特性以及临床安全性对轨迹跟踪的严格要求，坐立转换过程中下肢外骨骼的精准控制始终是一项核心挑战。本研究针对双侧下肢外骨骼执行坐立转换任务，系统设计并仿真比较了三种控制策略：经典比例-积分-微分控制器、线性二次调节器以及新型混合PID-LQR控制器。通过将SolidWorks CAD装配体直接导入MATLAB/Simulink Simscape Multibody环境，构建了高保真度的物理动力学模型，完整保留了所有连杆的精确几何与惯性属性。利用OpenSim肌肉骨骼仿真生成符合人体生理特征的髋、膝、踝关节参考轨迹，并将其分解为三个生物力学阶段：屈曲动量期（0-33%）、动量转移期（34-66%）和伸展期（67-100%）。所提出的混合PID-LQR控制器通过α=0.65的调谐融合系数，将线性二次调节器的最优瞬态响应与比例-积分-微分控制器的积分抗扰特性相结合。仿真结果表明：混合控制器在髋、膝关节的均方根误差较传统PID分别降低72.3%和70.4%；所有关节的调节时间缩短90%以上；超调量控制在2.39%-6.10%区间，在所有评估指标上均优于基准策略，展现出临床辅助外骨骼应用的强大转化潜力。

title: CT-VoxelMap: Efficient Continuous-Time LiDAR-Inertial Odometry with Probabilistic Adaptive Voxel Mapping
summary: Maintaining stable and accurate localization during fast motion or on rough terrain remains highly challenging for mobile robots with onboard resources. Currently, multi-sensor fusion methods based on continuous-time representation offer a potential and effective solution to this challenge. Among these, spline-based methods provide an efficient and intuitive approach for continuous-time representation. Previous continuous-time odometry works based on B-splines either treat control points as variables to be estimated or perform estimation in quaternion space, which introduces complexity in deriving analytical Jacobians and often overlooks the fitting error between the spline and the true trajectory over time. To address these issues, we first propose representing the increments of control points on matrix Lie groups as variables to be estimated. Leveraging the feature of the cumulative form of B-splines, we derive a more compact formulation that yields simpler analytical Jacobians without requiring additional boundary condition considerations. Second, we utilize forward propagation information from IMU measurements to estimate fitting errors online and further introduce a hybrid feature-based voxel map management strategy, enhancing system accuracy and robustness. Finally, we propose a re-estimation policy that significantly improves system computational efficiency and robustness. The proposed method is evaluated on multiple challenging public datasets, demonstrating superior performance on most sequences. Detailed ablation studies are conducted to analyze the impact of each module on the overall pose estimation system.
tldr: This paper presents a continuous-time LiDAR-inertial odometry method for mobile robots, focusing on improving localization accuracy and robustness during fast motion using a novel spline representation and adaptive voxel mapping.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对移动机器人的连续时间LiDAR-惯性里程计方法，通过新颖的样条表示和自适应体素映射，旨在提高快速运动时的定位精度和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 对于搭载机载资源的移动机器人而言，在快速运动或崎岖地形上保持稳定且精确的定位仍然极具挑战性。当前，基于连续时间表示的多传感器融合方法为这一挑战提供了潜在且有效的解决方案。其中，基于样条的方法为实现连续时间表示提供了一种高效且直观的途径。先前基于B样条的连续时间里程计研究，要么将控制点视为待估计变量，要么在四元数空间中进行估计，这导致解析雅可比矩阵的推导过程复杂，且往往忽视了样条随时间推移与真实轨迹之间的拟合误差。为解决这些问题，我们首先提出将矩阵李群上的控制点增量作为待估计变量进行表示。利用B样条累积形式的特点，我们推导出了一种更紧凑的表达式，该表达式可在无需额外边界条件考虑的情况下，得到更简洁的解析雅可比矩阵。其次，我们利用来自IMU测量的前向传播信息在线估计拟合误差，并进一步引入一种基于混合特征的体素地图管理策略，从而提升系统的精度与鲁棒性。最后，我们提出了一种重估计算法，显著提高了系统的计算效率和鲁棒性。所提出的方法在多个具有挑战性的公开数据集上进行了评估，结果表明在大多数序列中均展现出优越的性能。通过详细的消融实验，分析了各模块对整体位姿估计系统的影响。

title: Diffusion Policy with Bayesian Expert Selection for Active Multi-Target Tracking
summary: Active multi-target tracking requires a mobile robot to balance exploration for undetected targets with exploitation of uncertain tracked ones. Diffusion policies have emerged as a powerful approach for capturing diverse behavioral strategies by learning action sequences from expert demonstrations. However, existing methods implicitly select among strategies through the denoising process, without uncertainty quantification over which strategy to execute. We formulate expert selection for diffusion policies as an offline contextual bandit problem and propose a Bayesian framework for pessimistic, uncertainty-aware strategy selection. A multi-head Variational Bayesian Last Layer (VBLL) model predicts the expected tracking performance of each expert strategy given the current belief state, providing both a point estimate and predictive uncertainty. Following the pessimism principle for offline decision-making, a Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) criterion then selects the expert whose worst-case predicted performance is best, avoiding overcommitment to experts with unreliable predictions. The selected expert conditions a diffusion policy to generate corresponding action sequences. Experiments on simulated indoor tracking scenarios demonstrate that our approach outperforms both the base diffusion policy and standard gating methods, including Mixture-of-Experts selection and deterministic regression baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes a Bayesian expert selection framework for a diffusion policy to improve active multi-target tracking by a mobile robot, balancing exploration and exploitation with uncertainty-aware strategy selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种贝叶斯专家选择框架，用于改进移动机器人的主动多目标跟踪扩散策略，通过不确定性感知的策略选择来平衡探索与利用。
summary_zh: 主动多目标跟踪要求移动机器人平衡对未探测目标的探索与对已跟踪目标不确定性的利用。扩散策略已成为一种强大方法，通过从专家演示中学习动作序列来捕捉多样化的行为策略。然而，现有方法在去噪过程中隐式地选择策略，缺乏对执行策略的不确定性量化。本文将扩散策略的专家选择建模为离线上下文多臂赌博机问题，并提出一个贝叶斯框架用于悲观且具有不确定性的策略选择。多头变分贝叶斯末层模型根据当前信念状态预测每个专家策略的期望跟踪性能，提供点估计和预测不确定性。基于离线决策的悲观原则，下界置信区间准则选择具有最坏情况预测性能最优的专家，避免过度依赖预测不可靠的专家。所选专家通过条件扩散策略生成相应的动作序列。在模拟室内跟踪场景中的实验表明，我们的方法优于基础扩散策略和标准门控方法，包括专家混合选择和确定性回归基线。

title: OpenRC: An Open-Source Robotic Colonoscopy Framework for Multimodal Data Acquisition and Autonomy Research
summary: Colorectal cancer screening critically depends on colonoscopy, yet existing platforms offer limited support for systematically studying the coupled dynamics of operator control, instrument motion, and visual feedback. This gap restricts reproducible closed-loop research in robotic colonoscopy, medical imaging, and emerging vision-language-action (VLA) learning paradigms. To address this challenge, we present OpenRC, an open-source modular robotic colonoscopy framework that retrofits conventional scopes while preserving clinical workflow. The framework supports simultaneous recording of video, operator commands, actuation state, and distal tip pose. We experimentally validated motion consistency and quantified cross-modal latency across sensing streams. Using this platform, we collected a multimodal dataset comprising 1,894 teleoperated episodes ~19 hours across 10 structured task variations of routine navigation, failure events, and recovery behaviors. By unifying open hardware and an aligned multimodal dataset, OpenRC provides a reproducible foundation for research in multimodal robotic colonoscopy and surgical autonomy.
tldr: The paper presents OpenRC, an open-source robotic colonoscopy framework for multimodal data collection and autonomy research, enabling reproducible studies in robotic control, sensing, and vision-language-action learning for a specific medical application.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了OpenRC，一个用于多模态数据采集和自主性研究的开源机器人结肠镜框架，为机器人控制、感知和视觉-语言-动作学习在特定医疗应用中的可重复研究提供了基础。
summary_zh: 结直肠癌筛查高度依赖于结肠镜检查，但现有平台对系统研究操作者控制、器械运动与视觉反馈之间的耦合动态支持有限。这一局限制约了机器人结肠镜、医学影像及新兴的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）学习范式中可重复的闭环研究。为应对此挑战，我们提出了OpenRC——一个开源模块化机器人结肠镜框架，可在保留临床工作流程的同时对传统内窥镜进行升级改造。该框架支持同步记录视频、操作者指令、驱动状态及末端头端位姿。我们通过实验验证了运动一致性，并量化了各传感流之间的跨模态延迟。利用该平台，我们收集了包含1,894次远程操作案例（总计约19小时）的多模态数据集，覆盖常规导航、故障事件与恢复行为等10种结构化任务场景。通过整合开源硬件与对齐的多模态数据集，OpenRC为多模态机器人结肠镜及手术自主性研究提供了可复现的基础平台。

title: InCaRPose: In-Cabin Relative Camera Pose Estimation Model and Dataset
summary: Camera extrinsic calibration is a fundamental task in computer vision. However, precise relative pose estimation in constrained, highly distorted environments, such as in-cabin automotive monitoring (ICAM), remains challenging. We present InCaRPose, a Transformer-based architecture designed for robust relative pose prediction between image pairs, which can be used for camera extrinsic calibration. By leveraging frozen backbone features such as DINOv3 and a Transformer-based decoder, our model effectively captures the geometric relationship between a reference and a target view. Unlike traditional methods, our approach achieves absolute metric-scale translation within the physically plausible adjustment range of in-cabin camera mounts in a single inference step, which is critical for ICAM, where accurate real-world distances are required for safety-relevant perception. We specifically address the challenges of highly distorted fisheye cameras in automotive interiors by training exclusively on synthetic data. Our model is capable of generalization to real-world cabin environments without relying on the exact same camera intrinsics and additionally achieves competitive performance on the public 7-Scenes dataset. Despite having limited training data, InCaRPose maintains high precision in both rotation and translation, even with a ViT-Small backbone. This enables real-time performance for time-critical inference, such as driver monitoring in supervised autonomous driving. We release our real-world In-Cabin-Pose test dataset consisting of highly distorted vehicle-interior images and our code at https://github.com/felixstillger/InCaRPose.
tldr: Presents a Transformer-based model for robust relative camera pose estimation in constrained, in-cabin environments, trained on synthetic data and achieving generalization to real-world automotive interiors.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于Transformer的模型，用于在受限的车内环境中进行鲁棒的相对相机姿态估计，该模型在合成数据上训练，并能泛化到真实的汽车内部环境。
summary_zh: 相机外参标定是计算机视觉领域的一项基础任务。然而，在受限且高度畸变的环境（如车内监控系统）中实现精确的相对位姿估计仍具挑战性。我们提出了InCaRPose——一种基于Transformer的架构，专为图像对之间鲁棒性的相对位姿预测而设计，可用于相机外参标定。该模型通过利用冻结骨干网络特征（如DINOv3）和基于Transformer的解码器，有效捕捉参考视图与目标视图之间的几何关系。与传统方法不同，我们的方法在单次推理步骤中即可实现物理可行的车内摄像头安装调整范围内的绝对度量尺度平移，这对需要精确真实世界距离以保障安全感知的车内监控系统至关重要。我们通过完全使用合成数据训练，专门应对汽车内舱高度畸变鱼眼相机带来的挑战。该模型能够泛化至真实车内环境，且不依赖完全相同的相机内参，同时在公开的7-Scenes数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能。尽管训练数据有限，InCaRPose即使采用ViT-Small骨干网络，仍能在旋转和平移参数上保持高精度。这使得模型在时间敏感型推理任务（如监督式自动驾驶中的驾驶员监控）中可实现实时性能。我们在https://github.com/felixstillger/InCaRPose发布了包含高度畸变车内图像的真实世界In-Cabin-Pose测试数据集及相关代码。

title: LightThinker++: From Reasoning Compression to Memory Management
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex reasoning, yet their efficiency is limited by the surging cognitive overhead of long thought traces. In this paper, we propose LightThinker, a method that enables LLMs to dynamically compress intermediate thoughts into compact semantic representations. However, static compression often struggles with complex reasoning where the irreversible loss of intermediate details can lead to logical bottlenecks. To address this, we evolve the framework into LightThinker++, introducing Explicit Adaptive Memory Management. This paradigm shifts to behavioral-level management by incorporating explicit memory primitives, supported by a specialized trajectory synthesis pipeline to train purposeful memory scheduling. Extensive experiments demonstrate the framework's versatility across three dimensions. (1) LightThinker reduces peak token usage by 70% and inference time by 26% with minimal accuracy loss. (2) In standard reasoning, LightThinker++ slashes peak token usage by 69.9% while yielding a +2.42% accuracy gain under the same context budget for maximum performance. (3) Most notably, in long-horizon agentic tasks, it maintains a stable footprint beyond 80 rounds (a 60%-70% reduction), achieving an average performance gain of 14.8% across different complex scenarios. Overall, our work provides a scalable direction for sustaining deep LLM reasoning over extended horizons with minimal overhead.
tldr: The paper introduces LightThinker++, a method for improving LLM reasoning efficiency by dynamically compressing intermediate thoughts and managing memory, showing significant performance gains in long-horizon agentic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LightThinker++方法，通过动态压缩中间推理步骤和管理记忆来提升大语言模型的推理效率，在长视野智能体任务中实现了显著的性能提升。
summary_zh: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务中表现卓越，但其效率受限于长思维链条带来的急剧增长的认知负荷。本文提出LightThinker方法，通过将中间思考动态压缩为紧凑的语义表征以提升效率。然而，静态压缩在处理复杂推理时往往面临挑战——中间细节的不可逆损失可能导致逻辑瓶颈。为此，我们进一步将框架升级为LightThinker++，引入显式自适应记忆管理机制。该范式通过整合显式记忆原语，转向行为层面的记忆管理，并借助专门设计的轨迹合成流程来训练有目的性的记忆调度策略。大量实验证明了该框架在三个维度上的优越性：(1) LightThinker在准确率损失极小的情况下，将峰值令牌使用量降低70%，推理时间缩短26%；(2) 在标准推理任务中，LightThinker++在相同上下文预算下实现69.9%的峰值令牌压缩，同时准确率提升2.42%，达到最优性能；(3) 在长程智能体任务中，其能在80轮交互后仍保持稳定的内存占用（降低60%-70%），并在不同复杂场景中平均获得14.8%的性能提升。总体而言，我们的工作为在长周期推理中维持大语言模型深度思考能力提供了可扩展的低成本解决方案。

title: ART: Adaptive Relational Transformer for Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction with Temporal-Aware Relations
summary: Accurate prediction of real-world pedestrian trajectories is crucial for a wide range of robot-related applications. Recent approaches typically adopt graph-based or transformer-based frameworks to model interactions. Despite their effectiveness, these methods either introduce unnecessary computational overhead or struggle to represent the diverse and time-varying characteristics of human interactions. In this work, we present an Adaptive Relational Transformer (ART), which introduces a Temporal-Aware Relation Graph (TARG) to explicitly capture the evolution of pairwise interactions and an Adaptive Interaction Pruning (AIP) mechanism to reduce redundant computations efficiently. Extensive evaluations on ETH/UCY and NBA benchmarks show that ART delivers state-of-the-art accuracy with high computational efficiency.
tldr: Proposes an Adaptive Relational Transformer (ART) with a Temporal-Aware Relation Graph and an Adaptive Interaction Pruning mechanism for efficient and accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction.
tldr_zh: 提出一种自适应关系Transformer（ART），通过时间感知关系图捕获行人交互的演变，并使用自适应交互剪枝机制高效减少冗余计算，用于准确预测行人轨迹。
summary_zh: 真实世界行人轨迹的精准预测对于各类机器人相关应用至关重要。现有方法通常采用基于图或基于Transformer的框架来建模交互关系。尽管这些方法具有一定效果，但它们要么引入了不必要的计算开销，要么难以表征人际交互中多样且时变的特性。本研究提出了一种自适应关系变换器（ART），通过引入时间感知关系图（TARG）显式捕捉成对交互的演化过程，并采用自适应交互剪枝（AIP）机制高效减少冗余计算。在ETH/UCY和NBA数据集上的大量实验表明，ART在保持高计算效率的同时实现了最先进的预测精度。

title: Delayed Homomorphic Reinforcement Learning for Environments with Delayed Feedback
summary: Reinforcement learning in real-world systems is often accompanied by delayed feedback, which breaks the Markov assumption and impedes both learning and control. Canonical state augmentation approaches cause the state-space explosion, which introduces a severe sample-complexity burden. Despite recent progress, the state-of-the-art augmentation-based baselines remain incomplete: they either predominantly reduce the burden on the critic or adopt non-unified treatments for the actor and critic. To provide a structured and sample-efficient solution, we propose delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning (DHRL), a framework grounded in MDP homomorphisms that collapses belief-equivalent augmented states and enables efficient policy learning on the resulting abstract MDP without loss of optimality. We provide theoretical analyses of state-space compression bounds and sample complexity, and introduce a practical algorithm. Experiments on continuous control tasks in MuJoCo benchmark confirm that our algorithm outperforms strong augmentation-based baselines, particularly under long delays.
tldr: Proposes a novel RL framework (DHRL) using MDP homomorphisms to efficiently handle delayed feedback without state-space explosion, with improved performance on continuous control tasks with long delays.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新的强化学习框架（DHRL），利用MDP同态性高效处理延迟反馈，避免状态空间爆炸，在具有长延迟的连续控制任务中表现出色。
summary_zh: 现实世界系统中的强化学习常常伴随着反馈延迟，这打破了马尔可夫假设并阻碍学习与控制过程。传统的状态增广方法会导致状态空间爆炸，从而带来严重的样本复杂度负担。尽管近期研究有所进展，但当前基于增广的基准方法仍存在不足：它们要么主要减轻评论者的负担，要么对行动者与评论者采用非统一的处理方式。为提供一种结构化且样本高效的解决方案，我们提出了延迟同态强化学习（DHRL），该框架基于马尔可夫决策过程同态理论，将信念等价的增广状态进行压缩，从而能在不损失最优性的前提下，在抽象马尔可夫决策过程上实现高效策略学习。我们提供了状态空间压缩边界与样本复杂度的理论分析，并设计了一种实用算法。在MuJoCo基准测试的连续控制任务中，实验证实我们的算法优于现有基于增广的强基线方法，尤其在长延迟条件下表现突出。

title: Rashomon Memory: Towards Argumentation-Driven Retrieval for Multi-Perspective Agent Memory
summary: AI agents operating over extended time horizons accumulate experiences that serve multiple concurrent goals, and must often maintain conflicting interpretations of the same events. A concession during a client negotiation encodes as a ``trust-building investment'' for one strategic goal and a ``contractual liability'' for another. Current memory architectures assume a single correct encoding, or at best support multiple views over unified storage. We propose Rashomon Memory: an architecture where parallel goal-conditioned agents encode experiences according to their priorities and negotiate at query time through argumentation. Each perspective maintains its own ontology and knowledge graph. At retrieval, perspectives propose interpretations, critique each other's proposals using asymmetric domain knowledge, and Dung's argumentation semantics determines which proposals survive. The resulting attack graph is itself an explanation: it records which interpretation was selected, which alternatives were considered, and on what grounds they were rejected. We present a proof-of-concept showing that retrieval modes (selection, composition, conflict surfacing) emerge from attack graph topology, and that the conflict surfacing mode, where the system reports genuine disagreement rather than forcing resolution, lets decision-makers see the underlying interpretive conflict directly.
tldr: Proposes Rashomon Memory, a memory architecture for AI agents that allows parallel goal-conditioned agents to maintain conflicting perspectives on experiences and negotiate at retrieval time using argumentation, rather than enforcing a single correct encoding.
tldr_zh: 提出了Rashomon Memory，一种用于AI智能体的记忆架构，允许并行的目标驱动智能体在经验上保持相互冲突的视角，并在检索时通过论证进行协商，而非强制单一正确编码。
summary_zh: 在长期运作过程中，AI智能体积累的经验需同时服务于多个并发目标，且常常需要对同一事件保持相互矛盾的解读。例如，在客户谈判中的一次让步，既可能被编码为某一战略目标下的“信任建设投资”，也可能成为另一目标下的“合同责任”。当前的内存架构通常假定只存在单一正确编码方式，至多在统一存储上支持多重视角。我们提出“罗生门内存”架构：在该架构中，多个以目标为导向的并行智能体根据各自优先级编码经验，并在查询时通过论证机制进行协商。每个视角维护独立的本体论与知识图谱。在检索阶段，各视角提出解读方案，利用非对称领域知识相互批判，并依据邓氏论证语义学决定最终采纳的方案。由此生成的攻击图本身即构成一种解释：它记录了被采纳的解读方案、被考虑的替代方案，以及这些方案被否决的依据。通过概念验证，我们展示了攻击图拓扑结构能自然呈现三种检索模式（选择、融合、冲突显化），其中冲突显化模式允许系统如实呈现分歧而非强制达成统一结论，使决策者能直接观察到潜在的解读冲突。

title: FunFact: Building Probabilistic Functional 3D Scene Graphs via Factor-Graph Reasoning
summary: Recent work in 3D scene understanding is moving beyond purely spatial analysis toward functional scene understanding. However, existing methods often consider functional relationships between object pairs in isolation, failing to capture the scene-wide interdependence that humans use to resolve ambiguity. We introduce FunFact, a framework for constructing probabilistic open-vocabulary functional 3D scene graphs from posed RGB-D images. FunFact first builds an object- and part-centric 3D map and uses foundation models to propose semantically plausible functional relations. These candidates are converted into factor graph variables and constrained by both LLM-derived common-sense priors and geometric priors. This formulation enables joint probabilistic inference over all functional edges and their marginals, yielding substantially better calibrated confidence scores. To benchmark this setting, we introduce FunThor, a synthetic dataset based on AI2-THOR with part-level geometry and rule-based functional annotations. Experiments on SceneFun3D, FunGraph3D, and FunThor show that FunFact improves node and relation discovery recall and significantly reduces calibration error for ambiguous relations, highlighting the benefits of holistic probabilistic modeling for functional scene understanding. See our project page at https://funfact-scenegraph.github.io/
tldr: FunFact is a framework for building probabilistic functional 3D scene graphs from RGB-D images using factor-graph reasoning and foundation models to jointly infer object relationships, evaluated on new synthetic and real-world datasets.
tldr_zh: FunFact是一个从RGB-D图像构建概率性功能3D场景图的框架，利用因子图推理和基础模型联合推断物体关系，并在新的合成和真实世界数据集上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 近期三维场景理解研究正从纯粹的空间分析转向功能性场景理解。然而，现有方法常孤立地考虑物体对之间的功能关系，未能捕捉人类用于消解歧义的场景全局互依性。我们提出了FunFact框架，该框架能够从配准的RGB-D图像构建概率式开放词汇功能三维场景图。FunFact首先建立以物体和部件为中心的三维地图，并利用基础模型生成语义上合理的功能关系候选。这些候选关系被转化为因子图变量，并受限于由大语言模型推导的常识先验与几何先验。该建模方式支持对所有功能边及其边际分布进行联合概率推断，从而产生显著更优的校准置信度得分。为建立该研究方向的基准，我们构建了FunThor合成数据集——该数据集基于AI2-THOR平台，具备部件级几何结构与基于规则的功能标注。在SceneFun3D、FunGraph3D和FunThor数据集上的实验表明，FunFact提升了节点与关系发现的召回率，并显著降低了模糊关系的校准误差，凸显了整体概率建模在功能性场景理解中的优势。项目页面详见：https://funfact-scenegraph.github.io/

title: Leveraging Gaze and Set-of-Mark in VLLMs for Human-Object Interaction Anticipation from Egocentric Videos
summary: The ability to anticipate human-object interactions is highly desirable in an intelligent assistive system in order to guide users during daily life activities and understand their short and long-term goals. Creating systems with such capabilities requires to approach several complex challenges. This work addresses the problem of human-object interaction anticipation in Egocentric Vision using Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs). We tackle key limitations in existing approaches by improving visual grounding capabilities through Set-of-Mark prompting and understanding user intent via the trajectory formed by the user's most recent gaze fixations. To effectively capture the temporal dynamics immediately preceding the interaction, we further introduce a novel inverse exponential sampling strategy for input video frames. Experiments conducted on the egocentric dataset HD-EPIC demonstrate that our method surpasses state-of-the-art approaches for the considered task, showing its model-agnostic nature.
tldr: This paper proposes using Vision Large Language Models with Set-of-Mark prompting and gaze trajectories for human-object interaction anticipation from egocentric videos, improving performance on a standard dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出利用视觉大语言模型，结合Set-of-Mark提示和注视轨迹，从第一人称视角视频中预测人-物交互，在标准数据集上超越了现有方法。
summary_zh: 在智能辅助系统中，预测人与物体的交互能力对于指导用户日常生活活动及理解其短期与长期目标至关重要。构建具备此类能力的系统需要应对多项复杂挑战。本研究致力于通过视觉大语言模型解决以自我为中心视角下的人-物交互预测问题。我们通过改进视觉定位能力——采用"标记集"提示方法，并结合用户最近凝视注视点形成的轨迹来理解用户意图，从而克服了现有方法的关键局限。为有效捕捉交互发生前的瞬时动态特征，我们进一步提出了一种新颖的逆指数采样策略来处理输入视频帧。在自我中心视角数据集HD-EPIC上进行的实验表明，该方法在相关任务中超越了现有最优方案，并展现出其模型无关的通用特性。

title: ViBA: Implicit Bundle Adjustment with Geometric and Temporal Consistency for Robust Visual Matching
summary: Most existing image keypoint detection and description methods rely on datasets with accurate pose and depth annotations, limiting scalability and generalization, and often degrading navigation and localization performance. We propose ViBA, a sustainable learning framework that integrates geometric optimization with feature learning for continuous online training on unconstrained video streams. Embedded in a standard visual odometry pipeline, it consists of an implicitly differentiable geometric residual framework: (i) an initial tracking network for inter-frame correspondences, (ii) depth-based outlier filtering, and (iii) differentiable global bundle adjustment that jointly refines camera poses and feature positions by minimizing reprojection errors. By combining geometric consistency from BA with long-term temporal consistency across frames, ViBA enforces stable and accurate feature representations. We evaluate ViBA on EuRoC and UMA datasets. Compared with state-of-the-art methods such as SuperPoint+SuperGlue, ALIKED, and LightGlue, ViBA reduces mean absolute translation error (ATE) by 12-18% and absolute rotation error (ARE) by 5-10% across sequences, while maintaining real-time inference speeds (FPS 36-91). When evaluated on unseen sequences, it retains over 90% localization accuracy, demonstrating robust generalization. These results show that ViBA supports continuous online learning with geometric and temporal consistency, consistently improving navigation and localization in real-world scenarios.
tldr: ViBA is a visual odometry method that integrates feature learning with a differentiable bundle adjustment module, enforcing geometric and temporal consistency for improved localization and navigation.
tldr_zh: ViBA 是一种视觉里程计方法，它将特征学习与可微分的光束法平差模块相结合，利用几何和时序一致性来提升定位和导航性能。
summary_zh: 现有大多数图像关键点检测与描述方法依赖于具有精确位姿和深度标注的数据集，这限制了方法的可扩展性与泛化能力，并往往导致导航与定位性能下降。我们提出ViBA，一种可持续学习框架，将几何优化与特征学习相结合，实现对无约束视频流的持续在线训练。该框架嵌入标准视觉里程计流程，包含一个隐式可微的几何残差框架：（一）用于帧间对应的初始跟踪网络；（二）基于深度的离群点过滤机制；（三）通过最小化重投影误差联合优化相机位姿与特征位置的可微全局束调整。通过融合束调整的几何一致性与跨帧长期时间一致性，ViBA构建出稳定且准确的特征表示。我们在EuRoC和UMA数据集上评估ViBA，相较于SuperPoint+SuperGlue、ALIKED及LightGlue等前沿方法，ViBA在连续序列中将平均绝对平移误差降低12-18%，绝对旋转误差减少5-10%，同时保持实时推理速度（每秒36-91帧）。在未见序列上的评估显示，其定位精度保持率超过90%，展现出强大的泛化能力。这些结果表明，ViBA通过几何与时间一致性支持持续在线学习，在实际场景中持续提升导航与定位性能。

title: Improving Feasibility via Fast Autoencoder-Based Projections
summary: Enforcing complex (e.g., nonconvex) operational constraints is a critical challenge in real-world learning and control systems. However, existing methods struggle to efficiently enforce general classes of constraints. To address this, we propose a novel data-driven amortized approach that uses a trained autoencoder as an approximate projector to provide fast corrections to infeasible predictions. Specifically, we train an autoencoder using an adversarial objective to learn a structured, convex latent representation of the feasible set. This enables rapid correction of neural network outputs by projecting their associated latent representations onto a simple convex shape before decoding into the original feasible set. We test our approach on a diverse suite of constrained optimization and reinforcement learning problems with challenging nonconvex constraints. Results show that our method effectively enforces constraints at a low computational cost, offering a practical alternative to expensive feasibility correction techniques based on traditional solvers.
tldr: Proposes a method using a trained autoencoder to enforce complex constraints in learning and control systems by projecting into a structured latent space, and tests it on constrained optimization and RL tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种方法，使用训练好的自编码器，通过将数据投影到结构化潜在空间，来强制执行学习和控制系统中的复杂约束，并在约束优化和强化学习任务中进行了测试。
summary_zh: 在现实世界的学习和控制系统中，强制满足复杂（如非凸）操作约束是一项关键挑战。然而，现有方法在高效强制执行一般类别约束方面存在困难。为此，我们提出一种新颖的数据驱动摊销方法，该方法利用训练好的自编码器作为近似投影器，以快速修正不可行预测。具体而言，我们使用对抗性目标训练自编码器，从而学习可行集的结构化凸潜在表示。这使得我们能够通过将神经网络输出的相关潜在表示投影到简单凸形上，再解码回原始可行集，从而快速修正这些输出。我们在具有挑战性非凸约束的多样化约束优化和强化学习问题中测试了所提方法。结果表明，我们的方法能以较低计算成本有效强制执行约束，为传统求解器依赖的昂贵可行性修正技术提供了实用替代方案。

title: SDVDiag: Using Context-Aware Causality Mining for the Diagnosis of Connected Vehicle Functions
summary: Real-world implementations of connected vehicle functions are spreading steadily, yet operating these functions reliably remains challenging due to their distributed nature and the complexity of the underlying cloud, edge, and networking infrastructure. Quick diagnosis of problems and understanding the error chains that lead to failures is essential for reducing downtime. However, diagnosing these systems is still largely performed manually, as automated analysis techniques are predominantly data-driven and struggle with hidden relationships and the integration of context information. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a multimodal approach that integrates human feedback and system-specific information into the causal analysis process. Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback is employed to continuously train a causality mining model while incorporating expert knowledge. Additional modules leverage distributed tracing data to prune false-positive causal links and enable the injection of domain-specific relationships to further refine the causal graph.Evaluation is performed using an automated valet parking application operated in a connected vehicle test field. Results demonstrate a significant increase in precision from 14\% to 100\% for the detection of causal edges and improved system interpretability compared to purely data-driven approaches, highlighting the potential for system operators in the connected vehicle domain.
tldr: This paper introduces a multimodal approach using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback to improve causality mining for diagnosing failures in connected vehicle systems, specifically tested in an automated valet parking application.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多模态方法，利用人类反馈的强化学习来改进互联车辆系统的故障诊断因果挖掘，并在自动代客泊车应用中进行测试。
summary_zh: 网联汽车功能在现实世界中的应用正稳步推广，但由于其分布式特性及底层云、边缘和网络基础设施的复杂性，确保这些功能可靠运行仍面临挑战。快速诊断问题并理解导致故障的连锁错误链对于减少停机时间至关重要。然而，当前对这些系统的诊断仍主要依赖人工操作，因为自动化分析技术大多以数据驱动为主，难以处理隐藏的关联关系并整合上下文信息。本文针对这一不足，提出了一种多模态方法，将人类反馈与系统特定信息融入因果分析过程。该方法通过基于人类反馈的强化学习持续训练因果挖掘模型，同时融入专家知识。附加模块利用分布式追踪数据剔除虚假因果关联，并支持注入特定领域关系以进一步优化因果图。研究基于网联汽车试验场中的自动代客泊车应用进行评估。结果表明，相较于纯数据驱动方法，该方法在因果边检测的精确率从14%提升至100%，同时显著增强了系统的可解释性，展现了其在网联汽车领域为系统运营商带来的巨大潜力。

title: HAD: Combining Hierarchical Diffusion with Metric-Decoupled RL for End-to-End Driving
summary: End-to-end planning has emerged as a dominant paradigm for autonomous driving, where recent models often adopt a scoring-selection framework to choose trajectories from a large set of candidates, with diffusion-based decoding showing strong promise. However, directly selecting from the entire candidate space remains difficult to optimize, and Gaussian perturbations used in diffusion often introduce unrealistic trajectories that complicate the denoising process. In addition, for training these models, reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise, but existing end-to-end RL approaches typically rely on a single coupled reward without structured signals, limiting optimization effectiveness. To address these challenges, we propose HAD, an end-to-end planning framework with a Hierarchical Diffusion Policy that decomposes planning into a coarse-to-fine process. To improve trajectory generation, we introduce Structure-Preserved Trajectory Expansion, which produces realistic candidates while maintaining kinematic structure. For policy learning, we develop Metric-Decoupled Policy Optimization (MDPO) to enable structured RL optimization across multiple driving objectives. Extensive experiments show that HAD achieves new state-of-the-art performance on both NAVSIM and HUGSIM, outperforming prior arts by a huge margin: +2.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM and +4.9 Route Completion on HUGSIM.
tldr: This paper proposes a new hierarchical diffusion model and a metric-decoupled reinforcement learning method for improving end-to-end autonomous driving planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的分层扩散模型和度量解耦强化学习方法，用于改进端到端的自动驾驶规划。
summary_zh: 端到端规划已成为自动驾驶领域的主流范式，其最新模型通常采用评分-选择框架从大量候选轨迹中筛选方案，其中基于扩散模型的解码方式展现出强大潜力。然而，直接从整个候选空间中进行选择仍难以优化，且扩散过程中使用的高斯扰动常会生成不符合运动学规律的轨迹，使去噪过程复杂化。此外在模型训练方面，强化学习虽展现出前景，但现有端到端强化学习方法通常依赖单一耦合奖励而缺乏结构化信号，限制了优化效果。为解决这些挑战，我们提出HAD——一种采用分层扩散策略的端到端规划框架，将规划过程分解为从粗到精的多级处理。为提升轨迹生成质量，我们提出结构保持型轨迹扩展方法，在保持运动学结构的同时生成符合现实的候选轨迹。在策略学习方面，我们开发了度量解耦策略优化方法，支持跨多驾驶目标的结构化强化学习优化。大量实验表明，HAD在NAVSIM和HUGSIM数据集上均实现了最新的最优性能：在NAVSIM上提升2.3 EPDMS，在HUGSIM上提升4.9%路线完成率，显著超越现有方法。

title: Decomposing Communication Gain and Delay Cost Under Cross-Timestep Delays in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Communication is essential for coordination in \emph{cooperative} multi-agent reinforcement learning under partial observability, yet \emph{cross-timestep} delays cause messages to arrive multiple timesteps after generation, inducing temporal misalignment and making information stale when consumed.
  We formalize this setting as a delayed-communication partially observable Markov game (DeComm-POMG) and decompose a message's effect into \emph{communication gain} and \emph{delay cost}, yielding the Communication Gain and Delay Cost (CGDC) metric.
  We further establish a value-loss bound showing that the degradation induced by delayed messages is upper-bounded by a discounted accumulation of an information gap between the action distributions induced by timely versus delayed messages.
  Guided by CGDC, we propose \textbf{CDCMA}, an actor--critic framework that requests messages only when predicted CGDC is positive, predicts future observations to reduce misalignment at consumption, and fuses delayed messages via CGDC-guided attention.
  Experiments on no-teammate-vision variants of Cooperative Navigation and Predator Prey, and on SMAC maps across multiple delay levels show consistent improvements in performance, robustness, and generalization, with ablations validating each component.
tldr: The paper proposes a theoretical framework and method (CDCMA) for addressing cross-timestep communication delays in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, showing improvements in standard benchmark tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个理论框架和方法（CDCMA），用于解决协作多智能体强化学习中的跨时间步通信延迟问题，在标准基准任务上展示了性能提升。
summary_zh: 在部分可观测条件下，\emph{合作式}多智能体强化学习中的通信是实现协调的关键，然而\emph{跨时间步}延迟会导致消息在生成后多个时间步才抵达，引发时间错位并使信息在接收时已过时。我们将此设定形式化为延迟通信部分可观测马尔可夫博弈（DeComm-POMG），并将消息的效应分解为\emph{通信增益}与\emph{延迟成本}，由此提出通信增益与延迟成本（CGDC）度量指标。我们进一步建立了价值损失上界，证明延迟消息引起的性能衰减受限于即时消息与延迟消息所诱导的动作分布间信息差距的折现累加上界。在CGDC指导下，我们提出\textbf{CDCMA}——一个基于行动者-评论家框架的算法，其仅在预测CGDC为正时请求消息，通过预测未来观测以降低信息接收时的错位，并采用CGDC引导的注意力机制融合延迟消息。在合作导航与捕食者-猎物场景的无队友视觉变体以及多延迟层级星际争霸作战地图上的实验表明，该方法在性能、鲁棒性和泛化能力上均取得持续提升，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。

title: VisionClaw: Always-On AI Agents through Smart Glasses
summary: We present VisionClaw, an always-on wearable AI agent that integrates live egocentric perception with agentic task execution. Running on Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses, VisionClaw continuously perceives real-world context and enables in-situ, speech-driven action initiation and delegation via OpenClaw AI agents. Therefore, users can directly execute tasks through the smart glasses, such as adding real-world objects to an Amazon cart, generating notes from physical documents, receiving meeting briefings on the go, creating events from posters, or controlling IoT devices. We evaluate VisionClaw through a controlled laboratory study (N=12) and a longitudinal deployment study (N=5). Results show that integrating perception and execution enables faster task completion and reduces interaction overhead compared to non-always-on and non-agent baselines. Beyond performance gains, deployment findings reveal a shift in interaction: tasks are initiated opportunistically during ongoing activities, and execution is increasingly delegated rather than manually controlled. These results suggest a new paradigm for wearable AI agents, where perception and action are continuously coupled to support situated, hands-free interaction.
tldr: VisionClaw is an always-on wearable AI agent on smart glasses, integrating live egocentric perception with agentic task execution for hands-free, speech-driven interaction with the physical world, such as online shopping or note-taking.
tldr_zh: VisionClaw 是一款基于智能眼镜的常开可穿戴 AI 代理，集成了实时第一人称视角感知和智能任务执行，支持通过语音驱动的免手操作与物理世界交互，例如在线购物或记事。
summary_zh: 本研究推出VisionClaw——一款全天候可穿戴AI智能体，其将实时第一视角感知与智能体任务执行相结合。该系统运行于Meta Ray-Ban智能眼镜平台，可持续感知现实场景情境，并通过OpenClaw智能体实现基于语音的现场任务启动与委托。用户可直接通过智能眼镜执行各类任务，例如将现实物品添加至亚马逊购物车、从实体文档生成笔记、移动中接收会议简报、通过海报创建活动日程或控制物联网设备。我们通过对照实验室研究（N=12）和纵向部署研究（N=5）对VisionClaw进行评估。结果显示，相较于非全天候与非智能体基线系统，感知与执行的整合能显著加快任务完成速度并降低交互开销。除性能提升外，部署研究还揭示了交互模式的转变：任务可在进行其他活动时被即时触发，且执行过程逐渐从手动控制转向委托处理。这些发现预示着可穿戴AI智能体的新范式——通过持续耦合感知与行动，为情境化免提交互提供支持。

title: DSERT-RoLL: Robust Multi-Modal Perception for Diverse Driving Conditions with Stereo Event-RGB-Thermal Cameras, 4D Radar, and Dual-LiDAR
summary: In this paper, we present DSERT-RoLL, a driving dataset that incorporates stereo event, RGB, and thermal cameras together with 4D radar and dual LiDAR, collected across diverse weather and illumination conditions. The dataset provides precise 2D and 3D bounding boxes with track IDs and ego vehicle odometry, enabling fair comparisons within and across sensor combinations. It is designed to alleviate data scarcity for novel sensors such as event cameras and 4D radar and to support systematic studies of their behavior. We establish unified 3D and 2D benchmarks that enable direct comparison of characteristics and strengths across sensor families and within each family. We report baselines for representative single modality and multimodal methods and provide protocols that encourage research on different fusion strategies and sensor combinations. In addition, we propose a fusion framework that integrates sensor specific cues into a unified feature space and improves 3D detection robustness under varied weather and lighting.
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-sensor driving dataset (DSERT-RoLL) with stereo event, RGB, thermal cameras, 4D radar, and dual LiDAR, along with benchmarks and a fusion framework for robust 3D detection in varied driving conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于自动驾驶的多传感器数据集（DSERT-RoLL），包含立体事件相机、RGB相机、热成像相机、4D雷达和双激光雷达，并建立了基准测试和融合框架，以提升在多样天气和光照条件下的3D检测鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 本文提出DSERT-RoLL驾驶数据集，该数据集融合了立体事件相机、RGB相机与热成像相机，并同步采集4D雷达与双激光雷达数据，覆盖多样化天气与光照条件。数据集提供带有追踪ID的精确2D与3D边界框及自车里程计，支持传感器组合内与跨组合的公平性能比较。本数据集旨在缓解事件相机、4D雷达等新型传感器的数据稀缺问题，并支持对其特性的系统性研究。我们建立了统一的3D与2D基准测试体系，可直接比较不同传感器家族之间及家族内部的特性与优势。我们报告了代表性单模态与多模态方法的基线性能，并设计研究协议以促进不同融合策略与传感器组合的探索。此外，我们提出一种融合框架，将传感器特异性信息整合到统一特征空间中，从而提升多天气与光照条件下的3D检测鲁棒性。

title: Automated Segmentation and Tracking of Group Housed Pigs Using Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models (FM) are reshaping computer vision by reducing reliance on task-specific supervised learning and leveraging general visual representations learned at scale. In precision livestock farming, most pipelines remain dominated by supervised learning models that require extensive labeled data, repeated retraining, and farm-specific tuning. This study presents an FM-centered workflow for automated monitoring of group-housed nursery pigs, in which pretrained vision-language FM serve as general visual backbones and farm-specific adaptation is achieved through modular post-processing. Grounding-DINO was first applied to 1,418 annotated images to establish a baseline detection performance. While detection accuracy was high under daytime conditions, performance degraded under night-vision and heavy occlusion, motivating the integration of temporal tracking logic. Building on these detections, short-term video segmentation with Grounded-SAM2 was evaluated on 550 one-minute video clips; after post-processing, over 80% of 4,927 active tracks were fully correct, with most remaining errors arising from inaccurate masks or duplicated labels. To support identity consistency over an extended time, we further developed a long-term tracking pipeline integrating initialization, tracking, matching, mask refinement, re-identification, and post-hoc quality control. This system was evaluated on a continuous 132-minute video and maintained stable identities throughout. On 132 uniformly sampled ground-truth frames, the system achieved a mean region similarity (J) of 0.83, contour accuracy (F) of 0.92, J&F of 0.87, MOTA of 0.99, and MOTP of 90.7%, with no identity switches. Overall, this work demonstrates how FM prior knowledge can be combined with lightweight, task-specific logic to enable scalable, label-efficient, and long-duration monitoring in pig production.
tldr: This paper presents a workflow using foundation models (Grounding-DINO, Grounded-SAM2) for automated segmentation and long-term tracking of group-housed pigs, demonstrating label-efficient and scalable monitoring for precision livestock farming.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种利用基础模型（Grounding-DINO, Grounded-SAM2）的工作流程，用于群养猪的自动分割和长期跟踪，展示了精准畜牧业中标签高效、可扩展的监控方法。
summary_zh: 摘要：基础模型正在重塑计算机视觉领域，通过减少对特定任务监督学习的依赖，并利用大规模学习得到的通用视觉表征。在精准畜牧业中，大多数流程仍以监督学习模型为主导，这些模型需要大量标注数据、重复训练和针对特定农场的调优。本研究提出了一种以基础模型为核心的群养保育猪自动化监测工作流程，其中预训练的视觉-语言基础模型作为通用视觉骨干，通过模块化后处理实现农场特定适应性调整。首先，在1,418张标注图像上应用Grounding-DINO建立了基线检测性能。虽然日间条件下检测精度较高，但在夜视和严重遮挡情况下性能下降，这促使我们引入时序跟踪逻辑。基于这些检测结果，我们在550段一分钟视频剪辑上评估了采用Grounded-SAM2的短期视频分割方法；经过后处理，在4,927条活动轨迹中超过80%完全正确，其余错误主要源于掩模不准确或标签重复。为实现长时间的身份一致性，我们进一步开发了集成初始化、跟踪、匹配、掩模优化、重识别和事后质量控制的长时跟踪流程。该系统在连续132分钟的视频上进行评估，全程保持了稳定的身份识别。在132个均匀采样的真实标注帧中，系统实现了0.83的平均区域相似度（J）、0.92的轮廓精度（F）、0.87的J&F综合指标、0.99的多目标跟踪准确度（MOTA）以及90.7%的多目标跟踪精度（MOTP），且未出现身份切换错误。总体而言，这项工作展示了如何将基础模型的先验知识与轻量级、任务特定逻辑相结合，从而在生猪生产过程中实现可扩展、标注高效且持久的监测。

title: Spatiotemporal-Aware Bit-Flip Injection on DNN-based Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
summary: Modern advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) rely on deep neural networks (DNNs) for perception and planning. Since DNNs' parameters reside in DRAM during inference, bit flips caused by cosmic radiation or low-voltage operation may corrupt DNN computations, distort driving decisions, and lead to real-world incidents. This paper presents a SpatioTemporal-Aware Fault Injection (STAFI) framework to locate critical fault sites in DNNs for ADAS efficiently. Spatially, we propose a Progressive Metric-guided Bit Search (PMBS) that efficiently identifies critical network weight bits whose corruption causes the largest deviations in driving behavior (e.g., unintended acceleration or steering). Furthermore, we develop a Critical Fault Time Identification (CFTI) mechanism that determines when to trigger these faults, taking into account the context of real-time systems and environmental states, to maximize the safety impact. Experiments on DNNs for a production ADAS demonstrate that STAFI uncovers 29.56x more hazard-inducing critical faults than the strongest baseline.
tldr: This paper introduces a SpatioTemporal-Aware Fault Injection (STAFI) framework to efficiently identify critical bit-flip locations and timing in DNNs for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) to assess safety hazards.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种时空感知的故障注入（STAFI）框架，用于高效识别高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）中DNN的关键位翻转位置和时机，以评估其安全风险。
summary_zh: 现代先进驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）依赖深度神经网络（DNN）进行感知与规划。由于推理过程中DNN参数存储于DRAM中，宇宙辐射或低压操作引发的比特翻转可能破坏DNN计算过程，扭曲驾驶决策，并导致现实事故。本文提出一种时空感知故障注入（STAFI）框架，用于高效定位ADAS中DNN的关键故障点。在空间维度上，我们提出渐进式度量引导比特搜索（PMBS）方法，可高效识别关键网络权重比特——这些比特的损坏会导致驾驶行为（如意外加速或转向）产生最大偏差。此外，我们开发了关键故障时间识别（CFTI）机制，结合实时系统上下文与环境状态确定触发故障的时机，以最大化安全影响。在实际ADAS的DNN实验中验证表明，STAFI发现的引发危险关键故障数量达到最强基准方法的29.56倍。

title: Super Agents and Confounders: Influence of surrounding agents on vehicle trajectory prediction
summary: In highly interactive driving scenes, trajectory prediction is conditioned on information from surrounding traffic participants such as cars and pedestrians. Our main contribution is a comprehensive analysis of state-of-the-art trajectory predictors, which reveals a surprising and critical flaw: many surrounding agents degrade prediction accuracy rather than improve it. Using Shapley-based attribution, we rigorously demonstrate that models learn unstable and non-causal decision-making schemes that vary significantly across training runs. Building on these insights, we propose to integrate a Conditional Information Bottleneck (CIB), which does not require additional supervision and is trained to effectively compress agent features as well as ignore those that are not beneficial for the prediction task. Comprehensive experiments using multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that this simple yet effective approach not only improves overall trajectory prediction performance in many cases but also increases robustness to different perturbations. Our results highlight the importance of selectively integrating contextual information, which can often contain spurious or misleading signals, in trajectory prediction. Moreover, we provide interpretable metrics for identifying non-robust behavior and present a promising avenue towards a solution.
tldr: This paper analyzes flaws in trajectory prediction models for driving, showing surrounding agents can hurt accuracy, and proposes a Conditional Information Bottleneck to improve robustness by selectively integrating context.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了自动驾驶轨迹预测模型的缺陷，指出周围智能体可能损害预测准确性，并提出条件信息瓶颈方法，通过选择性整合上下文信息来提高鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 在高度交互的驾驶场景中，轨迹预测依赖于周围交通参与者（如车辆和行人）的信息。我们的主要贡献是对当前最先进轨迹预测器进行的全面分析，揭示了一个令人惊讶且关键的问题：许多周围参与者反而会降低预测准确性而非提高它。通过基于沙普利值的归因分析，我们严格证明了这些模型学习了不稳定且非因果的决策机制，这些机制在不同训练轮次中存在显著差异。基于这些发现，我们提出集成条件信息瓶颈（CIB）的方法，该方法无需额外监督，通过训练有效压缩智能体特征并忽略那些对预测任务无益的特征。使用多个数据集和模型架构的综合实验表明，这种简单而有效的方法不仅在许多情况下提升了整体轨迹预测性能，还增强了对不同扰动的鲁棒性。我们的研究结果强调了在轨迹预测中有选择地整合上下文信息的重要性，因为这些信息往往包含虚假或误导性信号。此外，我们提供了可解释的指标来识别非鲁棒性行为，并提出了一个具有潜力的解决方向。

title: SpectralSplat: Appearance-Disentangled Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods have achieved impressive reconstruction quality for autonomous driving scenes, yet they entangle scene geometry with transient appearance properties such as lighting, weather, and time of day. This coupling prevents relighting, appearance transfer, and consistent rendering across multi-traversal data captured under varying environmental conditions. We present SpectralSplat, a method that disentangles appearance from geometry within a feed-forward Gaussian Splatting framework. Our key insight is to factor color prediction into an appearance-agnostic base stream and and appearance-conditioned adapted stream, both produced by a shared MLP conditioned on a global appearance embedding derived from DINOv2 features. To enforce disentanglement, we train with paired observations generated by a hybrid relighting pipeline that combines physics-based intrinsic decomposition with diffusion based generative refinement, and supervise with complementary consistency, reconstruction, cross-appearance, and base color losses. We further introduce an appearance-adaptable temporal history that stores appearance-agnostic features, enabling accumulated Gaussians to be re-rendered under arbitrary target appearances. Experiments demonstrate that SpectralSplat preserves the reconstruction quality of the underlying backbone while enabling controllable appearance transfer and temporally consistent relighting across driving sequences.
tldr: A method for disentangling appearance from geometry in 3D Gaussian Splatting for driving scenes, enabling tasks like relighting and appearance transfer, but not directly applied to robotics.
tldr_zh: 一种用于自动驾驶场景3D高斯泼溅的方法，将外观与几何解耦，实现重光照和外观转移，但未直接应用于机器人技术。
summary_zh: 前馈式3D高斯泼溅方法在自动驾驶场景重建中已取得令人瞩目的质量，但该方法将场景几何结构与光照、天气、时间等瞬态外观属性相互耦合。这种耦合阻碍了重光照、外观迁移以及在不同环境条件下采集的多轨迹数据间的连贯渲染。我们提出SpectralSplat方法，在前馈式高斯泼溅框架内实现外观与几何结构的解耦。核心思路是将色彩预测分解为与外观无关的基础流和受外观调节的适配流，二者均由共享MLP生成，该MLP以从DINOv2特征提取的全局外观嵌入为条件。为实现解耦，我们采用混合重光照流程生成的配对观测数据进行训练——该流程结合了基于物理的固有分解与基于扩散模型的生成式优化，并通过互补的一致性损失、重建损失、跨外观损失和基础色彩损失进行监督。此外，我们引入可适应外观的时序历史机制，用于存储与外观无关的特征，使得累积的高斯单元能够在任意目标外观下重新渲染。实验表明，SpectralSplat在保持底层骨干网络重建质量的同时，能够实现可控的外观迁移与跨行驶序列的时序一致重光照。

title: Surrogate Model-Based Near-Optimal Gain Selection for Approach-Angle-Constrained Two-Phase Pure Proportional Navigation
summary: In guidance literature, Pure Proportional Navigation (PPN) guidance is widely used for aerodynamically driven vehicles. A two-phase extension of PPN (2pPPN), which uses different navigation gains for an orientation phase and a final phase, has been presented to achieve any desired approach angle within an angular half-space. Recent studies show that the orientation phase can be realized through multiple feasible trajectories, creating an opportunity to select navigation gains that minimize overall guidance effort. This paper addresses the problem of near-optimal gain selection for given initial and desired terminal engagement geometries. Two optimization problems are considered: i) determination of the optimal orientation-phase gain for a specified final-phase gain, and ii) simultaneously determining the optimal gain pair for both phases that minimizes the total guidance effort. Determining the optimal gains analytically for arbitrary engagement geometries is intractable. Numerical simulations further reveal that these optimal gains vary smoothly with respect to the engagement conditions. Exploiting this property, a neural network (NN)-based regression model is developed in this paper to learn the nonlinear mapping between optimal gains and initial and desired terminal engagement geometries. The trained NN serves as a computationally efficient surrogate for generating the optimal gains manifold, enabling near-optimal realization of 2pPPN guidance. Numerical simulation studies demonstrate that the developed NN-based architecture predicts optimal gains with high accuracy, achieving very high (close to 0.9) value of coefficient of determination.
tldr: This paper proposes a neural network surrogate model to learn the optimal navigation gains for a two-phase missile guidance law, enabling near-optimal control effort for specified engagement geometries.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的代理模型，用于学习两阶段导弹制导律的最优导航增益，以实现特定交战几何下的近最优控制效果。
summary_zh: 在制导文献中，纯比例导航（PPN）制导被广泛应用于空气动力驱动的飞行器。为实现角半空间内任意期望的接近角，学者们提出了采用不同导航增益的双阶段扩展PPN（2pPPN）方法，分别为定向阶段和最终阶段。最新研究表明，定向阶段可通过多种可行轨迹实现，这为选择最小化总体制导效能的导航增益提供了可能。本文针对给定初始及期望终端交战几何下的近最优增益选择问题展开研究。考虑两类优化问题：i) 在指定最终阶段增益下确定最优定向阶段增益；ii) 同步确定两阶段最优增益组合以最小化总体制导效能。针对任意交战几何解析求解最优增益具有较高难度。数值仿真进一步揭示这些最优增益随交战条件呈现平滑变化特性。本文利用这一特性，建立了基于神经网络（NN）的回归模型，以学习最优增益与初始及期望终端交战几何之间的非线性映射关系。训练完成的神经网络作为计算高效的替代模型，可生成最优增益流形，从而实现2pPPN制导的近最优控制。数值仿真研究表明，所构建的神经网络架构能够高精度预测最优增益，其决定系数达到极高水平（接近0.9）。

title: k-Maximum Inner Product Attention for Graph Transformers and the Expressive Power of GraphGPS The Expressive Power of GraphGPS
summary: Graph transformers have shown promise in overcoming limitations of traditional graph neural networks, such as oversquashing and difficulties in modelling long-range dependencies. However, their application to large-scale graphs is hindered by the quadratic memory and computational complexity of the all-to-all attention mechanism. Although alternatives such as linearized attention and restricted attention patterns have been proposed, these often degrade performance or limit expressive power. To better balance efficiency and effectiveness, we introduce k-Maximum Inner Product (k-MIP) attention for graph transformers. k-MIP attention selects the most relevant key nodes per query via a top-k operation, yielding a sparse yet flexible attention pattern. Combined with an attention score computation based on symbolic matrices, this results in linear memory complexity and practical speedups of up to an order of magnitude compared to all-to-all attention, enabling the processing of graphs with over 500k nodes on a single A100 GPU. We provide a theoretical analysis of expressive power, showing that k-MIP attention does not compromise the expressiveness of graph transformers: specifically, we prove that k-MIP transformers can approximate any full-attention transformer to arbitrary precision. In addition, we analyze the expressive power of the GraphGPS framework, in which we integrate our attention mechanism, and establish an upper bound on its graph distinguishing capability in terms of the S-SEG-WL test. Finally, we validate our approach on the Long Range Graph Benchmark, the City-Networks benchmark, and two custom large-scale inductive point cloud datasets, consistently ranking among the top-performing scalable graph transformers.
tldr: This paper introduces a k-Maximum Inner Product attention mechanism for graph transformers, improving efficiency and theoretical expressiveness for large-scale graph tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于图变换器的k最大内积注意力机制，提高了大规模图处理任务的效率和理论表达能力。
