summary_zh: 形式化规约生成作为一种无需人工注解即可提升程序正确性的方法，近期在软件工程领域受到关注。大语言模型在该领域展现出潜力，但早期研究结果揭示其存在若干局限性。由于语法错误、逻辑不准确或不完备的推理，生成的规约常无法通过验证，这在包含循环或分支逻辑的程序中尤为明显。SpecGen 和 FormalBench 等技术试图通过提示工程与基准测试应对这些问题，但它们通常依赖静态提示，且缺乏从失败中恢复或适应不同程序结构的机制。本文提出 AutoReSpec，一种结合开源与闭源大语言模型的协作框架，用于生成可验证的形式化规约。AutoReSpec 根据输入程序的结构动态选择大语言模型对及提示配置。若主模型未能生成有效输出，则调用协作模型，利用验证器反馈对规约进行优化和修正。这种两阶段设计兼顾了速度与鲁棒性。我们在包含 72 个真实场景与合成 Java 程序的新基准测试中评估 AutoReSpec，结果显示其成功通过 67 项测试，在成功概率与完整性指标上均优于 SpecGen 和 FormalBench。实验评估中，AutoReSpec 取得了 58.2% 的成功概率与 69.2% 的完整性得分，同时相较于现有方法平均减少 26.89% 的评估时间。这些结果共同表明，AutoReSpec 为大语言模型驱动的形式化规约生成提供了一种可扩展、高效且可靠的方法。

title: Can Humans Tell? A Dual-Axis Study of Human Perception of LLM-Generated News
summary: Can humans tell whether a news article was written by a person or a large language model (LLM)? We investigate this question using JudgeGPT, a study platform that independently measures source attribution (human vs. machine) and authenticity judgment (legitimate vs. fake) on continuous scales. From 2,318 judgments collected from 1,054 participants across content generated by six LLMs, we report five findings: (1) participants cannot reliably distinguish machine-generated from human-written text (p > .05, Welch's t-test); (2) this inability holds across all tested models, including open-weight models with as few as 7B parameters; (3) self-reported domain expertise predicts judgment accuracy (r = .35, p < .001) whereas political orientation does not (r = -.10, n.s.); (4) clustering reveals distinct response strategies ("Skeptics" vs. "Believers"); and (5) accuracy degrades after approximately 30 sequential evaluations due to cognitive fatigue. The answer, in short, is no: humans cannot reliably tell. These results indicate that user-side detection is not a viable defense and motivate system-level countermeasures such as cryptographic content provenance.
tldr: A study finds humans cannot reliably distinguish between human-written and LLM-generated news articles, even across various model sizes, highlighting the need for system-level countermeasures like cryptographic content provenance.
tldr_zh: 研究表明，人类无法可靠地区分人类撰写和LLM生成的新闻文章，即使面对不同规模的模型，这凸显了需要如加密内容溯源等系统级对策的必要性。
summary_zh: 人类能否辨别一篇新闻文章是由人撰写还是由大型语言模型（LLM）生成？我们通过JudgeGPT研究平台探讨了这一问题，该平台能够独立在连续尺度上测量来源归因（人类 vs. 机器）和真实性判断（真实 vs. 虚假）。基于来自1,054名参与者对六种LLM生成内容的2,318条判断数据，我们得出五项发现：（1）参与者无法可靠区分机器生成文本与人类撰写文本（p > 0.05，韦尔奇t检验）；（2）这种判断局限在所有测试模型中均成立，包括参数量仅70亿的开源模型；（3）自报领域专业知识可预测判断准确率（r = 0.35, p < 0.001），而政治倾向无显著影响（r = -0.10，不显著）；（4）聚类分析揭示出两种截然不同的应对策略（“怀疑者”与“轻信者”）；（5）连续评估约30次后因认知疲劳导致准确率下降。简言之，答案是否定的：人类无法可靠辨别。这些结果表明用户端检测并非有效防御手段，进而凸显了系统级对策（如加密内容溯源）的必要性。

title: Testing the Limits of Truth Directions in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to encode truth of statements in their activation space along a linear truth direction. Previous studies have argued that these directions are universal in certain aspects, while more recent work has questioned this conclusion drawing on limited generalization across some settings. In this work, we identify a number of limits of truth-direction universality that have not been previously understood. We first show that truth directions are highly layer-dependent, and that a full understanding of universality requires probing at many layers in the model. We then show that truth directions depend heavily on task type, emerging in earlier layers for factual and later layers for reasoning tasks; they also vary in performance across levels of task complexity. Finally, we show that model instructions dramatically affect truth directions; simple correctness evaluation instructions significantly affect the generalization ability of truth probes. Our findings indicate that universality claims for truth directions are more limited than previously known, with significant differences observable for various model layers, task difficulties, task types, and prompt templates.
tldr: This paper investigates the limits of universality for 'truth directions' in LLMs, showing they are highly dependent on model layer, task type, complexity, and instructions, challenging prior generalization claims.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型中‘真实方向’普遍性的局限，发现其对模型层、任务类型、复杂度和指令高度敏感，挑战了先前的泛化结论。
summary_zh: 已有研究表明，大型语言模型在其激活空间中沿线性真实方向编码了陈述的真实性。先前研究认为这些方向在某些方面具有普适性，而近期工作基于某些场景下有限的泛化能力对这一结论提出了质疑。本研究揭示了此前未被充分认识的真实方向普适性若干局限。首先，我们发现真实方向具有高度层级依赖性，要全面理解其普适性需对模型多个层级进行探测。其次，真实方向在很大程度上受任务类型影响：在事实性任务中较早层级出现，在推理任务中则较晚层级出现；其表现也随任务复杂度变化而波动。最后，我们证明模型指令会显著影响真实方向：简单的正确性评估指令即可显著改变真实探测器的泛化能力。这些发现表明，真实方向的普适性比既往认知更为有限，在不同模型层级、任务难度、任务类型及提示模板中均可观察到显著差异。

title: Structured Multi-Criteria Evaluation of Large Language Models with Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process and DualJudge
summary: Effective evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical bottleneck, as conventional direct scoring often yields inconsistent and opaque judgments. In this work, we adapt the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to LLM-based evaluation and, more importantly, propose a confidence-aware Fuzzy AHP (FAHP) extension that models epistemic uncertainty via triangular fuzzy numbers modulated by LLM-generated confidence scores. Systematically validated on JudgeBench, our structured approach decomposes assessments into explicit criteria and incorporates uncertainty-aware aggregation, producing more calibrated judgments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that both crisp and fuzzy AHP consistently outperform direct scoring across model scales and dataset splits, with FAHP showing superior stability in uncertain comparison scenarios. Building on these insights, we propose \textbf{DualJudge}, a hybrid framework inspired by Dual-Process Theory that adaptively fuses holistic direct scores with structured AHP outputs via consistency-aware weighting. DualJudge achieves state-of-the-art performance, underscoring the complementary strengths of intuitive and deliberative evaluation paradigms. These results establish uncertainty-aware structured reasoning as a principled pathway toward more reliable LLM assessment. Code is available at https://github.com/hreyulog/AHP_llm_judge.
tldr: This paper proposes a structured evaluation method using Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process and a hybrid DualJudge framework to improve the reliability and consistency of LLM-based assessments, validated on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模糊层次分析法的结构化评估方法及DualJudge混合框架，旨在提高LLM评估的可靠性和一致性，并在标准基准上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLM）的有效评估仍然是关键瓶颈，因为传统的直接评分往往产生不一致且不透明的判断。本研究将层次分析法（AHP）适配于基于LLM的评估，并进一步提出一种置信感知的模糊层次分析法（FAHP）扩展——该方法通过LLM生成的置信度分数调制三角模糊数来建模认知不确定性。在JudgeBench上的系统性验证表明，我们的结构化方法将评估分解为明确标准，并融入不确定性感知的聚合机制，从而产生更校准的判断。大量实验证明，无论是经典AHP还是模糊AHP，在不同模型规模和数据集划分下均持续优于直接评分，其中FAHP在不确定比较场景中表现出更强的稳定性。基于这些发现，我们提出**DualJudge**混合框架——该框架受双过程理论启发，通过一致性感知加权机制，将整体直接评分与结构化AHP输出进行自适应融合。DualJudge实现了最先进的性能，印证了直觉式与审慎式评估范式的互补优势。这些研究结果确立了不确定性感知结构化推理作为实现更可靠LLM评估的原则性路径。代码已开源：https://github.com/hreyulog/AHP_llm_judge。

title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
summary: Sequential Recommendation (SR) learns user preferences from their historical interaction sequences and provides personalized suggestions. In real-world scenarios, most items exhibit sparse interactions, known as the tail-item problem. This issue limits the model's ability to accurately capture item transition patterns. To tackle this, large language models (LLMs) offer a promising solution by capturing semantic relationships between items. Despite previous efforts to leverage LLM-derived embeddings for enriching tail items, they still face the following limitations: 1) They struggle to effectively fuse collaborative signals with semantic knowledge, leading to suboptimal item embedding quality. 2) Existing methods overlook the structural inconsistency between the ID and LLM embedding spaces, causing conflicting signals that degrade recommendation accuracy. In this work, we propose a Fusion and Alignment Enhancement framework with LLMs for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation (FAERec), which improves item representations by generating coherently-fused and structurally consistent embeddings. For the information fusion challenge, we design an adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically fuses ID and LLM embeddings. Then, we propose a dual-level alignment approach to mitigate structural inconsistency. The item-level alignment establishes correspondences between ID and LLM embeddings of the same item through contrastive learning, while the feature-level alignment constrains the correlation patterns between corresponding dimensions across the two embedding spaces. Furthermore, the weights of the two alignments are adjusted by a curriculum learning scheduler to avoid premature optimization of the complex feature-level objective. Extensive experiments across three widely used datasets with multiple representative SR backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework (FAERec) that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve sequential recommendation systems, specifically for items with sparse interactions, by fusing ID-based and semantic embeddings and aligning their structures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种融合大型语言模型（LLMs）的框架（FAERec），通过融合ID和语义嵌入并调整其结构，来解决推荐系统中稀疏交互物品的序列推荐问题。
summary_zh: 序贯推荐（SR）通过用户历史交互序列学习其偏好，并提供个性化推荐。在实际场景中，大多数商品存在交互稀疏问题，即尾项问题。该问题限制了模型准确捕捉商品转移模式的能力。为解决此问题，大语言模型（LLM）通过捕获商品间语义关系提供了可行方案。尽管已有研究尝试利用LLM生成的嵌入向量增强尾项表征，但仍面临以下局限：1）难以有效融合协同信号与语义知识，导致商品嵌入质量欠佳；2）现有方法忽略了ID嵌入空间与LLM嵌入空间之间的结构不一致性，导致信号冲突而降低推荐精度。为此，本文提出一种面向尾项序贯推荐的融合与对齐增强框架（FAERec），通过生成融合一致且结构对齐的嵌入向量来优化商品表征。针对信息融合挑战，我们设计了自适应门控机制，动态融合ID嵌入与LLM嵌入。随后提出双层次对齐方法以缓解结构不一致问题：在商品层面通过对比学习建立同一商品ID嵌入与LLM嵌入的对应关系；在特征层面约束两个嵌入空间对应维度间的相关性模式。此外，通过课程学习调度器动态调整两个对齐目标的权重，避免复杂特征层目标过早优化。在三个广泛使用的数据集上，结合多种代表性SR骨干模型的实验结果表明，本框架具有显著的有效性与泛化能力。

title: Unlocking Prompt Infilling Capability for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) generate text through bidirectional denoising, yet this capability remains locked for infilling prompts. This limitation is an artifact of the current supervised finetuning (SFT) convention of applying response-only masking. To unlock this capability, we extend full-sequence masking during SFT, where both prompts and responses are masked jointly. Once unlocked, the model infills masked portions of a prompt template conditioned on few-shot examples. We show that such model-infilled prompts match or surpass manually designed templates, transfer effectively across models, and are complementary to existing prompt optimization methods. Our results suggest that training practices, not architectural limitations, are the primary bottleneck preventing masked diffusion language models from infilling effective prompts
tldr: The paper proposes a training method to enable masked diffusion language models to infill prompts, showing that model-infilled prompts can match or surpass manually designed templates and transfer across models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种训练方法，使掩码扩散语言模型具备提示填充能力，证明模型填充的提示可媲美或超越人工设计模板，并能跨模型有效迁移。
summary_zh: 掩蔽扩散语言模型通过双向去噪生成文本，然而其填充提示的功能尚未得到充分开发。这一限制源于当前监督式微调中仅对响应部分进行掩蔽的常规做法。为解锁此功能，我们在微调过程中扩展了全序列掩蔽策略，即同时对提示和响应内容进行联合掩蔽。实现功能解锁后，该模型能够基于少量示例填充提示模板中被掩蔽的部分。研究表明，这种由模型填充的提示在效果上达到甚至超越了人工设计的模板，具备良好的跨模型迁移能力，并与现有提示优化方法形成有效互补。我们的结果表明，阻碍掩蔽扩散语言模型生成有效提示的主要瓶颈在于训练方法，而非架构本身的限制。

title: AI Appeals Processor: A Deep Learning Approach to Automated Classification of Citizen Appeals in Government Services
summary: Government agencies worldwide face growing volumes of citizen appeals, with electronic submissions increasing significantly over recent years. Traditional manual processing averages 20 minutes per appeal with only 67% classification accuracy, creating significant bottlenecks in public service delivery. This paper presents AI Appeals Processor, a microservice-based system that integrates natural language processing and deep learning techniques for automated classification and routing of citizen appeals. We evaluate multiple approaches -- including Bag-of-Words with SVM, TF-IDF with SVM, fastText, Word2Vec with LSTM, and BERT -- on a representative dataset of 10,000 real citizen appeals across three primary categories (complaints, applications, and proposals) and seven thematic domains. Our experiments demonstrate that a Word2Vec+LSTM architecture achieves 78% classification accuracy while reducing processing time by 54%, offering an optimal balance between accuracy and computational efficiency compared to transformer-based models.
tldr: A deep learning system for automated classification of citizen appeals in government services using NLP techniques, achieving 78% accuracy with a Word2Vec+LSTM model.
tldr_zh: 一个用于政府服务中公民申诉自动分类的深度学习系统，采用自然语言处理技术，Word2Vec+LSTM模型达到78%的分类准确率。
summary_zh: 全球政府机构面临着日益增长的公民诉求处理量，近年电子化提交量显著上升。传统人工处理方式平均每项诉求需耗时20分钟且分类准确率仅为67%，对公共服务供给形成了显著瓶颈。本文提出AI诉求处理系统，这是一个基于微服务架构的集成自然语言处理与深度学习技术的自动化公民诉求分类路由系统。我们在涵盖三大类别（投诉、申请、建议）和七个主题领域的10,000条真实公民诉求数据集上，评估了多种技术方案——包括词袋模型+SVM、TF-IDF+SVM、fastText、Word2Vec+LSTM以及BERT模型。实验结果表明，基于Word2Vec+LSTM的架构在分类准确率达到78%的同时，将处理时间缩短了54%，与基于Transformer的模型相比，在准确率与计算效率之间实现了最佳平衡。

title: TableVision: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Spatially Grounded Reasoning over Complex Hierarchical Tables
summary: Structured tables are essential for conveying high-density information in professional domains such as finance, healthcare, and scientific research. Despite the progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), reasoning performance remains limited for complex tables with hierarchical layouts. In this paper, we identify a critical Perception Bottleneck through quantitative analysis. We find that as task complexity scales, the number of involved discrete visual regions increases disproportionately. This processing density leads to an internal "Perceptual Overload," where MLLMs struggle to maintain accurate spatial attention during implicit generation. To address this bottleneck, we introduce TableVision, a large-scale, trajectory-aware benchmark designed for spatially grounded reasoning. TableVision stratifies tabular tasks into three cognitive levels (Perception, Reasoning, and Analysis) across 13 sub-categories. By utilizing a rendering-based deterministic grounding pipeline, the dataset explicitly couples multi-step logical deductions with pixel-perfect spatial ground truths, comprising 6,799 high-fidelity reasoning trajectories. Our empirical results, supported by diagnostic probing, demonstrate that explicit spatial constraints significantly recover the reasoning potential of MLLMs. Furthermore, our two-stage decoupled framework achieves a robust 12.3% overall accuracy improvement on the test set. TableVision provides a rigorous testbed and a fresh perspective on the synergy between perception and logic in document understanding.
tldr: This paper presents TableVision, a benchmark for evaluating spatially grounded reasoning over complex hierarchical tables using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It diagnoses a 'Perceptual Overload' bottleneck and proposes a decoupled framework to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TableVision，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在复杂层次化表格上进行空间推理的基准。它诊断出'感知过载'瓶颈，并提出了一个解耦框架以提高性能。
summary_zh: 结构化表格对于金融、医疗和科研等专业领域传递高密度信息至关重要。尽管多模态大语言模型取得了进展，但在处理具有层次布局的复杂表格时，其推理性能仍存在局限。本文通过定量分析揭示了一个关键感知瓶颈：随着任务复杂度提升，涉及的离散视觉区域数量呈非均衡增长，这种处理密度会导致模型内部产生"感知过载"，使其在隐式生成过程中难以维持准确的空间注意力。为突破此瓶颈，我们提出了TableVision——一个面向空间锚定推理的大规模轨迹感知基准。TableVision将表格任务按认知层次划分为感知、推理与分析三个维度，覆盖13个子类别。通过基于渲染的确定性锚定流程，该数据集将多步逻辑推导与像素级空间真值显式关联，共包含6,799条高保真推理轨迹。实验结果表明，显式空间约束能显著恢复多模态大语言模型的推理潜力。此外，我们的两阶段解耦框架在测试集上实现了12.3%的总体准确率提升。TableVision为文档理解中感知与逻辑的协同研究提供了严谨的测试基准与全新视角。

title: Beyond Retrieval: Modeling Confidence Decay and Deterministic Agentic Platforms in Generative Engine Optimization
summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is rapidly reshaping digital marketing paradigms in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, current GEO strategies predominantly rely on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which inherently suffers from probabilistic hallucinations and the "zero-click" paradox, failing to establish sustainable commercial trust. In this paper, we systematically deconstruct the probabilistic flaws of existing RAG-based GEO and propose a paradigm shift towards deterministic multi-agent intent routing. First, we mathematically formulate Semantic Entropy Drift (SED) to model the dynamic decay of confidence curves in LLMs over continuous temporal and contextual perturbations. To rigorously quantify optimization value in black-box commercial engines, we introduce the Isomorphic Attribution Regression (IAR) model, leveraging a Multi-Agent System (MAS) probe with strict human-in-the-loop physical isolation to enforce hallucination penalties. Furthermore, we architect the Deterministic Agent Handoff (DAH) protocol, conceptualizing an Agentic Trust Brokerage (ATB) ecosystem where LLMs function solely as intent routers rather than final answer generators. We empirically validate this architecture using EasyNote, an industrial AI meeting minutes product by Yishu Technology. By routing the intent of "knowledge graph mapping on an infinite canvas" directly to its specialized proprietary agent via DAH, we demonstrate the reduction of vertical task hallucination rates to near zero. This work establishes a foundational theoretical framework for next-generation GEO and paves the way for a well-ordered, deterministic human-AI collaboration ecosystem.
tldr: The paper proposes a deterministic multi-agent framework, termed Deterministic Agent Handoff (DAH), to replace probabilistic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), aiming to reduce AI hallucinations and improve trust in commercial applications like AI meeting minutes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个确定性的多智能体框架，称为确定性智能体移交协议（DAH），以取代生成引擎优化（GEO）中概率性的检索增强生成（RAG），旨在减少AI幻觉并提升在AI会议纪要等商业应用中的可信度。
summary_zh: 生成式引擎优化（GEO）正迅速重塑大型语言模型（LLM）时代的数字营销范式。然而，当前GEO策略主要依赖检索增强生成（RAG），其本质上存在概率性幻觉与“零点击”悖论，难以建立可持续的商业信任。本文系统解构了现有基于RAG的GEO的概率性缺陷，并提出向确定性多智能体意图路由的范式转变。首先，我们通过数学形式化语义熵漂移（SED）模型，以描述LLM在连续时空与语境扰动下置信度曲线的动态衰减。为严格量化黑盒商业引擎的优化价值，我们引入同构归因回归（IAR）模型，利用具有严格人在回路物理隔离机制的多智能体系统（MAS）探针实施幻觉惩罚。进一步，我们设计了确定性智能体交接（DAH）协议，构建了智能体信任经纪（ATB）生态系统框架，其中LLM仅作为意图路由器而非最终答案生成器。我们基于易数科技旗下的工业级AI会议纪要产品EasyNote进行了实证验证：通过DAH将“无限画布上的知识图谱映射”意图直接路由至其专用私有智能体，成功将垂直任务幻觉率降至近乎零值。本研究为下一代GEO奠定了基础理论框架，并为构建有序、确定性的人机协作生态系统开辟了路径。

title: Stabilizing Unsupervised Self-Evolution of MLLMs via Continuous Softened Retracing reSampling
summary: In the unsupervised self-evolution of Multimodal Large Language Models, the quality of feedback signals during post-training is pivotal for stable and effective learning. However, existing self-evolution methods predominantly rely on majority voting to select the most frequent output as the pseudo-golden answer, which may stem from the model's intrinsic biases rather than guaranteeing the objective correctness of the reasoning paths. To counteract the degradation, we propose \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{S}oftened \textbf{R}etracing re\textbf{S}ampling (\textbf{CSRS}) in MLLM self-evolution. Specifically, we introduce a Retracing Re-inference Mechanism (\textbf{RRM}) that the model re-inferences from anchor points to expand the exploration of long-tail reasoning paths. Simultaneously, we propose Softened Frequency Reward (\textbf{SFR}), which replaces binary rewards with continuous signals, calibrating reward based on the answers' frequency across sampled reasoning sets. Furthermore, incorporated with Visual Semantic Perturbation (\textbf{VSP}), CSRS ensures the model prioritizes mathematical logic over visual superficiality. Experimental results demonstrate that CSRS significantly enhances the reasoning performance of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on benchmarks such as MathVision. We achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in unsupervised self-evolution on geometric tasks. Our code is avaible at https://github.com/yyy195/CSRS.
tldr: This paper proposes a method (CSRS) to improve the stability and performance of unsupervised self-evolution in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for mathematical reasoning tasks, with a focus on avoiding bias in pseudo-label selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法（CSRS），通过连续软化重采样机制，旨在提高多模态大语言模型在数学推理任务中无监督自我进化的稳定性和性能，避免多数投票带来的偏差。
summary_zh: 在多模态大语言模型的无监督自演进过程中，训练后期反馈信号的质量对于实现稳定且有效的学习至关重要。然而，现有的自演进方法主要依赖多数投票机制，将出现频率最高的输出作为伪黄金答案，这可能导致模型固有偏见占主导，而无法保证推理路径的客观正确性。为防止性能退化，我们在MLLM自演进中提出**连续软化回溯重采样方法**（CSRS）。具体而言，我们引入**回溯重推理机制**（RRM），使模型从锚点重新推理，以扩展对长尾推理路径的探索。同时，我们提出**软化频率奖励**（SFR），用连续信号替代二元奖励，并根据采样推理集中答案的出现频率进行奖励校准。此外，结合**视觉语义扰动**（VSP），CSRS确保模型更关注数学逻辑而非视觉表象。实验结果表明，CSRS显著提升了Qwen2.5-VL-7B在MathVision等基准测试中的推理性能。我们在几何任务的无监督自演进中取得了最先进的成果。相关代码已在https://github.com/yyy195/CSRS开源。

title: Persistent Cross-Attempt State Optimization for Repository-Level Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in repository-level code generation. However, solving the same repository-level task often requires multiple attempts, while existing methods still optimize each attempt in isolation and do not preserve or reuse task-specific state across attempts. In this paper, we propose LiveCoder, a novel framework for repository-level code generation based on cross-attempt knowledge optimization. LiveCoder maintains persistent task-specific state from prior attempts to guide subsequent generation. This state includes success knowledge, which captures reusable signals from previously strong repositories, failure knowledge, which records unsuccessful outcomes and their diagnostic signals, and a historical-best repository, which preserves the strongest result found so far and prevents regression. These components collectively transform repeated repository generation into a persistent, knowledge-driven optimization process. We evaluate LiveCoder using four frontier LLMs on two representative repository-level code generation benchmarks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LiveCoder, improving the functional score by up to 22.94 percentage points, increasing repository reuse to 81.58%, and reducing cost by up to 53.63% on RAL-Bench while maintaining broadly stable non-functional quality.
tldr: This paper introduces LiveCoder, a framework for repository-level code generation that persistently optimizes knowledge across multiple generation attempts, improving functional scores, reuse, and reducing costs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LiveCoder框架，用于仓库级代码生成，通过跨尝试知识优化持续提升生成效果，提高了功能分数、代码重用率，并降低了成本。
summary_zh: 大语言模型在仓库级代码生成领域已取得显著进展。然而，解决同一仓库级任务通常需要多次尝试，而现有方法仍孤立地优化每次尝试，未能跨尝试保存或复用任务特定状态。本文提出LiveCoder——一种基于跨尝试知识优化的新型仓库级代码生成框架。LiveCoder能够维护从先前尝试中积累的持久性任务特定状态，以指导后续生成过程。该状态包含三方面核心内容：成功知识——捕获先前高质量仓库中可复用的信号；失败知识——记录未成功的结果及其诊断信号；历史最佳仓库——保留当前发现的最优结果以防止性能回退。这些组件共同将重复的仓库生成过程转化为持续的、知识驱动的优化流程。我们在两个代表性仓库级代码生成基准测试中，使用四种前沿大语言模型对LiveCoder进行评估。大量实验结果表明，LiveCoder在保证非功能性质量总体稳定的前提下，能够将功能评分最高提升22.94个百分点，将仓库复用率提高至81.58%，并在RAL-Bench基准上实现高达53.63%的成本降低，充分验证了其有效性与高效性。

title: Neural Global Optimization via Iterative Refinement from Noisy Samples
summary: Global optimization of black-box functions from noisy samples is a fundamental challenge in machine learning and scientific computing. Traditional methods such as Bayesian Optimization often converge to local minima on multi-modal functions, while gradient-free methods require many function evaluations. We present a novel neural approach that learns to find global minima through iterative refinement. Our model takes noisy function samples and their fitted spline representation as input, then iteratively refines an initial guess toward the true global minimum. Trained on randomly generated functions with ground truth global minima obtained via exhaustive search, our method achieves a mean error of 8.05 percent on challenging multi-modal test functions, compared to 36.24 percent for the spline initialization, a 28.18 percent improvement. The model successfully finds global minima in 72 percent of test cases with error below 10 percent, demonstrating learned optimization principles rather than mere curve fitting. Our architecture combines encoding of multiple modalities including function values, derivatives, and spline coefficients with iterative position updates, enabling robust global optimization without requiring derivative information or multiple restarts.
tldr: A neural method for global optimization of black-box functions from noisy samples using iterative refinement, trained on synthetic multi-modal functions and outperforming spline initialization.
tldr_zh: 一种用于从噪声样本中全局优化黑盒函数的神经方法，通过迭代细化实现，在合成多模态函数上训练，性能优于样条初始化方法。
summary_zh: 从含噪样本中进行黑箱函数的全局优化是机器学习和科学计算领域的核心挑战。传统方法如贝叶斯优化在多模态函数上常收敛于局部极小值，而无梯度方法则需要大量函数评估。我们提出一种新颖的神经网络方法，通过迭代修正学习寻找全局最小值。该模型以含噪函数样本及其拟合样条表示为输入，通过迭代将初始猜测逐步修正至真实全局最小值。基于随机生成函数（其全局最小值通过穷举搜索获得）训练后，该方法在具有挑战性的多模态测试函数上平均误差为8.05%，较样条初始化的36.24%误差实现了28.18%的改进。在72%的测试案例中，模型能以低于10%的误差成功找到全局最小值，表明其学习到的是优化原理而非单纯的曲线拟合。我们的架构融合了函数值、导数和样条系数等多模态编码与迭代位置更新机制，无需导数信息或多重重启即可实现鲁棒的全局优化。

title: Entropy and Attention Dynamics in Small Language Models: A Trace-Level Structural Analysis on the TruthfulQA Benchmark
summary: Small language models (SLMs) have been increasingly deployed in edge devices and other resource-constrained settings. However, these models make confident mispredictions and produce unstable output, making them risky for factual and decision-critical tasks. Current evaluation methodology relies on final accuracy or hallucination rates without explaining how internal model behavior affects outputs. Specifically, how entropy evolves during decoding, how attention is distributed across layers, and how hidden representations contribute to uncertainty, logical inconsistencies, and misinformation propagation are often overlooked. Consequently, this study introduces a trace-level analysis of entropy and attention dynamics in SLMs evaluated with the TruthfulQA dataset. Four models with parameter ranges of 1B-1.7B parameters were examined via token-level output entropy, attention entropy, head dispersion, and hidden-state representation. The results reflect three model classifications by entropy patterns. Deterministic models (DeepSeek-1.5B and LLaMA-1B): output entropy decreases over time. Exploratory models (Gemma-1B): with increasing entropy, and balanced models (Qwen-1.7B): have moderate and stable entropy. Also, each group has distinctively different hidden-state movement and attention dispersion patterns. The analysis demonstrates that truthfulness in SLMs emerges from structured entropy and attention dynamics. Monitoring and optimizing these internal uncertainty patterns can guide the design of a more reliable, hallucination-aware, and application-specific edge SLMs.
tldr: This paper analyzes entropy and attention dynamics in small language models (1B-1.7B parameters) during inference on the TruthfulQA benchmark to understand internal patterns related to truthfulness and hallucination.
tldr_zh: 本文对小型语言模型在TruthfulQA基准上的推理过程进行熵和注意力动态分析，以探究与真实性和幻觉相关的内部行为模式。
summary_zh: 小语言模型正越来越多地部署于边缘设备及其他资源受限环境。然而，这些模型存在过度自信的错误预测及输出不稳定的问题，使其在事实性与决策关键型任务中存在风险。当前评估方法主要依赖最终准确率或幻觉率，未能解释内部模型行为如何影响输出。具体而言，解码过程中的熵值演化、注意力在层间的分布规律，以及隐藏表示如何影响不确定性、逻辑不一致和错误信息传播等问题常被忽视。为此，本研究引入对基于TruthfulQA数据集评估的小语言模型的熵与注意力动态的追踪分析。通过词元级输出熵、注意力熵、注意力头分散度及隐藏状态表示等方法，对四款参数量在1B-1.7B区间的模型进行检验。结果显示熵值模式可将模型分为三类：确定性模型（DeepSeek-1.5B与LLaMA-1B）输出熵随时间递减；探索型模型（Gemma-1B）输出熵递增；均衡型模型（Qwen-1.7B）则保持适中稳定的熵值。同时，每组模型在隐藏状态迁移与注意力分散模式上均存在显著差异。分析表明，小语言模型的真实性源于结构化的熵与注意力动态。监测并优化这些内部不确定性模式，可指导设计更可靠、具备幻觉感知能力且面向特定应用的边缘小语言模型。

title: SecPI: Secure Code Generation with Reasoning Models via Security Reasoning Internalization
summary: Reasoning language models (RLMs) are increasingly used in programming. Yet, even state-of-the-art RLMs frequently introduce critical security vulnerabilities in generated code. Prior training-based approaches for secure code generation face a critical limitation that prevents their direct application to RLMs: they rely on costly, manually curated security datasets covering only a limited set of vulnerabilities. At the inference level, generic security reminders consistently degrade functional correctness while triggering only shallow ad-hoc vulnerability analysis. To address these problems, we present SecPI, a fine-tuning pipeline that teaches RLMs to internalize structured security reasoning, producing secure code by default without any security instructions at inference time. SecPI filters existing general-purpose coding datasets for security-relevant tasks using an LLM-based classifier, generates high-quality security reasoning traces with a teacher model guided by a structured prompt that systematically enumerates relevant CWEs and mitigations, and fine-tunes the target model on pairs of inputs with no security prompt and teacher reasoning traces -- as a result, the model learns to reason about security autonomously rather than in response to explicit instructions. An extensive evaluation on security benchmarks with state-of-the-art open-weight reasoning models validates the effectiveness of our approach. For instance, SecPI improves the percentage of functionally correct and secure generations for QwQ 32B from 48.2% to 62.2% (+14.0 points) on CWEval and from 18.2% to 22.0% on BaxBench. Further investigation also reveals strong cross-CWE and cross-language generalization beyond training vulnerabilities. Even when trained only on injection-related CWEs, QwQ 32B generates correct and secure code 9.9% more frequently on held-out memory-safety CWEs.
tldr: SecPI is a fine-tuning pipeline that teaches reasoning language models to internalize security reasoning, enabling them to generate secure code by default without explicit security instructions at inference time, validated on security benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SecPI是一种微调流程，通过教导推理语言模型内化安全推理，使其能够默认生成安全代码，无需在推理时使用安全指令，并在安全基准测试中得到验证。
summary_zh: 推理语言模型在编程中的应用日益广泛。然而，即使是最先进的推理语言模型，在生成代码时仍频繁引入严重的安全漏洞。先前基于训练的代码安全生成方法面临一个关键局限，使其无法直接应用于推理语言模型：这些方法依赖于成本高昂且仅覆盖有限漏洞类型的人工标注安全数据集。在推理层面，通用的安全提示在引发浅层临时性漏洞分析的同时，会持续损害代码的功能正确性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SecPI——一种通过微调流程教导推理语言模型内化结构化安全推理能力的方法，使其在推理阶段无需任何安全指令即可默认生成安全代码。SecPI利用基于大语言模型的分类器从通用编程数据集中筛选出安全相关任务，通过采用结构化提示（系统枚举相关CWE漏洞类型及缓解措施）的教师模型生成高质量安全推理轨迹，并在无安全提示的输入与教师推理轨迹的配对数据上对目标模型进行微调，从而使模型学会自主进行安全推理而非仅响应显式指令。通过对开源推理模型在安全基准测试上的广泛评估，我们验证了该方法的有效性。例如，在CWEval基准上，SecPI将QwQ 32B模型生成功能正确且安全代码的比例从48.2%提升至62.2%（+14.0个百分点）；在BaxBench基准上从18.2%提升至22.0%。进一步研究还发现该方法具有强大的跨CWE漏洞类型和跨编程语言的泛化能力：仅在注入类CWE漏洞数据上训练的QwQ 32B模型，在未训练过的内存安全类CWE漏洞上生成正确且安全代码的频率提升了9.9%。

title: Personality Requires Struggle: Three Regimes of the Baldwin Effect in Neuroevolved Chess Agents
summary:
Can lifetime learning expand behavioral diversity over evolutionary time, rather than collapsing it? Prior theory predicts that plasticity reduces variance by buffering organisms against environmental noise. We test this in a competitive domain: chess agents with eight NEAT-evolved neural modules, Hebbian within-game plasticity, and a desirability-domain signal chain with imagination. Across 10~seeds per Hebbian condition, a variance crossover emerges: Hebbian ON starts with lower cross-seed variance than OFF, then surpasses it at generation~34. The crossover trend is monotonic (\r{ho} = 0.91, p < 10^{-6): plasticity's effect on behavioral variance reverses over evolutionary time, initially compressing diversity (consistent with prior predictions) then expanding it as evolved Perception differences are amplified through imagination -- a feedback loop that mutation alone cannot sustain.
  The result is structured behavioral divergence: evolved agents select different moves on the same positions (62\% disagreement), develop distinct opening repertoires, piece preferences, and game lengths. These are not different sampling policies -- they are reproducible behavioral signatures (ICC > 0.8) with interpretable signal chain configurations. Three regimes appear depending on opponent type: exploration (Hebbian ON, heterogeneous opponent), lottery (Hebbian OFF, elitism lock-in), and transparent (same-model opponent, brain self-erasure). The transparent regime generates a falsifiable prediction: self-play systems may systematically suppress behavioral diversity by eliminating the heterogeneity that personality requires.
  \textbf{Keywords: Baldwin Effect, neuroevolution, NEAT, Hebbian learning, chess, cognitive architecture, personality emergence, imagination
tldr: This paper investigates the Baldwin Effect using neuroevolution and Hebbian learning in chess agents, showing how plasticity can both initially compress and later expand behavioral diversity over evolutionary time, leading to the emergence of distinct 'personalities'.
tldr_zh: 本文使用神经进化和赫布学习在棋类智能体上研究鲍德温效应，揭示了可塑性如何先在进化过程中压缩行为多样性，而后又扩大它，最终导致可解释的独特'个性'出现。
summary_zh:
摘要：
终身学习能否在进化时间尺度上扩展行为多样性，而非使其坍缩？现有理论预测可塑性通过缓冲环境噪声会降低方差。我们在竞争性领域对此进行检验：构建了包含八个NEAT进化神经模块的象棋智能体，其具备赫布型对局内可塑性机制，以及含想象功能的期望值-领域信号链。在每种赫布条件下进行10次种子实验，发现方差拐点现象：赫布开启组起始跨种子方差低于关闭组，但在第34代后反超。该拐点趋势呈单调性（ρ=0.91，p<10^-6）——可塑性对行为方差的影响在进化过程中发生逆转，初期压缩多样性（与既有预测一致），随后通过想象机制放大进化形成的感知差异，形成突变单独无法维持的反馈环路，从而扩展多样性。

这一过程催生了结构化行为分化：进化智能体在相同棋局中选择不同走法（62%决策差异），形成独特的开局体系、子力偏好与对局时长特征。这些并非不同的抽样策略，而是具有可解释信号链配置、可复现的行为特征（ICC>0.8）。根据对手类型呈现三种演化模态：探索型（赫布开启+异质对手）、彩票型（赫布关闭+精英锁定）与透明型（同模型对手+大脑自擦除）。透明模态产生可证伪预测：自我对弈系统可能通过消除个性所需的异质性，系统性压制行为多样性。

关键词：鲍德温效应，神经进化，NEAT，赫布学习，国际象棋，认知架构，个性涌现，想象力

title: When Adaptive Rewards Hurt: Causal Probing and the Switching-Stability Dilemma in LLM-Guided LEO Satellite Scheduling
summary: Adaptive reward design for deep reinforcement learning (DRL) in multi-beam LEO satellite scheduling is motivated by the intuition that regime-aware reward weights should outperform static ones. We systematically test this intuition and uncover a switching-stability dilemma: near-constant reward weights (342.1 Mbps) outperform carefully-tuned dynamic weights (103.3+/-96.8 Mbps) because PPO requires a quasistationary reward signal for value function convergence. Weight adaptation-regardless of quality-degrades performance by repeatedly restarting convergence. To understand why specific weights matter, we introduce a single-variable causal probing method that independently perturbs each reward term by +/-20% and measures PPO response after 50k steps. Probing reveals counterintuitive leverage: a +20% increase in the switching penalty yields +157 Mbps for polar handover and +130 Mbps for hot-cold regimes-findings inaccessible to human experts or trained MLPs without systematic probing. We evaluate four MDP architect variants (fixed, rule-based, learned MLP, finetuned LLM) across known and novel traffic regimes. The MLP achieves 357.9 Mbps on known regimes and 325.2 Mbps on novel regimes, while the fine-tuned LLM collapses to 45.3+/-43.0 Mbps due to weight oscillation rather than lack of domain knowledge-output consistency, not knowledge, is the binding constraint. Our findings provide an empirically-grounded roadmap for LLM-DRL integration in communication systems, identifying where LLMs add irreplaceable value (natural language intent understanding) versus where simpler methods suffice.
tldr: This paper investigates the 'switching-stability dilemma' in adaptive reward design for Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) within a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite scheduling problem, finding that dynamic reward weights can degrade PPO performance due to non-stationarity. It also introduces a causal probing method and compares several reward design methods, including a fine-tuned LLM, which failed due to output inconsistency.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了近地轨道卫星调度中深度强化学习的自适应奖励设计，发现了'切换-稳定性困境'，即动态奖励权重会因不稳定性而损害PPO算法的性能。研究引入了一种因果探针方法，并比较了多种奖励设计方法，包括微调后的LLM，该方法因输出不稳定而失败。
summary_zh: 在面向多波束低轨卫星调度的深度强化学习中，自适应奖励设计的动机源于一种直观认识：机制感知的奖励权重应优于静态权重。我们系统性地验证了这一假设，并揭示了一个切换稳定性困境：近乎恒定的奖励权重（342.1 Mbps）表现优于精心调整的动态权重（103.3±96.8 Mbps），因为近端策略优化算法需要准静态的奖励信号来实现价值函数收敛。权重的自适应调整——无论其质量如何——会通过反复重启收敛过程而降低性能。为探究具体权重的影响机制，我们提出一种单变量因果探测方法：对每个奖励项独立施加±20%的扰动，并在5万步训练后测量近端策略优化算法的响应。探测揭示了反直觉的杠杆效应：将切换惩罚提升20%可使极地切换场景的吞吐量增加157 Mbps，热冷负载场景增加130 Mbps——这些发现无法通过专家经验或未经系统探测的已训练多层感知机获得。我们在已知和新型流量场景中评估了四种马尔可夫决策过程架构变体（固定式、规则式、学习式多层感知机、微调式大语言模型）。多层感知机在已知场景中达到357.9 Mbps，在新型场景中达到325.2 Mbps，而微调后的大语言模型因权重振荡（而非领域知识缺乏）崩溃至45.3±43.0 Mbps——输出一致性（而非知识储备）成为核心约束。本研究为通信系统中大语言模型与深度强化学习的融合提供了实证依据，明确了大语言模型能提供不可替代价值的领域（自然语言意图理解），以及适用简单方法的场景。

title: When Do Hallucinations Arise? A Graph Perspective on the Evolution of Path Reuse and Path Compression
summary: Reasoning hallucinations in large language models (LLMs) often appear as fluent yet unsupported conclusions that violate either the given context or underlying factual knowledge. Although such failures are widely observed, the mechanisms by which decoder-only Transformers produce them remain poorly understood. We model next-token prediction as a graph search process over an underlying graph, where entities correspond to nodes and learned transitions form edges. From this perspective, contextual reasoning is a constrained search over a sampled subgraph (intrinsic reasoning), while context-free queries rely on memorized structures in the underlying graph (extrinsic reasoning). We show that reasoning hallucinations arise from two fundamental mechanisms: \textbf{Path Reuse}, where memorized knowledge overrides contextual constraints during early training, and \textbf{Path Compression}, where frequently traversed multi-step paths collapse into shortcut edges in later training. Together, these mechanisms provide a unified explanation for reasoning hallucinations in LLMs and connected to well-known behaviors observed in downstream applications.
tldr: The paper analyzes reasoning hallucinations in LLMs from a graph perspective, identifying Path Reuse and Path Compression as two core mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 本文从图论视角分析大语言模型中的推理幻觉，提出路径重用和路径压缩是其产生的两个核心机制。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）中的推理幻觉通常表现为看似流畅却缺乏依据的结论，这些结论要么违背给定上下文，要么与底层事实知识相矛盾。尽管此类问题普遍存在，但人们对于仅解码器架构的Transformer模型如何产生此类幻觉的机制仍知之甚少。本文将下一词元预测建模为基于底层图的搜索过程，其中实体对应节点，已习得的转移关系构成边。从这一视角看，上下文推理是在采样子图上的约束搜索（内在推理），而无上下文查询则依赖底层图中记忆化的结构（外在推理）。研究表明，推理幻觉源于两种根本机制：\textbf{路径复用}（在早期训练阶段记忆化知识覆盖了上下文约束）与\textbf{路径压缩}（在后期训练中频繁遍历的多步路径坍缩为捷径边）。这两种机制共同为LLM中的推理幻觉提供了统一解释，并与下游应用中观察到的常见现象密切相关。

title: AgenticFlict: A Large-Scale Dataset of Merge Conflicts in AI Coding Agent Pull Requests on GitHub
summary: Software Engineering 3.0 marks a paradigm shift in software development, in which AI coding agents are no longer just assistive tools but active contributors. While prior empirical studies have examined productivity gains and acceptance patterns in AI-assisted development, the challenges associated with integrating agent-generated contributions remain less understood. In particular, merge conflicts, a fundamental aspect of collaborative software development, remain underexplored in this context. In this paper, we present AgenticFlict, a large-scale dataset of textual merge conflicts in AI coding agent pull requests (Agentic PRs). The dataset comprises 142K+ Agentic PRs collected from 59K+ repositories, of which 107K+ are successfully processed through deterministic merge simulation. Our pipeline identifies 29K+ PRs exhibiting merge conflicts, yielding a conflict rate of 27.67%, and extracts 336K+ fine-grained conflict regions across these instances. Our preliminary exploratory analysis indicates that merge conflicts are both frequent and often substantial in AI-generated contributions, with noticeable variation across agents, emphasizing the need to better understand and manage integration challenges in AI-assisted software development. The dataset, code and supplementary materials are available in zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19396917.
tldr: This paper presents a large-scale dataset, AgenticFlict, which measures merge conflicts in AI-generated code contributions on GitHub, finding them to be frequent and substantial, highlighting integration challenges in AI-assisted software development.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个名为AgenticFlict的大规模数据集，用于测量GitHub上AI生成代码贡献中的合并冲突，发现此类冲突频繁且影响较大，凸显了AI辅助软件开发中的集成挑战。
summary_zh: 软件工程3.0标志着软件开发范式的转变，其中AI编码代理不再仅仅是辅助工具，而是积极的贡献者。虽然先前的实证研究已经探讨了AI辅助开发中的生产力提升和接受模式，但与整合AI代理生成贡献相关的挑战仍鲜为人知。特别是在协作软件开发的核心方面——合并冲突，在此背景下尚未得到充分研究。本文提出了AgenticFlict，一个大规模AI编码代理拉取请求（Agentic PRs）中文本合并冲突的数据集。该数据集包含从59K+代码库中收集的142K+个Agentic PRs，其中107K+通过确定性合并模拟成功处理。我们的分析流程识别出29K+个存在合并冲突的PRs，冲突率达27.67%，并从中提取出336K+个细粒度冲突区域。初步探索性分析表明，AI生成贡献中的合并冲突不仅频繁发生且往往规模较大，不同代理之间的冲突特征存在显著差异，这凸显了在AI辅助软件开发中更好理解和管理集成挑战的必要性。数据集、代码及补充材料已发布于zenodo：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19396917。

title: Incentives shape how humans co-create with generative AI
summary: Generative AI is quickly becoming an integral part of people's everyday workflows. Early evidence has shown that while generative AI can increase individual-level productivity, it does so at the cost of collective diversity, potentially narrowing the set of ideas and perspectives produced. Our research stands in contrast to this concern: through a pre-registered randomized control trial, we show that incentives mediate AI's homogenizing force in a creative writing task where participants can use AI interactively. Participants rewarded for originality relative to peers produce collectively more diverse writing than those rewarded for quality alone. This divergence is driven not by abandoning AI, but by how participants use it: those incentivized for originality incorporate fewer AI suggestions verbatim, relying on the model more selectively for brainstorming, proofreading, and targeted edits. Our results reveal that the effects of generative AI depend not only on the technology itself, but also the behavioral strategies and incentive structures surrounding its use.
tldr: A randomized control trial shows that incentive structures (rewarding originality vs. quality) mediate the homogenizing effect of generative AI in a creative writing task by changing how humans interactively use the AI.
tldr_zh: 一项随机对照试验表明，在创意写作任务中，激励结构（奖励原创性vs.质量）通过改变人类交互式使用AI的方式，可以调节生成式AI的同质化效应。
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能正迅速成为人们日常工作中不可或缺的一部分。早期证据表明，虽然生成式人工智能能提高个体生产力，但这是以牺牲集体多样性为代价的，可能导致产生的观点和视角范围收窄。我们的研究则提出了不同见解：通过一项预注册的随机对照实验，我们发现，在参与者可交互使用人工智能的创意写作任务中，激励机制能够调节人工智能的同质化效应。相比仅因作品质量获得奖励的参与者，那些因作品原创性（相对于同伴）而获得奖励的参与者，其集体创作成果表现出更高的多样性。这种差异并非源于参与者放弃使用人工智能，而是取决于其使用方式：在原创性激励下，参与者逐字采用人工智能建议的比例更低，而是更有选择地利用模型进行头脑风暴、文本校对和针对性修改。我们的研究结果表明，生成式人工智能的影响不仅取决于技术本身，更与其使用过程中的行为策略和激励结构密切相关。

title: Explainable Model Routing for Agentic Workflows
summary: Modern agentic workflows decompose complex tasks into specialized subtasks and route them to diverse models to minimize cost without sacrificing quality. However, current routing architectures focus exclusively on performance optimization, leaving underlying trade-offs between model capability and cost unrecorded. Without clear rationale, developers cannot distinguish between intelligent efficiency -- using specialized models for appropriate tasks -- and latent failures caused by budget-driven model selection. We present Topaz, a framework that introduces formal auditability to agentic routing. Topaz replaces silent model assignments with an inherently interpretable router that incorporates three components: (i) skill-based profiling that synthesizes performance across diverse benchmarks into granular capability profiles (ii) fully traceable routing algorithms that utilize budget-based and multi-objective optimization to produce clear traces of how skill-match scores were weighed against costs, and (iii) developer-facing explanations that translate these traces into natural language, allowing users to audit system logic and iteratively tune the cost-quality tradeoff. By making routing decisions interpretable, Topaz enables users to understand, trust, and meaningfully steer routed agentic systems.
tldr: Topaz is a framework for making model routing decisions in agentic workflows explainable and auditable, focusing on balancing cost and performance trade-offs with clear, interpretable traces.
tldr_zh: Topaz是一个使智能体工作流中模型路由决策可解释和可审计的框架，专注于通过清晰的、可解释的跟踪来平衡成本与性能的权衡。
summary_zh: 现代智能体工作流通过将复杂任务分解为专业化子任务，并路由至多样化模型，实现在保持质量的同时最小化成本。然而，当前路由架构仅聚焦于性能优化，未能记录模型能力与成本之间的潜在权衡关系。由于缺乏明确决策依据，开发者难以区分智能效率——即为特定任务选用专业化模型——与受预算驱动的模型选择所引发的隐性故障。本文提出Topaz框架，该框架为智能体路由引入形式化可审计机制。Topaz采用具备本质可解释性的路由器取代静默模型分配机制，其包含三个核心组件：(1)基于技能画像的评估方法，将多维度基准测试结果综合为细粒度能力画像；(2)全链路可追溯路由算法，通过基于预算及多目标优化的决策过程，清晰记录技能匹配度与成本权衡的轨迹；(3)面向开发者的解释系统，将这些决策轨迹转化为自然语言，使用户能够审计系统逻辑并迭代调整成本-质量平衡点。通过实现路由决策的可解释化，Topaz使用户能够理解、信任并有效引导智能体路由系统的运行。

title: Inside the Scaffold: A Source-Code Taxonomy of Coding Agent Architectures
summary: LLM-based coding agents can localize bugs, generate patches, and run tests with diminishing human oversight, yet the scaffolding code that surrounds the language model (the control loop, tool definitions, state management, and context strategy) remains poorly understood. Existing surveys classify agents by abstract capabilities (tool use, planning, reflection) that cannot distinguish between architecturally distinct systems, and trajectory studies observe what agents do without examining the scaffold code that determines why. This paper presents a source-code-level architectural taxonomy derived from analysis of 13 open-source coding agent scaffolds at pinned commit hashes. Each agent is characterized across 12 dimensions organized into three layers: control architecture, tool and environment interface, and resource management. The analysis reveals that scaffold architectures resist discrete classification: control strategies range from fixed pipelines to Monte Carlo Tree Search, tool counts range from 0 to 37, and context compaction spans seven distinct strategies. Five loop primitives (ReAct, generate-test-repair, plan-execute, multi-attempt retry, tree search) function as composable building blocks that agents layer in different combinations; 11 of 13 agents compose multiple primitives rather than relying on a single control structure. Dimensions converge where external constraints dominate (tool capability categories, edit formats, execution isolation) and diverge where open design questions remain (context compaction, state management, multi-model routing). All taxonomic claims are grounded in file paths and line numbers, providing a reusable reference for researchers studying agent behavior and practitioners designing new scaffolds.
tldr: The paper presents a source-code-level taxonomy for the architecture of LLM-based coding agents, analyzing 13 open-source scaffolds across 12 dimensions to identify reusable building blocks and design patterns.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于源代码的LLM编码智能体架构分类法，分析了13个开源脚手架，识别了可复用的构建块和设计模式。
summary_zh: 基于LLM的代码智能体能够在极少人工干预下定位缺陷、生成补丁并运行测试，但围绕语言模型的脚手架代码（控制循环、工具定义、状态管理与上下文策略）仍缺乏深入理解。现有研究按抽象能力（工具使用、规划、反思）对智能体进行分类，却无法区分架构各异的系统；轨迹研究虽记录智能体行为，却未剖析决定其行为逻辑的脚手架代码。本文通过对13个开源代码智能体脚手架在特定提交哈希下的源码分析，提出一种源代码级架构分类法。每个智能体通过12个维度进行刻画，这些维度分为三层：控制架构、工具与环境接口、资源管理。分析表明，脚手架架构难以简单归类：控制策略涵盖从固定流水线到蒙特卡洛树搜索，工具数量从0到37不等，上下文压缩策略多达七种。五种循环原语（ReAct、生成-测试-修复、计划-执行、多轮重试、树搜索）作为可组合的构建模块，被智能体以不同组合方式叠加使用；13个系统中有11个融合了多种原语而非依赖单一控制结构。各维度在外部约束主导处趋同（工具能力分类、编辑格式、执行隔离），而在开放设计问题上存在分歧（上下文压缩、状态管理、多模型路由）。所有分类主张均基于文件路径与行号，为研究智能体行为的研究者及设计新脚手架的实践者提供了可复用的参考框架。

title: ActionNex: A Virtual Outage Manager for Cloud
summary: Outage management in large-scale cloud operations remains heavily manual, requiring rapid triage, cross-team coordination, and experience-driven decisions under partial observability. We present \textbf{ActionNex}, a production-grade agentic system that supports end-to-end outage assistance, including real-time updates, knowledge distillation, and role- and stage-conditioned next-best action recommendations. ActionNex ingests multimodal operational signals (e.g., outage content, telemetry, and human communications) and compresses them into critical events that represent meaningful state transitions. It couples this perception layer with a hierarchical memory subsystem: long-term Key-Condition-Action (KCA) knowledge distilled from playbooks and historical executions, episodic memory of prior outages, and working memory of the live context. A reasoning agent aligns current critical events to preconditions, retrieves relevant memories, and generates actionable recommendations; executed human actions serve as an implicit feedback signal to enable continual self-evolution in a human-agent hybrid system. We evaluate ActionNex on eight real Azure outages (8M tokens, 4,000 critical events) using two complementary ground-truth action sets, achieving 71.4\% precision and 52.8-54.8\% recall. The system has been piloted in production and has received positive early feedback.
tldr: ActionNex is a production-grade agentic system for cloud outage management, using multimodal operational signals and a hierarchical memory to provide real-time, context-aware action recommendations for human operators.
tldr_zh: ActionNex是一个用于云故障管理的生产级智能体系统，通过多模态操作信号和分层内存提供实时、上下文感知的面向人类操作员的行动建议。
summary_zh: 大规模云服务中的故障管理依然高度依赖人工操作，需要在部分可观测条件下快速完成故障分类、跨团队协作以及基于经验的决策。我们提出 **ActionNex**——一个生产级的智能体系统，可提供端到端的故障辅助支持，包括实时状态更新、知识提炼以及基于角色和阶段的最优行动推荐。ActionNex 接收多模态运营信号（如故障内容、遥测数据和人工通信记录），并将其压缩为代表关键状态转移的“关键事件”。该系统将感知层与分层式记忆子系统相结合：从操作手册和历史执行记录中提炼出的长期“关键-条件-行动”（KCA）知识、过往故障的案例记忆，以及当前场景的工作记忆。推理智能体将当前关键事件与预设条件进行匹配，检索相关记忆并生成可执行的行动建议；已执行的人工操作则作为隐式反馈信号，使这种人机协同系统能够实现持续自我进化。我们通过两组互补的真实行动数据集，对 ActionNex 在八个真实 Azure 故障案例（共计 800 万标记、4000 个关键事件）中的表现进行评估，实现了 71.4% 的准确率与 52.8%-54.8% 的召回率。该系统已在生产环境中试点运行，并获得了初步积极反馈。

title: The Augmentation Trap: AI Productivity and the Cost of Cognitive Offloading
summary: Experimental evidence confirms that AI tools raise worker productivity, but also that sustained use can erode the expertise on which those gains depend. We develop a dynamic model in which a decision-maker chooses AI usage intensity for a worker over time, trading immediate productivity against the erosion of worker skill. We decompose the tool's productivity effect into two channels, one independent of worker expertise and one that scales with it. The model produces three main results. First, even a decision-maker who fully anticipates skill erosion rationally adopts AI when front-loaded productivity gains outweigh long-run skill costs, producing steady-state loss: the worker ends up less productive than before adoption. Second, when managers are short-termist or worker skill has external value, the decision-maker's optimal policy turns steady-state loss into the augmentation trap, leaving the worker worse off than if AI had never been adopted. Third, when AI productivity depends less on worker expertise, workers can permanently diverge in skill: experienced workers realize their full potential while less experienced workers deskill to zero. Small differences in managerial incentives can determine which path a worker takes. The productivity decomposition classifies deployments into five regimes that separate beneficial adoption from harmful adoption and identifies which deployments are vulnerable to the trap.
tldr: A theoretical economic model analyzing the trade-off between immediate productivity gains from AI tools and the long-term erosion of human expertise, leading to potential steady-state productivity loss.
tldr_zh: 一个理论经济模型分析人工智能工具带来的即时生产力提升与长期人类专业技能侵蚀之间的权衡，可能导致稳态生产力损失。
summary_zh: 实验证据表明，AI工具能够提升工人的生产力，但持续使用也可能侵蚀这些生产力提升所依赖的专业技能。我们构建了一个动态模型，描述决策者随时间调整对工人使用AI强度的决策过程，该过程需要在即时生产力提升与工人技能损耗之间进行权衡。我们将AI工具对生产力的影响分解为两个渠道：其一与工人专业技能无关，其二随专业技能水平而增强。该模型得出三个主要结论：首先，即使决策者完全预见到技能损耗，当短期生产力收益超过长期技能成本时，仍会理性选择采用AI，从而导致稳态损失——工人最终生产力反而低于采用AI之前的水平。其次，当管理者存在短视行为或工人技能具有外部价值时，决策者的最优策略会使稳态损失演变为"增强陷阱"，导致工人处境比从未采用AI时更差。第三，当AI生产力对工人专业技能的依赖程度较低时，工人的技能水平可能出现永久性分化：经验丰富的工人能充分发挥潜力，而经验不足的工人则面临技能归零的风险。管理者激励机制的微小差异可能决定工人走向哪条路径。通过生产力分解框架，我们将AI部署分为五种模式，从而区分有益采用与有害采用，并识别哪些部署易陷入增强陷阱。

title: Resource-Conscious Modeling for Next- Day Discharge Prediction Using Clinical Notes
summary: Timely discharge prediction is essential for optimizing bed turnover and resource allocation in elective spine surgery units. This study evaluates the feasibility of lightweight, fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) and traditional text-based models for predicting next-day discharge using postoperative clinical notes. We compared 13 models, including TF-IDF with XGBoost and LGBM, and compact LLMs (DistilGPT-2, Bio_ClinicalBERT) fine-tuned via LoRA. TF-IDF with LGBM achieved the best balance, with an F1-score of 0.47 for the discharge class, a recall of 0.51, and the highest AUC-ROC (0.80). While LoRA improved recall in DistilGPT2, overall transformer-based and generative models underperformed. These findings suggest interpretable, resource-efficient models may outperform compact LLMs in real-world, imbalanced clinical prediction tasks.
tldr: The study compares lightweight LLMs and traditional models for predicting patient discharge from postoperative clinical notes, finding that simpler, interpretable models outperformed fine-tuned LLMs in this imbalanced clinical task.
tldr_zh: 本研究比较了轻量级大语言模型与传统模型在利用术后临床记录预测患者出院方面的表现，发现在这一不平衡的临床预测任务中，更简单、可解释的模型优于微调后的大语言模型。
summary_zh: 及时预测出院时间对于优化择期脊柱外科手术单元的床位周转和资源分配至关重要。本研究评估了轻量化微调的大型语言模型（LLM）与传统文本模型在利用术后临床记录预测次日出院情况中的可行性。我们比较了13种模型，包括结合XGBoost和LGBM的TF-IDF模型，以及通过LoRA微调的紧凑型LLM（DistilGPT-2、Bio_ClinicalBERT）。TF-IDF结合LGBM的模型取得了最佳平衡，其出院类别的F1分数为0.47，召回率为0.51，且AUC-ROC值最高（0.80）。虽然LoRA技术提升了DistilGPT2的召回率，但整体基于Transformer的生成式模型表现欠佳。这些结果表明，在现实世界中不平衡的临床预测任务中，可解释且资源高效的模型可能优于紧凑型LLM。

title: Beyond Predefined Schemas: TRACE-KG for Context-Enriched Knowledge Graphs from Complex Documents
summary: Knowledge graph construction typically relies either on predefined ontologies or on schema-free extraction. Ontology-driven pipelines enforce consistent typing but require costly schema design and maintenance, whereas schema-free methods often produce fragmented graphs with weak global organization, especially in long technical documents with dense, context-dependent information. We propose TRACE-KG (Text-dRiven schemA for Context-Enriched Knowledge Graphs), a multimodal framework that jointly constructs a context-enriched knowledge graph and an induced schema without assuming a predefined ontology. TRACE-KG captures conditional relations through structured qualifiers and organizes entities and relations using a data-driven schema that serves as a reusable semantic scaffold while preserving full traceability to the source evidence. Experiments show that TRACE-KG produces structurally coherent, traceable knowledge graphs and offers a practical alternative to both ontology-driven and schema-free construction pipelines.
tldr: The paper proposes TRACE-KG, a multimodal framework for constructing context-enriched knowledge graphs and induced schemas from complex documents without predefined ontologies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了TRACE-KG，一种多模态框架，用于从复杂文档中无需预定义本体即可构建上下文丰富的知识图谱和归纳模式。
summary_zh: 知识图谱构建通常依赖于预定义的本体或免模式抽取方法。基于本体的流程能够确保类型一致性，但需要昂贵的模式设计与维护成本；而免模式方法则常产生结构碎片化的图谱，尤其在处理包含密集、上下文依赖信息的长篇技术文档时，其全局组织性较弱。本文提出TRACE-KG（面向上下文增强知识图谱的文本驱动模式），这是一种多模态框架，能够在不预设本体的前提下，联合构建上下文增强的知识图谱及推导出的模式。TRACE-KG通过结构化限定符捕捉条件性关系，并利用数据驱动的模式组织实体与关系，该模式既可作为可复用的语义框架，又能完整保留至源证据的可追溯性。实验表明，TRACE-KG能够生成结构连贯、可追溯的知识图谱，为基于本体和免模式的构建流程提供了实用替代方案。

title: Fine-tuning DeepSeek-OCR-2 for Molecular Structure Recognition
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) is critical for converting 2D molecular diagrams from printed literature into machine-readable formats. While Vision-Language Models have shown promise in end-to-end OCR tasks, their direct application to OCSR remains challenging, and direct full-parameter supervised fine-tuning often fails. In this work, we adapt DeepSeek-OCR-2 for molecular optical recognition by formulating the task as image-conditioned SMILES generation. To overcome training instabilities, we propose a two-stage progressive supervised fine-tuning strategy: starting with parameter-efficient LoRA and transitioning to selective full-parameter fine-tuning with split learning rates. We train our model on a large-scale corpus combining synthetic renderings from PubChem and realistic patent images from USPTO-MOL to improve coverage and robustness. Our fine-tuned model, MolSeek-OCR, demonstrates competitive capabilities, achieving exact matching accuracies comparable to the best-performing image-to-sequence model. However, it remains inferior to state-of-the-art image-to-graph modelS. Furthermore, we explore reinforcement-style post-training and data-curation-based refinement, finding that they fail to improve the strict sequence-level fidelity required for exact SMILES matching.
tldr: This paper adapts a general OCR model for molecular structure recognition via image-conditioned SMILES generation, using a progressive fine-tuning strategy, but it is not directly related to robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将分子结构识别任务建模为图像条件SMILES生成，使用渐进式微调策略适配通用OCR模型，但该研究与机器人学无直接关联。
summary_zh: 光学化学结构识别（OCSR）对于将印刷文献中的二维分子图转化为机器可读格式至关重要。尽管视觉语言模型在端到端光学字符识别任务中展现出潜力，但其直接应用于OCSR仍面临挑战，直接的全参数监督微调往往效果不佳。本研究通过将任务构建为图像条件SMILES生成问题，将DeepSeek-OCR-2模型适配于分子光学识别任务。为克服训练不稳定性问题，我们提出两阶段渐进式监督微调策略：首先采用参数高效的LoRA方法，随后过渡到分学习率的选择性全参数微调。我们利用PubChem合成渲染图与USPTO-MOL专利实际图像构建的大规模语料库进行训练，以提升模型覆盖范围与鲁棒性。经微调后的MolSeek-OCR模型展现出竞争力，其精确匹配准确率与最佳图像到序列模型相当，但仍落后于当前最先进的图像到图模型。此外，我们探索了强化式后训练与数据优化改进方法，发现这些方法均未能提升精确SMILES匹配所需的严格序列级保真度。

title: RDFace: A Benchmark Dataset for Rare Disease Facial Image Analysis under Extreme Data Scarcity and Phenotype-Aware Synthetic Generation
summary: Rare diseases often manifest with distinctive facial phenotypes in children, offering valuable diagnostic cues for clinicians and AI-assisted screening systems. However, progress in this field is severely limited by the scarcity of curated, ethically sourced facial data and the high similarity among phenotypes across different conditions. To address these challenges, we introduce RDFace, a curated benchmark dataset comprising 456 pediatric facial images spanning 103 rare genetic conditions (average 4.4 samples per condition). Each ethically verified image is paired with standardized metadata. RDFace enables the development and evaluation of data-efficient AI models for rare disease diagnosis under real-world low-data constraints. We benchmark multiple pretrained vision backbones using cross-validation and explore synthetic augmentation with DreamBooth and FastGAN. Generated images are filtered via facial landmark similarity to maintain phenotype fidelity and merged with real data, improving diagnostic accuracy by up to 13.7% in ultra-low-data regimes. To assess semantic validity, phenotype descriptions generated by a vision-language model from real and synthetic images achieve a report similarity score of 0.84. RDFace establishes a transparent, benchmark-ready dataset for equitable rare disease AI research and presents a scalable framework for evaluating both diagnostic performance and the integrity of synthetic medical imagery.
tldr: This paper introduces RDFace, a dataset for rare disease facial image analysis, featuring synthetic image generation and evaluation of diagnostic AI models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于罕见疾病面部图像分析的数据集RDFace，包含合成图像生成和诊断AI模型评估。
summary_zh: 罕见疾病常表现为儿童面部特征异常，这为临床医生和AI辅助筛查系统提供了重要的诊断线索。然而，该领域的发展因高质量的伦理合规面部数据稀缺以及不同疾病间表型高度相似性而受到严重制约。为此，我们提出RDFace——一个精心构建的基准数据集，包含涵盖103种罕见遗传病的456张儿科面部图像（平均每种疾病4.4个样本）。每张经过伦理验证的图像均配有标准化元数据。RDFace能够在真实世界低数据限制下，为罕见疾病诊断开发并评估数据高效型AI模型。我们通过交叉验证对多个预训练视觉骨干网络进行基准测试，并探索了DreamBooth和FastGAN的合成数据增强技术。通过面部关键点相似性筛选生成图像以保持表型保真度，并将其与真实数据融合，在极低数据场景下将诊断准确率最高提升13.7%。为评估语义有效性，通过视觉语言模型对真实与合成图像生成表型描述，其报告相似度得分达到0.84。RDFace为公平的罕见疾病AI研究建立了透明化、基准就绪的数据集，并为评估诊断性能与合成医学影像完整性提供了可扩展框架。

title: ExpressEdit: Fast Editing of Stylized Facial Expressions with Diffusion Models in Photoshop
summary: Facial expressions of characters are a vital component of visual storytelling. While current AI image editing models hold promise for assisting artists in the task of stylized expression editing, these models introduce global noise and pixel drift into the edited image, preventing the integration of these models into professional image editing software and workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExpressEdit, a fully open-source Photoshop plugin that is free from common artifacts of proprietary image editing models and robustly synergizes with native Photoshop operations such as Liquify. ExpressEdit seamlessly edits an expression within 3 seconds on a single consumer-grade GPU, significantly faster than popular proprietary models. Moreover, to support the generation of diverse expressions according to different narrative needs, we compile a comprehensive expression database of 135 expression tags enriched with example stories and images designed for retrieval-augmented generation. We open source the code and dataset to facilitate future research and artistic exploration.
tldr: This paper introduces ExpressEdit, an open-source Photoshop plugin for fast, artifact-free editing of stylized facial expressions using diffusion models, which is not related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ExpressEdit，一个用于Photoshop的开源插件，它利用扩散模型快速、无伪影地编辑风格化面部表情，与机器人或具身AI无关。
summary_zh: 角色的面部表情是视觉叙事的重要组成部分。现有AI图像编辑模型虽有望在风格化表情编辑任务中为艺术家提供协助，但这些模型会在编辑图像中引入全局噪点和像素漂移，导致其无法融入专业图像编辑软件及工作流程。为弥合这一差距，我们推出了ExpressEdit——一款完全开源的Photoshop插件，它不仅避免了专有图像编辑模型的常见伪影，还能与液化工具等原生Photoshop操作实现稳健协同。ExpressEdit在消费级单GPU上仅需3秒即可完成表情编辑，速度显著优于主流专有模型。此外，为支持根据不同叙事需求生成多样化表情，我们构建了包含135个表情标签的完整表情数据库，并配套设计用于检索增强生成的故事范例与图像集。我们已公开代码与数据集，以促进未来研究与艺术创作探索。

title: Agile Story-Point Estimation: Is RAG a Better Way to Go?
summary: The sprint-based iterative approach in the Agile software development method allows continuous feedback and adaptation. One of the crucial Agile software development activities is the sprint planning session where developers estimate the effort required to complete tasks through a consensus-based estimation technique such as Planning Poker. In the Agile software development method, a common unit of measuring development effort is Story Point (SP) which is assigned to tasks to understand the complexity and development time needed to complete them. Despite the benefits of this process, it is an extremely time-consuming manual process. To mitigate this issue, in this study, we investigated if this manual process can be automated using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) which comprises a "Retriever" and a "Generator". We applied two embedding models - bge-large-en-v1.5, and Sentence-Transformers' all-mpnet-base-v2 on 23 open-source software projects of varying sizes and examined four key aspects: 1) how retrieval hyper-parameters influence the performance, 2) whether estimation accuracy differs across different sizes of the projects, 3) whether embedding model choice affects accuracy, and 4) how the RAG-based approach compares to the existing baselines. Although the RAG-based approach outperformed the baseline models in several occasions, our results did not exhibit statistically significant differences in performance across the projects or across the embedding models. This highlights the need for further studies and refinement of the RAG, and model adaptation strategies for better accuracy in automatically estimating user stories.
tldr: This paper investigates the use of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to automate the manual, time-consuming process of estimating user story effort points in Agile software development, evaluating its performance on various open-source projects.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了使用检索增强生成（RAG）技术来自动化敏捷软件开发中耗时的用户故事工作量估算过程，并在多个开源项目上评估其性能。
summary_zh: 敏捷软件开发方法中基于冲刺的迭代方式支持持续反馈与调整。冲刺计划会议是敏捷开发的关键活动之一，开发人员通过“计划扑克”等共识性估算技术评估完成任务所需工作量。在敏捷开发方法中，故事点作为衡量开发工作量的常用单位，通过为任务分配故事点来理解其完成所需的复杂度与开发时间。尽管该流程具有优势，但其作为纯手动过程耗时极长。为缓解此问题，本研究探索了如何利用由“检索器”与“生成器”构成的检索增强生成技术实现该流程的自动化。我们在23个不同规模的开源软件项目上应用了bge-large-en-v1.5和Sentence-Transformers的all-mpnet-base-v2两种嵌入模型，并从四个维度展开研究：1) 检索超参数如何影响性能；2) 估算准确性是否随项目规模变化；3) 嵌入模型选择是否影响准确性；4) 基于RAG的方法与现有基线模型的对比效果。尽管RAG方法在多方面表现优于基线模型，但实验结果显示不同项目之间或不同嵌入模型之间的性能差异未达到统计学显著性。这表明需要进一步深入研究，优化RAG技术及模型适配策略，以提升用户故事自动估算的准确性。

title: Inference-Path Optimization via Circuit Duplication in Frozen Visual Transformers for Marine Species Classification
summary:
Automated underwater species classification is constrained by annotation cost and environmental variation that limits the transferability of fully supervised models. Recent work has shown that frozen embeddings from self-supervised vision foundation models already provide a strong label-efficient baseline for marine image classification. Here we investigate whether this frozen-embedding regime can be improved at inference time, without fine-tuning or changing model weights.
  We apply Circuit Duplication, an inference-time method originally proposed for Large Language Models, in which a selected range of transformer layers is traversed twice during the forward pass. We evaluate on the class-imbalanced AQUA20 benchmark using frozen DINOv3 embeddings under two settings: global circuit selection, where a single duplicated circuit is chosen for the full dataset, and class-specific circuit selection, where each species may receive a different optimal circuit. Both settings use simple semi-supervised downstream classifiers.
  Circuit Duplication consistently improves over the standard frozen forward pass. At the maximum label budget, class-specific selection reaches a macro F1 of 0.875, closing the gap to the fully supervised ConvNeXt benchmark (0.889) to 1.4 points without any gradient-based training. Four species exceed their fully supervised reference, with octopus improving by +12.1 F1 points. Across all budgets, roughly 75% of classes prefer a class-specific circuit, indicating a genuinely class-dependent benefit. To our knowledge, this is the first application of Circuit Duplication to computer vision.
tldr: This paper applies a circuit duplication method from LLMs to improve inference-time performance of frozen visual transformers for marine species classification, without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文将一种来自大语言模型的电路复制方法应用于冻结视觉Transformer，以改进水下物种分类的推理时性能，无需微调。
summary_zh:
自动化水下物种分类受限于标注成本与环境变化，这制约了全监督模型的迁移能力。近期研究表明，自监督视觉基础模型生成的冻结嵌入已为海洋图像分类提供了强大的标签高效基线。本文探讨是否能在不微调或改变模型权重的情况下，在推理阶段改进这一冻结嵌入机制。

我们采用最初为大型语言模型设计的推理时方法——电路复制，在前向传播过程中对选定的Transformer层进行两次遍历。实验在类别不平衡的AQUA20基准数据集上进行，使用冻结的DINOv3嵌入，并设置两种评估场景：全局电路选择（为整个数据集选择单一复制电路）和类别特定电路选择（每个物种可采用不同的最优电路）。两种场景均使用简单的半监督下游分类器。

电路复制方法持续优于标准的冻结前向传播。在最大标注预算下，类别特定选择实现了0.875的宏观F1分数，将全监督ConvNeXt基准分数（0.889）的差距缩小至1.4分，且无需任何基于梯度的训练。其中四个物种的表现超越其全监督参考结果，章鱼分类的F1分数提升了12.1分。在所有预算范围内，约75%的类别更适用于类别特定电路，表明该方法具有真实的类别依赖性优势。据我们所知，这是电路复制方法在计算机视觉领域的首次应用。

title: Zero-Shot Quantization via Weight-Space Arithmetic
summary: We show that robustness to post-training quantization (PTQ) is a transferable direction in weight space. We call this direction the quantization vector: extracted from a donor task by simple weight-space arithmetic, it can be used to patch a receiver model and improve robustness to PTQ-induced noise by as much as 60%, without receiver-side quantization-aware training (QAT). Because the method requires no receiver training data, it provides a zero-shot, low-cost alternative to QAT for extremely low-bit deployment. We demonstrate this on Vision Transformer (ViT) models. More broadly, our results suggest that quantization robustness is not merely a byproduct of task-specific training, but a reusable feature of weight-space geometry that can be transferred rather than retrained.
tldr: The paper introduces a zero-shot method to improve model robustness to post-training quantization by extracting and transferring a 'quantization vector' in weight space from a donor task, requiring no receiver-side training data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种零样本方法，通过从捐助任务中提取并转移权重空间中的'量化向量'来提高模型对训练后量化的鲁棒性，无需接收方训练数据。
summary_zh: 本文提出，后训练量化（PTQ）的鲁棒性在权重空间中具有可转移性方向。我们将其定义为量化向量：通过简单的权重空间算术从捐赠任务中提取该向量，可用于修补接收模型，将PTQ所引入噪声的鲁棒性提升高达60%，且无需在接收端进行量化感知训练（QAT）。由于该方法无需接收方训练数据，为实现极低比特部署提供了一种零样本、低成本的QAT替代方案。我们以视觉Transformer（ViT）模型验证了该方法的有效性。更广泛而言，研究结果表明量化鲁棒性并非仅是任务特定训练的副产品，而是权重空间几何中可复用、可转移而非重新训练的特性。

title: Generative AI for material design: A mechanics perspective from burgers to matter
summary: Generative artificial intelligence offers a new paradigm to design matter in high-dimensional spaces. However, its underlying mechanisms remain difficult to interpret and limit adoption in computational mechanics. This gap is striking because its core tools-diffusion, stochastic differential equations, and inverse problems-are fundamental to the mechanics of materials. Here we show that diffusion-based generative AI and computational mechanics are rooted in the same principles. We illustrate this connection using a three-ingredient burger as a minimal benchmark for material design in a low-dimensional space, where both forward and reverse diffusion admit analytical solutions: Markov chains with Bayesian inversion in the discrete case and the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with score-based reversal in the continuous case. We extend this framework to a high-dimensional design space with 146 ingredients and 8.9x10^43 possible configurations, where analytical solutions become intractable. We therefore learn the discrete and continuous reverse processes using neural network models that infer inverse dynamics from data. We train the models on only 2,260 recipes and generate one million samples that capture the statistical structure of the data, including ingredient prevalence and quantitative composition. We further generate five new burgers and validate them in a restaurant-based sensory study with 100 participants, where three of the AI-designed burgers outperform the classical Big Mac in overall liking, flavor, and texture. These results establish diffusion-based generative modeling as a physically grounded approach to design in high-dimensional spaces. They position generative AI as a natural extension of computational mechanics, with applications from burgers to matter, and establish a path toward data-driven, physics-informed generative design.
tldr: This paper applies diffusion-based generative AI to material design, establishing a connection between the principles of diffusion models and computational mechanics, and demonstrates its effectiveness on a high-dimensional design problem for creating novel burgers.
tldr_zh: 本文将基于扩散的生成式AI应用于材料设计，建立了扩散模型原理与计算力学之间的联系，并在一项高维度的汉堡设计中展示了其有效性。
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能为高维空间中的物质设计提供了新范式。然而，其内在机制仍难以解释，限制了其在计算力学中的广泛应用。这一矛盾尤为突出，因为其核心工具——扩散过程、随机微分方程和反问题——正是材料力学的理论基础。本文通过理论推导与实证研究表明，基于扩散的生成式人工智能与计算力学共享相同的数学原理。我们以三组分汉堡为例，在低维空间中构建了可解析求解的材料设计基准模型：离散情形下采用贝叶斯反演的马尔可夫链，连续情形下应用基于分数匹配的奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程反转。随后将该框架拓展至包含146种成分、8.9×10^43种可能配置的高维设计空间，此时解析解已不可行。我们通过神经网络模型从数据中学习离散与连续的反向过程，仅用2260个配方进行训练后，即可生成百万级样本，精准复现原始数据的统计特征（包括成分分布规律与定量组成）。基于该模型新设计的五款汉堡经百人餐厅感官测试验证，其中三款在总体喜好度、风味和质构评分上均超越经典巨无霸汉堡。这些发现确立了基于扩散的生成建模作为高维空间设计的物理基础方法，将生成式人工智能定位为计算力学的自然延伸，其应用范围可从汉堡设计拓展至广义物质设计，并为数据驱动、物理信息融合的生成式设计开辟了新路径。

title: Hume's Representational Conditions for Causal Judgment: What Bayesian Formalization Abstracted Away
summary: Hume's account of causal judgment presupposes three representational conditions: experiential grounding (ideas must trace to impressions), structured retrieval (association must operate through organized networks exceeding pairwise connection), and vivacity transfer (inference must produce felt conviction, not merely updated probability). This paper extracts these conditions from Hume's texts and argues that they are integral to his causal psychology. It then traces their fate through the formalization trajectory from Hume to Bayesian epistemology and predictive processing, showing that later frameworks preserve the updating structure of Hume's insight while abstracting away these further representational conditions. Large language models serve as an illustrative contemporary case: they exhibit a form of statistical updating without satisfying the three conditions, thereby making visible requirements that were previously background assumptions in Hume's framework.
tldr: The paper analyzes Hume's representational conditions for causal judgment, argues they were abstracted away in Bayesian formalization, and uses large language models as a case study to illustrate this abstraction.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了休谟对因果判断的表征条件，论证这些条件在贝叶斯形式化中被抽象掉了，并使用大型语言模型作为案例研究来说明这种抽象。
summary_zh: 摘要：休谟对因果判断的论述预设了三个表征条件：经验基础（观念必须追溯至印象）、结构化的提取（联想必须通过超越两两联结的有组织网络运作）以及生动性转移（推理必须产生实在的信念感，而非仅更新概率）。本文从休谟的文本中提取出这些条件，并论证它们是休谟因果心理学的内在组成部分。随后，本文追溯了从休谟到贝叶斯认识论与预测加工理论的形式化发展路径，表明后续框架虽保留了休谟洞见中的更新结构，却将这些更深层的表征条件抽象化处理。大语言模型作为一个当代的例证：它们展现出一种统计更新形式，却未满足上述三个条件，从而使休谟框架中原本作为背景假设的要求变得可见。

title: VERT: Reliable LLM Judges for Radiology Report Evaluation
summary: Current literature on radiology report evaluation has focused primarily on designing LLM-based metrics and fine-tuning small models for chest X-rays. However, it remains unclear whether these approaches are robust when applied to reports from other modalities and anatomies. Which model and prompt configurations are best suited to serve as LLM judges for radiology evaluation? We conduct a thorough correlation analysis between expert and LLM-based ratings. We compare three existing LLM-as-a-judge metrics (RadFact, GREEN, and FineRadScore) alongside VERT, our proposed LLM-based metric, using open- and closed-source models (reasoning and non-reasoning) of different sizes across two expert-annotated datasets, RadEval and RaTE-Eval, spanning multiple modalities and anatomies. We further evaluate few-shot approaches, ensembling, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using RaTE-Eval. To better understand metric behavior, we perform a systematic error detection and categorization study to assess alignment of these metrics against expert judgments and identify areas of lower and higher agreement. Our results show that VERT improves correlation with radiologist judgments by up to 11.7% relative to GREEN. Furthermore, fine-tuning Qwen3 30B yield gains of up to 25% using only 1,300 training samples. The fine-tuned model also reduces inference time up to 37.2 times. These findings highlight the effectiveness of LLM-based judges and demonstrate that reliable evaluation can be achieved with lightweight adaptation.
tldr: This paper proposes VERT, a new LLM-based metric for evaluating radiology reports, which is benchmarked against existing metrics and expert judgments across multiple modalities and anatomies, showing improved correlation and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VERT，一种用于评估放射学报告的新LLM基准指标，该指标在多个模态和解剖结构上对现有指标和专家判断进行了基准测试，显示出更高的相关性和效率。
summary_zh: 当前关于放射学报告评估的文献主要聚焦于设计基于大语言模型的评估指标，并针对胸部X光片进行小模型微调。然而，这些方法在应用于其他影像模态和解剖部位的报告时是否具有鲁棒性仍不明确。何种模型与提示配置最适合作为放射学评估的LLM评判工具？我们对专家评分与基于LLM的评分进行了全面的相关性分析，在涵盖多模态、多解剖部位的两个专家标注数据集（RadEval和RaTE-Eval）上，比较了三种现有的LLM即评判指标（RadFact、GREEN和FineRadScore）与我们提出的基于LLM的指标VERT，并使用了不同规模的开源与闭源模型（推理型与非推理型）。我们进一步利用RaTE-Eval数据集评估了少样本学习、集成学习以及参数高效微调方法。为深入理解指标性能，我们开展了系统性错误检测与分类研究，以评估这些指标与专家判断的一致性，并识别出吻合度较低与较高的领域。实验结果表明，相较于GREEN指标，VERT将放射科医生判断的相关性提升了最高达11.7%。此外，仅使用1300个训练样本对Qwen3 30B模型进行微调即可获得高达25%的性能增益，同时微调后的模型推理时间最多可缩短至原来的1/37.2。这些发现凸显了基于LLM的评判工具的有效性，并证明通过轻量级适配即可实现可靠的评估。

title: CresOWLve: Benchmarking Creative Problem-Solving Over Real-World Knowledge
summary: Creative problem-solving requires combining multiple cognitive abilities, including logical reasoning, lateral thinking, analogy-making, and commonsense knowledge, to discover insights that connect seemingly unrelated pieces of information. However, most existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) evaluate only specific components of this process. Moreover, many creativity-oriented benchmarks rely on artificially constructed brainteasers or contrived scenarios that do not reflect how creative problem-solving occurs in real-world settings. To address this gap, we introduce CresOWLve, a benchmark for evaluating creative problem-solving using puzzles grounded in real-world knowledge. Problems in CresOWLve require employing multiple creative thinking strategies, retrieving facts from diverse domains, and creatively combining them to arrive at a solution. Evaluating several frontier non-thinking and thinking LLMs, we show that CresOWLve remains highly challenging. Our analysis reveals a consistent performance gap: models perform substantially better on factual questions than on creative ones (up to a -17% drop). While models can often retrieve the relevant knowledge, they struggle to form the non-obvious creative connections required to integrate this information and arrive at the correct answer.
tldr: Introduces CresOWLve, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on creative problem-solving tasks that require integrating diverse real-world knowledge, revealing a significant gap between factual recall and creative reasoning performance.
tldr_zh: 提出CresOWLve基准，用于评估LLM在需要整合不同领域真实世界知识的创造性问题解决任务上的表现，揭示了模型在事实回忆与创造性推理之间存在显著性能差距。
summary_zh: 创造性解决问题需要融合逻辑推理、横向思维、类比推理和常识知识等多种认知能力，以发现连接看似无关信息的内在联系。然而，现有的大语言模型基准测试大多仅评估该过程的特定环节，且许多面向创造性的评测依赖于人为构造的脑筋急转弯或虚构场景，未能反映真实世界中的创造性问题解决过程。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了CresOWLve——一个基于现实世界知识的谜题评测框架，用于评估创造性问题解决能力。该基准中的问题需要运用多种创造性思维策略，检索跨领域事实，并通过创造性整合得出解决方案。通过对多个前沿的非思考型与思考型大语言模型进行评测，我们发现CresOWLve仍然具有高度挑战性。分析表明模型表现存在明显差距：在事实性问题上的表现显著优于创造性问题（最高下降达17%）。尽管模型通常能够检索相关知识，但在整合信息时难以建立非显而易见的创造性关联以获得正确答案。

title: Rényi Attention Entropy for Patch Pruning
summary: Transformers are strong baselines in both vision and language because self-attention captures long-range dependencies across tokens. However, the cost of self-attention grows quadratically with the number of tokens. Patch pruning mitigates this cost by estimating per-patch importance and removing redundant patches. To identify informative patches for pruning, we introduce a criterion based on the Shannon entropy of the attention distribution. Low-entropy patches, which receive selective and concentrated attention, are kept as important, while high-entropy patches with attention spread across many locations are treated as redundant. We also extend the criterion from Shannon to Rényi entropy, which emphasizes sharp attention peaks and supports pruning strategies that adapt to task needs and computational limits. In experiments on fine-grained image recognition, where patch selection is critical, our method reduced computation while preserving accuracy. Moreover, adjusting the pruning policy through the Rényi entropy measure yields further gains and improves the trade-off between accuracy and computation.
tldr: This paper introduces an attention entropy criterion for pruning redundant patches in vision transformers, reducing computational cost while maintaining accuracy on fine-grained image recognition tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于注意力熵的准则，用于剪枝视觉Transformer中的冗余图像块，在细粒度图像识别任务中，降低了计算成本并保持了准确率。
summary_zh: Transformer模型在视觉和语言领域均展现出强大的基线性能，其核心在于自注意力机制能够捕捉token之间的长程依赖关系。然而，自注意力计算成本随token数量呈二次方增长。补丁剪枝通过评估每个补丁的重要性并移除冗余补丁，有效缓解了这一计算负担。为识别剪枝中的信息丰富补丁，我们引入了一种基于注意力分布香农熵的判定准则：注意力集中且具有选择性的低熵补丁被视为重要信息而保留，而注意力分散到多个位置的高熵补丁则被判定为冗余。我们进一步将准则从香农熵推广至Rényi熵，该方法能强化对显著注意力峰的识别，支持根据任务需求与计算限制自适应调整剪枝策略。在细粒度图像识别任务中，补丁选择至关重要，实验表明我们的方法在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算量。此外，通过Rényi熵度量调整剪枝策略能获得更优的精度与计算效率平衡，进一步提升模型性能。

title: HistoFusionNet: Histogram-Guided Fusion and Frequency-Adaptive Refinement for Nighttime Image Dehazing
summary: Nighttime image dehazing remains a challenging low-level vision problem due to the joint presence of haze, glow, non-uniform illumination, color distortion, and sensor noise, which often invalidate assumptions commonly used in daytime dehazing. To address these challenges, we propose HistoFusionNet, a transformer-enhanced architecture tailored for nighttime image dehazing by combining histogram-guided representation learning with frequency-adaptive feature refinement. Built upon a multi-scale encoder-decoder backbone, our method introduces histogram transformer blocks that model long-range dependencies by grouping features according to their dynamic-range characteristics, enabling more effective aggregation of similarly degraded regions under complex nighttime lighting. To further improve restoration fidelity, we incorporate a frequency-aware refinement branch that adaptively exploits complementary low- and high-frequency cues, helping recover scene structures, suppress artifacts, and enhance local details. This design yields a unified framework that is particularly well suited to the heterogeneous degradations encountered in real nighttime hazy scenes. Extensive experiments and highly competitive performance of our method on the NTIRE 2026 Nighttime Image Dehazing Challenge benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
