Our team ranked 1st among 22 participating teams, highlighting the robustness and competitive performance of HistoFusionNet. The code is available at: https://github.com/heydarimo/Night-Time-Dehazing
tldr: The paper proposes HistoFusionNet, a transformer-enhanced model for nighttime image dehazing, combining histogram-guided representation learning and frequency-adaptive feature refinement to address challenges like glow and non-uniform illumination, achieving top performance on a benchmark challenge.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HistoFusionNet，一种用于夜间图像去雾的Transformer增强模型，它结合了直方图引导的表征学习和频率自适应特征细化，以解决光晕和非均匀光照等挑战，在基准测试中取得了最佳性能。
summary_zh: 夜间图像去雾仍是一个具有挑战性的低级视觉问题，因为雾霾、光晕、非均匀光照、色彩失真及传感器噪声往往同时存在，这使得传统基于白天去雾假设的方法通常失效。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种为夜间图像去雾量身定制的Transformer增强架构——HistoFusionNet，该方法将直方图引导的表示学习与频率自适应特征细化相结合。基于多尺度编码器-解码器主干网络，我们引入了直方图Transformer模块，通过依据动态范围特征对特征进行分组以建模长程依赖关系，从而在复杂夜间光照条件下更有效地聚合相似退化区域。为提升复原保真度，我们还加入了一个频率感知细化分支，该分支能够自适应地利用互补的低频与高频线索，有助于恢复场景结构、抑制伪影并增强局部细节。这一设计形成了一个统一的框架，特别适用于真实夜间有雾场景中存在的异构退化问题。在NTIRE 2026夜间图像去雾挑战基准上的大量实验及极具竞争力的性能表现，充分证明了所提方法的有效性。我们的团队在22支参赛队伍中位列第一，彰显了HistoFusionNet的鲁棒性与卓越性能。代码已发布于：https://github.com/heydarimo/Night-Time-Dehazing

title: Confidence-Driven Facade Refinement of 3D Building Models Using MLS Point Clouds
summary: Digital twins require continuous maintenance to meet the increasing demand for high-precision geospatial data. However, traditional coarse CityGML building models, typically derived from Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS), often exhibit significant geometric deficiencies, particularly regarding facade accuracy due to the nadir perspective of airborne sensors. Integrating these coarse models with high-precision Mobile Laser Scanning (MLS) data is essential to recover detailed facade geometry. Unlike reconstruction-from-scratch approaches that discard existing semantic information and rely heavily on complete data coverage, this work presents an automated refinement framework that utilizes the coarse model as a geometric prior. This method enables targeted updates to facade geometry even in complex urban environments. It integrates surface matching to identify outdated surfaces and employs a binary integer optimization to select optimal faces from candidate data. Crucially, hard constraints are enforced within the optimization to ensure the topological validity of the refined output. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively corrects facade misalignments, reducing the Cloud-to-Mesh RMSE by approximately 36% and achieving centimeter-level alignment. Furthermore, the framework guarantees strictly watertight and manifold geometry, providing a robust solution for upgrading ALS-derived city models.
tldr: This paper presents an automated framework for refining 3D building facade geometry in CityGML models by integrating them with high-precision mobile laser scanning data, ensuring watertight output through surface matching and optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自动化框架，通过整合高精度移动激光扫描数据来细化CityGML模型中的建筑立面几何，利用表面匹配和优化确保输出几何的密闭性。
summary_zh: 数字孪生需要持续维护以满足日益增长的高精度地理空间数据需求。然而，传统的粗粒度CityGML建筑模型通常源自机载激光扫描（ALS）数据，由于机载传感器的天底视角特性，往往存在显著的几何缺陷，特别是立面精度不足。将这些粗粒度模型与高精度移动激光扫描（MLS）数据相结合，对于恢复精细的立面几何结构至关重要。不同于完全依赖数据完整覆盖且抛弃现有语义信息的从头重建方法，本研究提出了一种自动化优化框架，利用粗粒度模型作为几何先验。该方法即使在复杂城市环境中也能实现对立面几何的定向更新，通过表面匹配识别过时表面，并采用二进制整数优化从候选数据中选择最优面片。优化过程中强制施加的硬约束条件，确保了优化输出结果的拓扑有效性。实验结果表明，所提方法有效修正了立面错位问题，将点云到网格的均方根误差降低了约36%，实现了厘米级精度的对齐。此外，该框架保证了严格的水密性和流形几何特性，为升级基于ALS的城市模型提供了稳健的解决方案。

title: Imagine Before Concentration: Diffusion-Guided Registers Enhance Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) aims to retrieve untrimmed videos based on text queries that describe only partial events. Existing methods suffer from incomplete global contextual perception, struggling with query ambiguity and local noise induced by spurious responses. To address these issues, we propose DreamPRVR, which adopts a coarse-to-fine representation learning paradigm. The model first generates global contextual semantic registers as coarse-grained highlights spanning the entire video and then concentrates on fine-grained similarity optimization for precise cross-modal matching. Concretely, these registers are generated by initializing from the video-centric distribution produced by a probabilistic variational sampler and then iteratively refined via a text-supervised truncated diffusion model. During this process, textual semantic structure learning constructs a well-formed textual latent space, enhancing the reliability of global perception. The registers are then adaptively fused with video tokens through register-augmented Gaussian attention blocks, enabling context-aware feature learning. Extensive experiments show that DreamPRVR outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is released at https://github.com/lijun2005/CVPR26-DreamPRVR.
tldr: This paper proposes DreamPRVR, a method for partially relevant video retrieval that uses a diffusion model to generate global semantic registers from videos, which are then fused with video tokens for improved cross-modal matching.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DreamPRVR方法，用于部分相关视频检索。它使用扩散模型从视频中生成全局语义寄存器，然后与视频标记融合，以改进跨模态匹配。
summary_zh: 部分相关视频检索（PRVR）旨在基于仅描述部分事件的文本查询来检索未剪辑视频。现有方法存在全局上下文感知不完整的问题，难以处理查询歧义以及由伪响应引起的局部噪声。为解决这些问题，我们提出DreamPRVR，采用由粗到细的表征学习范式。该模型首先生成全局上下文语义寄存器作为跨越整个视频的粗粒度亮点，随后专注于细粒度相似度优化以实现精确的跨模态匹配。具体而言，这些寄存器通过从概率变分采样器生成的以视频为中心的分布进行初始化，并借助文本监督的截断扩散模型进行迭代优化。在此过程中，文本语义结构学习构建了结构良好的文本潜空间，增强了全局感知的可靠性。随后，寄存器通过寄存器增强的高斯注意力块与视频标记进行自适应融合，实现上下文感知的特征学习。大量实验表明，DreamPRVR在性能上超越了现有先进方法。代码发布于https://github.com/lijun2005/CVPR26-DreamPRVR。

title: ComPrivDet: Efficient Privacy Object Detection in Compressed Domains Through Inference Reuse
summary: As the Internet of Things (IoT) becomes deeply embedded in daily life, users are increasingly concerned about privacy leakage, especially from video data. Since frame-by-frame protection in large-scale video analytics (e.g., smart communities) introduces significant latency, a more efficient solution is to selectively protect frames containing privacy objects (e.g., faces). Existing object detectors require fully decoded videos or per-frame processing in compressed videos, leading to decoding overhead or reduced accuracy. Therefore, we propose ComPrivDet, an efficient method for detecting privacy objects in compressed video by reusing I-frame inference results. By identifying the presence of new objects through compressed-domain cues, ComPrivDet either skips P- and B-frame detections or efficiently refines them with a lightweight detector. ComPrivDet maintains 99.75% accuracy in private face detection and 96.83% in private license plate detection while skipping over 80% of inferences. It averages 9.84% higher accuracy with 75.95% lower latency than existing compressed-domain detection methods.
tldr: This paper introduces ComPrivDet, an efficient method for detecting privacy-sensitive objects like faces and license plates in compressed videos by reusing I-frame inference results, which skips over 80% of detections while maintaining high accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为ComPrivDet的高效方法，用于在压缩视频中检测隐私敏感对象（如人脸和车牌），通过重用I帧推理结果，跳过了80%以上的检测，同时保持了高精度。
summary_zh: 摘要：随着物联网深度融入日常生活，用户对隐私泄露问题日益关注，尤其是涉及视频数据的隐私风险。在大规模视频分析（如智慧社区）中逐帧进行隐私保护会引入显著延迟，因此更高效的解决方案是选择性保护包含隐私对象（如人脸）的帧。现有对象检测器需对视频进行完全解码或对压缩视频逐帧处理，导致解码开销增大或检测精度降低。为此，我们提出一种基于I帧推理结果复用的高效压缩视频隐私对象检测方法ComPrivDet。该方法通过压缩域线索识别新对象出现，进而跳过P帧与B帧检测，或使用轻量级检测器进行高效细化。ComPrivDet在隐私人脸检测中保持99.75%的准确率，在隐私车牌检测中保持96.83%的准确率，同时可跳过超过80%的推理计算。与现有压缩域检测方法相比，其平均准确率提升9.84%，延迟降低75.95%。

title: SAGE-GAN: Towards Realistic and Robust Segmentation of Spatially Ordered Nanoparticles via Attention-Guided GANs
summary: Precise analysis of nanoparticles for characterization in electron microscopy images is essential for advancing nanomaterial development. Yet it remains challenging due to the time-consuming nature of manual methods and the shortcomings of traditional automated segmentation techniques, especially when dealing with complex shapes and imaging artifacts. While conventional methods yield promising results, they depend on a large volume of labeled training data, which is both difficult to acquire and highly time-consuming to generate. In order to overcome these challenges, we have developed a two-step solution: Firstly, our system learns to segment the key features of nanoparticles from a dataset of real images using a self-attention driven U-Net architecture that focuses on important physical and morphological details while ignoring background features and noise. Secondly, this trained Attention U-Net is embedded in a cycle-consistent generative adversarial network (CycleGAN) framework, inspired by the cGAN-Seg model introduced by Abzargar et al. This integration allows for the creation of highly realistic synthetic electron microscopy image-mask pairs that naturally reflect the structural patterns learned by the Attention U-Net. Consequently, the model can accurately detect features in a diverse array of real-world nanoparticle images and autonomously augment the training dataset without requiring human input. Cycle consistency enforces a direct correspondence between synthetic images and ground-truth masks, ensuring realistic features, which is crucial for accurate segmentation training.
tldr: This paper proposes SAGE-GAN, a method combining a self-attention U-Net with a CycleGAN to generate realistic synthetic electron microscopy image-mask pairs for improving nanoparticle segmentation, addressing the challenge of scarce labeled data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SAGE-GAN，该方法结合了自注意力U-Net和CycleGAN，用于生成逼真的合成电子显微镜图像-掩模对，以改进纳米颗粒分割，解决了标注数据稀缺的挑战。
summary_zh: 对电子显微镜图像中的纳米颗粒进行精确分析以表征其特性，对于推动纳米材料发展至关重要。然而，由于手动方法耗时且传统自动分割技术存在局限性——尤其是在处理复杂形状和成像伪影时——这一任务仍然面临挑战。传统方法虽能产生有前景的结果，但依赖于大量标记训练数据，这些数据不仅难以获取且生成过程极为耗时。为克服这些难题，我们开发了一种两步解决方案：首先，系统通过基于自注意力机制的U-Net架构，从真实图像数据集中学习分割纳米颗粒的关键特征，该架构能聚焦于重要的物理与形态细节，同时忽略背景特征和噪声干扰；其次，受Abzargar等人提出的cGAN-Seg模型启发，将训练好的注意力U-Net嵌入循环一致生成对抗网络框架中。这种集成方式能够生成高度逼真的合成电子显微镜图像-掩码对，其自然地体现了注意力U-Net学习到的结构特征。因此，该模型能准确检测各类真实纳米颗粒图像中的特征，并无需人工干预即可自主扩展训练数据集。循环一致性机制确保了合成图像与其对应真实掩码间的直接对应关系，从而保障了特征的真实性，这对实现精确分割训练至关重要。

title: Can Natural Image Autoencoders Compactly Tokenize fMRI Volumes for Long-Range Dynamics Modeling?
summary: Modeling long-range spatiotemporal dynamics in functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) remains a key challenge due to the high dimensionality of the four-dimensional signals. Prior voxel-based models, although demonstrating excellent performance and interpretation capabilities, are constrained by prohibitive memory demands and thus can only capture limited temporal windows. To address this, we propose TABLeT (Two-dimensionally Autoencoded Brain Latent Transformer), a novel approach that tokenizes fMRI volumes using a pre-trained 2D natural image autoencoder. Each 3D fMRI volume is compressed into a compact set of continuous tokens, enabling long-sequence modeling with a simple Transformer encoder with limited VRAM. Across large-scale benchmarks including the UK-Biobank (UKB), Human Connectome Project (HCP), and ADHD-200 datasets, TABLeT outperforms existing models in multiple tasks, while demonstrating substantial gains in computational and memory efficiency over the state-of-the-art voxel-based method given the same input. Furthermore, we develop a self-supervised masked token modeling approach to pre-train TABLeT, which improves the model's performance for various downstream tasks. Our findings suggest a promising approach for scalable and interpretable spatiotemporal modeling of brain activity. Our code is available at https://github.com/beotborry/TABLeT.
tldr: The paper proposes a method to compress fMRI brain activity data into tokens using a natural image autoencoder, enabling efficient long-range spatiotemporal modeling with a Transformer, and demonstrates improved performance on neuroscience datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用自然图像自动编码器将fMRI脑活动数据压缩为令牌的方法，通过Transformer实现了高效的长程时空建模，并在多个神经科学数据集上展示了性能提升。
summary_zh: 摘要：在功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）中，由于四维信号的高维度特性，建模长距离时空动态仍是一个关键挑战。先前的基于体素的方法虽展现出优异的性能和解释能力，却受限于极高的内存需求，因而只能捕捉有限的时间窗口。为此，我们提出 TABLeT（二维自编码大脑潜在变换器），这是一种新方法，它利用预训练的二维自然图像自编码器对 fMRI 体积进行标记化处理。每个三维 fMRI 体积被压缩成一组紧凑的连续标记，使得在显存受限的情况下，仅使用简单的变换器编码器即可实现长序列建模。通过在包括英国生物库（UKB）、人类连接组计划（HCP）和 ADHD-200 数据集在内的大规模基准测试中验证，TABLeT 在多项任务中均优于现有模型，并在相同输入条件下，相比当前最先进的基于体素的方法在计算和内存效率方面取得显著提升。此外，我们开发了一种自监督的掩蔽标记建模方法来预训练 TABLeT，该方法提升了模型在各类下游任务中的表现。我们的研究结果表明，这是一种具有前景的大脑活动可扩展与可解释时空建模方法。代码可在 https://github.com/beotborry/TABLeT 获取。

title: PortraitCraft: A Benchmark for Portrait Composition Understanding and Generation
summary: Portrait composition plays a central role in portrait aesthetics and visual communication, yet existing datasets and benchmarks mainly focus on coarse aesthetic scoring, generic image aesthetics, or unconstrained portrait generation. This limits systematic research on structured portrait composition analysis and controllable portrait generation under explicit composition requirements. In this paper, we introduce PortraitCraft, a unified benchmark for portrait composition understanding and generation. PortraitCraft is built on a dataset of approximately 50,000 curated real portrait images with structured multi-level supervision, including global composition scores, annotations over 13 composition attributes, attribute-level explanation texts, visual question answering pairs, and composition-oriented textual descriptions for generation. Based on this dataset, we establish two complementary benchmark tasks for composition understanding and composition-aware generation within a unified framework. The first evaluates portrait composition understanding through score prediction, fine-grained attribute reasoning, and image-grounded visual question answering, while the second evaluates portrait generation from structured composition descriptions under explicit composition constraints. We further define standardized evaluation protocols and provide reference baseline results with representative multimodal models. PortraitCraft provides a comprehensive benchmark for future research on fine-grained portrait understanding, interpretable aesthetic assessment, and controllable portrait generation.
tldr: The paper introduces PortraitCraft, a benchmark with a dataset of 50,000 portraits for tasks in fine-grained portrait composition understanding (like scoring and reasoning) and composition-aware portrait generation under explicit constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PortraitCraft，一个包含5万张人像图像的数据集和基准，用于细粒度人像构图理解（如评分、推理）和在明确构图约束下进行构图感知的人像生成任务。
summary_zh: 肖像构图在人像美学与视觉传达中占据核心地位，然而现有数据集与评测基准主要集中于粗粒度美学评分、通用图像美学评估或无约束人像生成。这限制了在明确构图要求下进行结构化肖像构图分析与可控肖像生成的系统性研究。本文提出PortraitCraft——一个面向肖像构图理解与生成的统一基准框架。该框架基于包含约5万张精选真实肖像图像的数据集构建，具备结构化多层次标注体系，包括整体构图评分、13项构图属性标注、属性级解释文本、视觉问答对以及面向生成任务的构图导向文本描述。基于此数据集，我们在统一框架内建立了构图理解与构图感知生成两项互补的基准任务：前者通过构图评分预测、细粒度属性推理及基于图像的视觉问答来评估肖像构图理解能力；后者则在明确构图约束条件下评估基于结构化描述的肖像生成能力。我们进一步制定了标准化评估协议，并提供了基于代表性多模态模型的参考基线结果。PortraitCraft为未来细粒度肖像理解、可解释美学评估与可控肖像生成研究提供了全面系统的评测基准。

title: Physics-Informed Untrained Learning for RGB-Guided Superresolution Single-Pixel Hyperspectral Imaging
summary: Single-pixel imaging (SPI) offers a cost-effective route to hyperspectral acquisition but struggles to recover high-fidelity spatial and spectral details under extremely low sampling rates, a severely ill-posed inverse problem. While deep learning has shown potential, existing data-driven methods demand large-scale pretraining datasets that are often impractical in hyperspectral imaging. To overcome this limitation, we propose an end-to-end physics-informed framework that leverages untrained neural networks and RGB guidance for joint hyperspectral reconstruction and super-resolution without any external training data. The framework comprises three physically grounded stages: (1) a Regularized Least-Squares method with RGB-derived Grayscale Priors (LS-RGP) that initializes the solution by exploiting cross-modal structural correlations; (2) an Untrained Hyperspectral Recovery Network (UHRNet) that refines the reconstruction through measurement consistency and hybrid regularization; and (3) a Transformer-based Untrained Super-Resolution Network (USRNet) that upsamples the spatial resolution via cross-modal attention, transferring high-frequency details from the RGB guide. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly surpasses state-of-the-art algorithms in both reconstruction accuracy and spectral fidelity. Moreover, a proof-of-concept experiment using a physical single-pixel imaging system validates the framework's practical applicability, successfully reconstructing a 144-band hyperspectral data cube at a mere 6.25% sampling rate. The proposed method thus provides a robust, data-efficient solution for computational hyperspectral imaging.
tldr: This paper proposes a physics-informed, untrained neural network framework for reconstructing super-resolution hyperspectral images from single-pixel measurements using RGB guidance, without requiring external training data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于物理信息、无需训练的神经网络框架，利用RGB图像引导，从单像素测量数据中重建超分辨率高光谱图像，且无需外部训练数据。
summary_zh: 单像素成像为实现高光谱获取提供了一条经济高效的路径，但在极低采样率下恢复高保真空间与光谱细节仍面临严重病态逆问题的挑战。尽管深度学习展现出潜力，但现有数据驱动方法需要大规模预训练数据集，这在高光谱成像中往往难以实现。为突破这一局限，本研究提出一种端到端的物理信息融合框架，利用未经训练的神经网络与RGB引导，在无需任何外部训练数据的情况下实现高光谱重建与超分辨率的联合优化。该框架包含三个基于物理机理的层级：(1) 采用RGB衍生的灰度先验正则化最小二乘法，通过跨模态结构相关性初始化解决方案；(2) 构建未经训练的高光谱重建网络，通过测量一致性约束与混合正则化优化重建结果；(3) 设计基于Transformer的未经训练超分辨率网络，借助跨模态注意力机制提升空间分辨率，从RGB引导图像中迁移高频细节。在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，本方法在重建精度与光谱保真度上均显著超越现有先进算法。此外，通过物理单像素成像系统开展的概念验证实验，成功在仅6.25%的采样率下重建出144波段的高光谱数据立方体，证实了该框架的实际应用价值。本方法为计算高光谱成像领域提供了一种鲁棒性强、数据效率高的解决方案。

title: LOGER: Local--Global Ensemble for Robust Deepfake Detection in the Wild
summary: Robust deepfake detection in the wild remains challenging due to the ever-growing variety of manipulation techniques and uncontrolled real-world degradations. Forensic cues for deepfake detection reside at two complementary levels: global-level anomalies in semantics and statistics that require holistic image understanding, and local-level forgery traces concentrated in manipulated regions that are easily diluted by global averaging. Since no single backbone or input scale can effectively cover both levels, we propose LOGER, a LOcal--Global Ensemble framework for Robust deepfake detection. The global branch employs heterogeneous vision foundation model backbones at multiple resolutions to capture holistic anomalies with diverse visual priors. The local branch performs patch-level modeling with a Multiple Instance Learning top-$k$ aggregation strategy that selectively pools only the most suspicious regions, mitigating evidence dilution caused by the dominance of normal patches; dual-level supervision at both the aggregated image level and individual patch level keeps local responses discriminative. Because the two branches differ in both granularity and backbone, their errors are largely decorrelated, a property that logit-space fusion exploits for more robust prediction. LOGER achieves 2nd place in the NTIRE 2026 Robust Deepfake Detection Challenge, and further evaluation on multiple public benchmarks confirms its strong robustness and generalization across diverse manipulation methods and real-world degradation conditions.
tldr: This paper proposes LOGER, a local-global ensemble framework for robust deepfake detection in the wild, combining multi-scale vision foundation models with patch-level modeling and top-k aggregation. It addresses the challenge of detecting diverse and degraded deepfakes, achieving strong performance on benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LOGER，一个用于野外鲁棒深度伪造检测的局部-全局集成框架，它结合了多尺度视觉基础模型与补丁级建模和top-k聚合策略。该方法旨在解决检测多样化和降质深度伪造的难题，并在多个公共基准测试中表现出色。
summary_zh: 摘要：由于不断涌现的各种篡改技术和不可控的现实世界退化，在真实场景下实现鲁棒的深度伪造检测仍面临挑战。深度伪造检测的取证线索存在于两个互补层面：一是需要整体图像理解的语义和统计层面的全局异常，二是集中于篡改区域的局部伪造痕迹，这些痕迹容易被全局平均操作所稀释。由于单一骨干网络或输入尺度无法有效覆盖这两个层面，我们提出了一种局部-全局集成框架（LOGER），用于实现鲁棒的深度伪造检测。全局分支采用多分辨率异构视觉基础模型骨干网络，以多样的视觉先验捕获整体异常；局部分支通过多示例学习的前k聚合策略进行块级建模，选择性地汇集最可疑的区域，从而缓解正常区域主导导致的证据稀释问题；同时，在聚合图像层面和单个图像块层面的双重监督机制保持了局部响应的判别力。由于两个分支在粒度和骨干网络上均存在差异，其误差在很大程度上不相关，逻辑空间融合利用这一特性实现了更鲁棒的预测。LOGER在NTIRE 2026鲁棒深度伪造检测挑战赛中荣获第二名，在多个公共基准上的进一步评估验证了其对于不同篡改方法和现实世界退化条件均具备强鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: HEDGE: Heterogeneous Ensemble for Detection of AI-GEnerated Images in the Wild
summary: Robust detection of AI-generated images in the wild remains challenging due to the rapid evolution of generative models and varied real-world distortions. We argue that relying on a single training regime, resolution, or backbone is insufficient to handle all conditions, and that structured heterogeneity across these dimensions is essential for robust detection. To this end, we propose HEDGE, a Heterogeneous Ensemble for Detection of AI-GEnerated images, that introduces complementary detection routes along three axes: diverse training data with strong augmentation, multi-scale feature extraction, and backbone heterogeneity. Specifically, Route~A progressively constructs DINOv3-based detectors through staged data expansion and augmentation escalation, Route~B incorporates a higher-resolution branch for fine-grained forensic cues, and Route~C adds a MetaCLIP2-based branch for backbone diversity. All outputs are fused via logit-space weighted averaging, refined by a lightweight dual-gating mechanism that handles branch-level outliers and majority-dominated fusion errors. HEDGE achieves 4th place in the NTIRE 2026 Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild Challenge and attains state-of-the-art performance with strong robustness on multiple AIGC image detection benchmarks.
tldr: This paper introduces HEDGE, a heterogeneous ensemble method for detecting AI-generated images in the wild by combining diverse training data, multi-scale features, and backbone architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为HEDGE的异构集成方法，用于在现实场景中检测AI生成的图像，该方法通过结合多样化的训练数据、多尺度特征和骨干网络架构来实现。
summary_zh: 由于生成模型的快速演变和现实世界中多样化的失真，对野外AI生成图像进行鲁棒检测仍然具有挑战性。我们认为，依赖单一的训练策略、分辨率或骨干网络不足以处理所有情况，而在这些维度上构建结构化的异构性对于实现鲁棒检测至关重要。为此，我们提出HEDGE——一种用于检测AI生成图像的异构集成方法，该方法通过三个维度引入互补的检测路径：采用强增强的多样化训练数据、多尺度特征提取以及骨干网络异构性。具体而言，路径A通过分阶段的数据扩展和增强升级，逐步构建基于DINOv3的检测器；路径B引入更高分辨率的分支以捕捉细粒度取证线索；路径C则加入基于MetaCLIP2的分支以实现骨干网络多样性。所有输出通过逻辑空间加权平均进行融合，并采用轻量级双门控机制进行优化，以处理分支级异常值和多数主导的融合误差。HEDGE在NTIRE 2026野外鲁棒AI生成图像检测挑战赛中荣获第四名，并在多个AIGC图像检测基准测试中取得了最先进的性能表现，展现出强大的鲁棒性。

title: Multimodal Urban Tree Detection from Satellite and Street-Level Imagery via Annotation-Efficient Deep Learning Strategies
summary: Beyond the immediate biophysical benefits, urban trees play a foundational role in environmental sustainability and disaster mitigation. Precise mapping of urban trees is essential for environmental monitoring, post-disaster assessment, and strengthening policy. However, the transition from traditional, labor-intensive field surveys to scalable automated systems remains limited by high annotation costs and poor generalization across diverse urban scenarios. This study introduces a multimodal framework that integrates high-resolution satellite imagery with ground-level Google Street View to enable scalable and detailed urban tree detection under limited-annotation conditions. The framework first leverages satellite imagery to localize tree candidates and then retrieves targeted ground-level views for detailed detection, significantly reducing inefficient street-level sampling. To address the annotation bottleneck, domain adaptation is used to transfer knowledge from an existing annotated dataset to a new region of interest. To further minimize human effort, we evaluated three learning strategies: semi-supervised learning, active learning, and a hybrid approach combining both, using a transformer-based detection model. The hybrid strategy achieved the best performance with an F1-score of 0.90, representing a 12% improvement over the baseline model. In contrast, semi-supervised learning exhibited progressive performance degradation due to confirmation bias in pseudo-labeling, while active learning steadily improved results through targeted human intervention to label uncertain or incorrect predictions. Error analysis further showed that active and hybrid strategies reduced both false positives and false negatives. Our findings highlight the importance of a multimodal approach and guided annotation for scalable, annotation-efficient urban tree mapping to strengthen sustainable city planning.
tldr: This paper presents a multimodal deep learning framework for efficient urban tree detection using satellite and street-level imagery, employing semi-supervised and active learning to reduce annotation costs.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种利用卫星和街景图像进行高效城市树木检测的多模态深度学习框架，结合半监督和主动学习以降低标注成本。
summary_zh: 除了直接的生物物理效益外，城市树木还在环境可持续性和灾害缓解中发挥着基础性作用。精确的城市树木测绘对于环境监测、灾后评估以及强化政策制定至关重要。然而，从传统劳动密集型实地调查向可扩展自动化系统的转变，仍受限于高标注成本及在不同城市场景中的泛化能力不足。本研究提出了一种多模态框架，通过整合高分辨率卫星图像与地面谷歌街景图像，在有限标注条件下实现可扩展、精细化的城市树木检测。该框架首先利用卫星图像定位候选树木，随后检索针对性地面视角进行详细检测，显著减少了低效的街景采样。为应对标注瓶颈，研究采用领域自适应技术将现有标注数据集的知识迁移到新目标区域。为进一步减少人工工作量，我们基于Transformer检测模型评估了三种学习策略：半监督学习、主动学习及两者结合的混合策略。其中混合策略以0.90的F1分数取得最佳性能，较基线模型提升12%。相比之下，半监督学习因伪标注中的确认偏差导致性能逐步下降，而主动学习则通过针对性人工标注不确定或错误预测实现了稳定提升。误差分析进一步表明，主动学习与混合策略有效降低了误报和漏检率。我们的研究结果凸显了多模态方法与引导式标注对于实现可扩展、高效标注的城市树木测绘的重要性，从而为可持续城市规划提供支持。

title: DRIFT: Deep Restoration, ISP Fusion, and Tone-mapping
summary: Smartphone cameras have gained immense popularity with the adoption of high-resolution and high-dynamic range imaging. As a result, high-performance camera Image Signal Processors (ISPs) are crucial in generating high-quality images for the end user while keeping computational costs low. In this paper, we propose DRIFT (Deep Restoration, ISP Fusion, and Tone-mapping): an efficient AI mobile camera pipeline that generates high quality RGB images from hand-held raw captures. The first stage of DRIFT is a Multi-Frame Processing (MFP) network that is trained using a adversarial perceptual loss to perform multi-frame alignment, denoising, demosaicing, and super-resolution. Then, the output of DRIFT-MFP is processed by a novel deep-learning based tone-mapping (DRIFT-TM) solution that allows for tone tunability, ensures tone-consistency with a reference pipeline, and can be run efficiently for high-resolution images on a mobile device. We show qualitative and quantitative comparisons against state-of-the-art MFP and tone-mapping methods to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
tldr: The paper proposes DRIFT, a deep learning-based mobile camera pipeline for generating high-quality RGB images from raw captures, involving multi-frame processing and tone-mapping.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为DRIFT的深度学习移动相机流水线，用于从原始手持拍摄中生成高质量的RGB图像，涉及多帧处理和色调映射。
summary_zh: 随着高分辨率与高动态范围成像技术的普及，智能手机相机已获得广泛应用。因此，高性能的相机图像信号处理器（ISP）对在保持较低计算成本的同时为用户生成高质量图像至关重要。本文提出DRIFT（深度恢复、ISP融合与色调映射）：一种高效的人工智能移动相机处理流程，能够从手持设备拍摄的原始图像中生成高质量的RGB图像。DRIFT的第一阶段为多帧处理网络（MFP），该网络采用对抗感知损失进行训练，以执行多帧对齐、去噪、去马赛克及超分辨率处理。随后，DRIFT-MFP的输出结果由一种新型的基于深度学习的色调映射方案（DRIFT-TM）处理，该方案支持色调可调性，确保与参考处理流程的色调一致性，并能在移动设备上对高分辨率图像高效运行。我们通过定性与定量对比分析，将所提方法与当前先进的多帧处理及色调映射技术进行比较，证明了本方法的有效性。

title: Debiased Machine Learning for Conformal Prediction of Counterfactual Outcomes Under Runtime Confounding
summary: Data-driven decision making frequently relies on predicting counterfactual outcomes. In practice, researchers commonly train counterfactual prediction models on a source dataset to inform decisions on a possibly separate target population. Conformal prediction has arisen as a popular method for producing assumption-lean prediction intervals for counterfactual outcomes that would arise under different treatment decisions in the target population of interest. However, existing methods require that every confounding factor of the treatment-outcome relationship used for training on the source data is additionally measured in the target population, risking miscoverage if important confounders are unmeasured in the target population. In this paper, we introduce a computationally efficient debiased machine learning framework that allows for valid prediction intervals when only a subset of confounders is measured in the target population, a common challenge referred to as runtime confounding. Grounded in semiparametric efficiency theory, we show the resulting prediction intervals achieve desired coverage rates with faster convergence compared to standard methods. Through numerous synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments, we demonstrate the utility of our proposed method.
tldr: This paper introduces a debiased machine learning framework for producing valid conformal prediction intervals for counterfactual outcomes when only a subset of confounders is measured in the target population, addressing the challenge of runtime confounding.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种去偏机器学习框架，用于在目标群体中仅测量部分混杂因素时，为反事实结果生成有效的共形预测区间，以解决运行时混杂这一常见挑战。
summary_zh: 数据驱动的决策制定通常依赖于对反事实结果的预测。实践中，研究人员通常基于源数据集训练反事实预测模型，以便为可能独立的目标群体提供决策依据。保形预测已成为一种流行方法，可为目标群体在不同治疗决策下产生的反事实结果提供假设宽松的预测区间。然而，现有方法要求源数据训练中使用的治疗-结果关系所有混杂因素都必须在目标群体中得到额外测量，若目标群体中未测量重要混杂因素，则可能导致覆盖率失准。本文提出一种计算效率高的去偏机器学习框架，当目标群体中仅测量部分混杂因素时（这一常见挑战被称为"运行时混杂"），仍能产生有效的预测区间。基于半参数效率理论，我们证明相较于标准方法，所得预测区间能以更快的收敛速度达到期望覆盖率。通过大量合成与半合成实验，我们验证了所提方法的实用性。

title: The Generalised Kernel Covariance Measure
summary: We consider the problem of conditional independence (CI) testing and adopt a kernel-based approach. Kernel-based CI tests embed variables in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, regress their embeddings on the conditioning variables, and test the resulting residuals for marginal independence. This approach yields tests that are sensitive to a broad range of conditional dependencies. Existing methods, however, rely heavily on kernel ridge regression, which is computationally expensive when properly tuned and yields poorly calibrated tests when left untuned, which limits their practical usefulness. We propose the Generalised Kernel Covariance Measure (GKCM), a regression-model-agnostic kernel-based CI test that accommodates a broad class of regression estimators. Building on the Generalised Hilbertian Covariance Measure framework (Lundborg et al., 2022), we characterise conditions under which GKCM satisfies uniform asymptotic level guarantees. In simulations, GKCM paired with tree-based regression models frequently outperforms state-of-the-art CI tests across a diverse range of data-generating processes, achieving better type I error control and competitive or superior power.
tldr: The paper introduces a new kernel-based test for conditional independence that is more flexible and efficient than existing methods by allowing the use of a broader class of regression estimators.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于核的条件独立性检验方法，该方法通过允许使用更广泛的回归估计器，比现有方法更灵活和高效。
summary_zh: 本文研究条件独立性检验问题，并采用基于核函数的方法。基于核函数的条件独立性检验将变量嵌入到再生核希尔伯特空间中，将其嵌入表示对条件变量进行回归，并检验所得残差的边际独立性。这种方法能够检测广泛类型的条件依赖关系。然而，现有方法严重依赖核岭回归：在合理调参时计算成本高昂，若不调参则检验校准效果较差，这限制了其实用性。我们提出广义核协方差度量——一种与回归模型无关的基于核函数的条件独立性检验方法，可兼容多种回归估计器。基于广义希尔伯特协方差度量框架（Lundborg等，2022），我们刻画了GKCM满足一致渐近水平保证的理论条件。在模拟实验中，GKCM与基于树的回归模型结合后，在多种数据生成过程中常优于现有先进的条件独立性检验方法，实现了更优的Ⅰ类错误控制能力，并具备相当或更优的检验功效。

title: Algebraic Diversity: Group-Theoretic Spectral Estimation from Single Observations
summary: We prove that temporal averaging over multiple observations can be replaced by algebraic group action on a single observation for second-order statistical estimation. A General Replacement Theorem establishes conditions under which a group-averaged estimator from one snapshot achieves equivalent subspace decomposition to multi-snapshot covariance estimation, and an Optimality Theorem proves that the symmetric group is universally optimal (yielding the KL transform). The framework unifies the DFT, DCT, and KLT as special cases of group-matched spectral transforms, with a closed-form double-commutator eigenvalue problem for polynomial-time optimal group selection. Five applications are demonstrated: MUSIC DOA estimation from a single snapshot, massive MIMO channel estimation with 64% throughput gain, single-pulse waveform classification at 90% accuracy, graph signal processing with non-Abelian groups, and a new algebraic analysis of transformer LLMs revealing that RoPE uses the wrong algebraic group for 70-80% of attention heads across five models (22,480 head observations), that the optimal group is content-dependent, and that spectral-concentration-based pruning improves perplexity at the 13B scale. All diagnostics require a single forward pass with no gradients or training.
tldr: The paper presents a theoretical framework for replacing temporal averaging with algebraic group actions on single observations for second-order statistical estimation, with applications in signal processing, communications, and a novel analysis of transformer LLMs, but no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种理论框架，利用单次观测的代数群作用替代时间平均进行二阶统计估计，应用于信号处理、通信和对LLM的新分析，但与机器人学或具身AI无直接关联。
summary_zh: 我们证明，在二阶统计估计中，多观测值的时间平均可被单次观测上的代数群作用所替代。广义替换定理确立了在何种条件下，基于单次快照的群平均估计器能够实现与多快照协方差估计相同的子空间分解，而最优性定理则证明对称群是普遍最优的（即产生KL变换）。该框架将DFT、DCT和KLT统一为群匹配谱变换的特例，并通过闭式的双交换子特征值问题，实现了多项式时间内的最优群选择。本文展示了五个应用：基于单次快照的MUSIC波达方向估计、具有64%吞吐量增益的大规模MIMO信道估计、准确率达90%的单脉冲波形分类、非阿贝尔群上的图信号处理，以及对变压器大语言模型的新代数分析——该分析揭示了RoPE在五个模型（22,480个头注意力观测值）中70%-80%的注意力头使用了错误的代数群，最优群具有内容依赖性，且基于谱集中的剪枝方法可在130亿参数规模上提升困惑度指标。所有诊断仅需单次前向传播，无需梯度计算或训练。

title: BlazeFL: Fast and Deterministic Federated Learning Simulation
summary: Federated learning (FL) research increasingly relies on single-node simulations with hundreds or thousands of virtual clients, making both efficiency and reproducibility essential. Yet parallel client training often introduces nondeterminism through shared random state and scheduling variability, forcing researchers to trade throughput for reproducibility or to implement custom control logic within complex frameworks. We present BlazeFL, a lightweight framework for single-node FL simulation that alleviates this trade-off through free-threaded shared-memory execution and deterministic randomness management. BlazeFL uses thread-based parallelism with in-memory parameter exchange between the server and clients, avoiding serialization and inter-process communication overhead. To support deterministic execution, BlazeFL assigns isolated random number generator (RNG) streams to clients. Under a fixed software/hardware stack, and when stochastic operators consume BlazeFL-managed generators, this design yields bitwise-identical results across repeated high-concurrency runs in both thread-based and process-based modes. In CIFAR-10 image-classification experiments, BlazeFL substantially reduces execution time relative to a widely used open-source baseline, achieving up to 3.1$\times$ speedup on communication-dominated workloads while preserving a lightweight dependency footprint. Our open-source implementation is available at: https://github.com/kitsuyaazuma/blazefl.
tldr: BlazeFL is a fast, deterministic, single-node simulation framework for federated learning, designed to improve efficiency and reproducibility in parallel client training.
tldr_zh: BlazeFL是一个用于联邦学习的快速、确定性的单节点仿真框架，旨在提高并行客户端训练的效率和可重复性。
summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）研究日益依赖于包含数百或数千个虚拟客户的单节点模拟，这使得高效性与可复现性变得至关重要。然而，并行客户训练常因共享的随机状态与调度可变性引入不确定性，迫使研究人员必须在高吞吐量与可复现性之间做出取舍，或是在复杂框架内实现自定义控制逻辑。本文提出了BlazeFL，一个用于单节点联邦学习模拟的轻量级框架，通过无锁线程共享内存执行与确定性随机性管理，缓解了上述取舍问题。BlazeFL采用基于线程的并行机制，在服务器与客户之间进行内存参数交换，避免了序列化与进程间通信的开销。为支持确定性执行，BlazeFL为每个客户分配了独立的随机数生成器（RNG）序列。在固定的软硬件环境下，当随机算子使用由BlazeFL管理的生成器时，该设计能在基于线程与基于进程的两种模式下，保证高并发多次运行的比特级结果一致性。在CIFAR-10图像分类实验中，相比广泛使用的开源基准框架，BlazeFL显著缩短了执行时间，在以通信为主的工作负载上实现了高达3.1倍的加速，同时保持了轻量级的依赖规模。我们的开源实现已发布于：https://github.com/kitsuyaazuma/blazefl。

title: Rethinking Token Prediction: Tree-Structured Diffusion Language Model
summary: Discrete diffusion language models have emerged as a competitive alternative to auto-regressive language models, but training them efficiently under limited parameter and memory budgets remains challenging. Modern architectures are predominantly based on a full-vocabulary token prediction layer, which accounts for a substantial fraction of model parameters (e.g., more than 20% in small scale DiT-style designs) and often dominates peak GPU memory usage. This leads to inefficient use of both parameters and memory under constrained training resources. To address this issue, we revisit the necessity of explicit full-vocabulary prediction, and instead exploit the inherent structure among tokens to build a tree-structured diffusion language model. Specifically, we model the diffusion process with intermediate latent states corresponding to a token's ancestor nodes in a pre-constructed vocabulary tree. This tree-structured factorization exponentially reduces the classification dimensionality, makes the prediction head negligible in size, and enables reallocation of parameters to deepen the attention blocks. Empirically, under the same parameter budget, our method reduces peak GPU memory usage by half while matching the perplexity performance of state-of-the-art discrete diffusion language models.
tldr: The paper introduces a tree-structured diffusion language model that reduces the classification dimensionality of the prediction head, significantly lowering GPU memory usage while maintaining performance compared to standard discrete diffusion language models.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种树状结构的扩散语言模型，通过减少预测头的分类维度，显著降低了GPU内存使用，同时保持了与标准离散扩散语言模型相当的性能。
summary_zh: 离散扩散语言模型已成为自回归语言模型的有力竞争者，但如何在有限参数量和内存预算下高效训练这些模型仍面临挑战。现代架构主要基于全词汇表标记预测层，该部分占据模型参数总量的显著比例（例如在小规模DiT风格设计中超过20%），且常主导GPU峰值内存使用。这导致在受限训练资源下参数与内存的利用效率低下。为解决此问题，我们重新审视了显式全词汇表预测的必要性，转而利用标记间的内在结构构建树状结构扩散语言模型。具体而言，我们通过对应于预构建词汇树中标记祖先节点的中间隐状态来建模扩散过程。这种树状结构因式分解将分类维度指数级降低，使预测头尺寸可忽略不计，并能将参数重新分配至更深的注意力模块。实验表明，在相同参数量预算下，本方法将GPU峰值内存使用降低一半，同时达到与最先进离散扩散语言模型相匹敌的困惑度性能。

title: Nonparametric Regression Discontinuity Designs with Survival Outcomes
summary: Quasi-experimental evaluations are central for generating real-world causal evidence and complementing insights from randomized trials. The regression discontinuity design (RDD) is a quasi-experimental design that can be used to estimate the causal effect of treatments that are assigned based on a running variable crossing a threshold. Such threshold-based rules are ubiquitous in healthcare, where predictive and prognostic biomarkers frequently guide treatment decisions. However, standard RD estimators rely on complete outcome data, an assumption often violated in time-to-event analyses where censoring arises from loss to follow-up. To address this issue, we propose a nonparametric approach that leverages doubly robust censoring corrections and can be paired with existing RD estimators. Our approach can handle multiple survival endpoints, long follow-up times, and covariate-dependent variation in survival and censoring. We discuss the relevance of our approach across multiple areas of applications and demonstrate its usefulness through simulations and the prostate component of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian (PLCO) Cancer Screening Trial where our new approach offers several advantages, including higher efficiency and robustness to misspecification. We have also developed an open-source software package, $\texttt{rdsurvival}$, for the $\texttt{R}$ language.
tldr: This paper proposes a nonparametric statistical method for estimating causal effects in quasi-experimental studies with time-to-event outcomes, addressing censoring issues in regression discontinuity designs.
tldr_zh: 本文针对存在数据删失的生存分析研究，提出了一种用于回归断点设计的非参数统计方法，以提高因果效应估计的效率和稳健性。
summary_zh: 准实验评估对于生成现实世界的因果证据、补充随机试验的见解至关重要。回归断点设计是一种准实验设计，可用于估计基于运行变量跨越阈值分配处理的因果效应。此类基于阈值的规则在医疗保健领域普遍存在，预测性和预后性生物标志物经常用于指导治疗决策。然而，标准RD估计量依赖于完整的结果数据，这一假设在时间-事件分析中常因失访导致的删失而被违背。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种非参数方法，利用双重稳健的删失校正，并能与现有RD估计量结合使用。我们的方法能处理多个生存终点、长随访时间以及生存和删失中协变量相关的变异。我们讨论了该方法在多个应用领域的相关性，并通过模拟和前列腺、肺、结直肠和卵巢癌症筛查试验的前列腺部分展示了其实用性，其中我们的新方法具有若干优势，包括更高的效率和更强的模型误设稳健性。我们还为$\texttt{R}$语言开发了一个开源软件包$\texttt{rdsurvival}$。

title: Investigating Data Interventions for Subgroup Fairness: An ICU Case Study
summary: In high-stakes settings where machine learning models are used to automate decision-making about individuals, the presence of algorithmic bias can exacerbate systemic harm to certain subgroups of people. These biases often stem from the underlying training data. In practice, interventions to "fix the data" depend on the actual additional data sources available -- where many are less than ideal. In these cases, the effects of data scaling on subgroup performance become volatile, as the improvements from increased sample size are counteracted by the introduction of distribution shifts in the training set. In this paper, we investigate the limitations of combining data sources to improve subgroup performance within the context of healthcare. Clinical models are commonly trained on datasets comprised of patient electronic health record (EHR) data from different hospitals or admission departments. Across two such datasets, the eICU Collaborative Research Database and the MIMIC-IV dataset, we find that data addition can both help and hurt model fairness and performance, and many intuitive strategies for data selection are unreliable. We compare model-based post-hoc calibration and data-centric addition strategies to find that the combination of both is important to improve subgroup performance. Our work questions the traditional dogma of "better data" for overcoming fairness challenges by comparing and combining data- and model-based approaches.
tldr: This paper investigates how combining data sources from different hospitals (eICU and MIMIC-IV) affects fairness and performance for subgroups in clinical prediction models, finding that intuitive data addition strategies are unreliable and suggesting combined data- and model-based approaches are needed.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了结合不同医院（eICU和MIMIC-IV）的数据源如何影响临床预测模型对亚组的公平性和性能，发现直观的数据添加策略并不可靠，建议需要结合数据和模型的方法。
summary_zh: 在运用机器学习模型对个体进行自动化决策的高风险场景中，算法偏见的存在可能会加剧对特定人群的系统性伤害。这些偏见往往源于底层训练数据。实践中，"修复数据"的干预措施取决于实际可用的额外数据源——而其中许多数据源并不理想。在这种情况下，数据规模对子群体表现的影响变得不稳定，因为样本量增加带来的改善会被训练集中分布偏移的引入所抵消。本文在医疗健康领域的背景下，研究了通过整合数据源提升子群体表现的局限性。临床模型通常基于来自不同医院或住院科室的患者电子健康记录（EHR）数据组成的训练集进行训练。通过对eICU协作研究数据库和MIMIC-IV数据集这两个典型案例的分析，我们发现数据补充既可能改善也可能损害模型的公平性与性能，且许多直观的数据选择策略并不可靠。我们比较了基于模型的后校准策略与以数据为中心的补充策略，发现二者结合对于提升子群体表现至关重要。本研究通过对比并融合数据导向与模型导向的方法，对传统"数据越优质越能解决公平性挑战"的教条提出了质疑。

title: Recurrent Quantum Feature Maps for Reservoir Computing
summary: Reservoir computing promises a fast method for handling large amounts of temporal data. This hinges on constructing a good reservoir--a dynamical system capable of transforming inputs into a high-dimensional representation while remembering properties of earlier data. In this work, we introduce a reservoir based on recurrent quantum feature maps where a fixed quantum circuit is reused to encode both current inputs and a classical feedback signal derived from previous outputs. We evaluate the model on the Mackey-Glass time-series prediction task using our recently introduced CP feature map, and find that it achieves lower mean squared error than standard classical baselines, including echo state networks and multilayer perceptrons, while maintaining compact circuit depth and qubit requirements. We further analyze memory capacity and show that the model effectively retains temporal information, consistent with its forecasting accuracy. Finally, we study the impact of realistic noise and find that performance is robust to several noise channels but remains sensitive to two-qubit gate errors, identifying a key limitation for near-term implementations.
tldr: This paper introduces a quantum reservoir computing model using recurrent quantum feature maps for time-series prediction, showing improved accuracy over classical baselines on the Mackey-Glass task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用循环量子特征映射的量子储层计算模型，用于时间序列预测，在Mackey-Glass任务上相比经典基线方法展现出更高的准确性。
summary_zh: 储层计算为实现快速处理大量时序数据提供了一种有前景的方法。其核心在于构建一个良好的储层——即一个能将输入数据转换为高维表示，同时保留早期数据特征信息的动态系统。本研究提出一种基于循环量子特征映射的储层结构，该结构通过重复使用固定量子电路，同时编码当前输入及来自先前输出的经典反馈信号。我们采用近期提出的CP特征映射，在Mackey-Glass时间序列预测任务上评估该模型，发现其均方误差低于标准经典基线模型（包括回声状态网络和多层感知机），同时保持了紧凑的电路深度和量子比特需求。我们进一步分析其记忆容量，结果表明该模型能有效保留时序信息，与其预测精度保持一致。最后，我们研究了实际噪声的影响，发现模型对多种噪声通道具有鲁棒性，但对双量子比特门误差仍较敏感，这指出了近期实现过程中的一个关键限制因素。

title: Earth Embeddings Reveal Diverse Urban Signals from Space
summary: Conventional urban indicators derived from censuses, surveys, and administrative records are often costly, spatially inconsistent, and slow to update. Recent geospatial foundation models enable Earth embeddings, compact satellite image representations transferable across downstream tasks, but their utility for neighborhood-scale urban monitoring remains unclear. Here, we benchmark three Earth embedding families, AlphaEarth, Prithvi, and Clay, for urban signal prediction across six U.S. metropolitan areas from 2020 to 2023. Using a unified supervised-learning framework, we predict 14 neighborhood-level indicators spanning crime, income, health, and travel behavior, and evaluate performance under four settings: global, city-wise, year-wise, and city-year. Results show that Earth embeddings capture substantial urban variation, with the highest predictive skill for outcomes more directly tied to built-environment structure, including chronic health burdens and dominant commuting modes. By contrast, indicators shaped more strongly by fine-scale behavior and local policy, such as cycling, remain difficult to infer. Predictive performance varies markedly across cities but remains comparatively stable across years, indicating strong spatial heterogeneity alongside temporal robustness. Exploratory analysis suggests that cross-city variation in predictive performance is associated with urban form in task-specific ways. Controlled dimensionality experiments show that representation efficiency is critical: compact 64-dimensional AlphaEarth embeddings remain more informative than 64-dimensional reductions of Prithvi and Clay. This study establishes a benchmark for evaluating Earth embeddings in urban remote sensing and demonstrates their potential as scalable, low-cost features for SDG-aligned neighborhood-scale urban monitoring.
tldr: The paper benchmarks geospatial foundation models for predicting urban indicators from satellite imagery, finding they best capture built-environment-related signals but struggle with fine-scale behavioral metrics.
tldr_zh: 该研究评估了多种地理空间基础模型，利用卫星图像预测城市指标，发现其对建筑环境相关信号捕捉效果最佳，但对细粒度行为指标预测困难。
summary_zh: 传统上，基于人口普查、调查和行政记录获取的城市指标通常成本高昂，空间一致性不足，且更新缓慢。近期出现的地理空间基础模型能够生成地球嵌入——一种可迁移至下游任务的紧凑型卫星影像表征，但其在街区尺度城市监测中的实用性尚不明确。本研究对AlphaEarth、Prithvi和Clay三种地球嵌入模型进行基准测试，分析其在2020年至2023年美国六大都市区城市信号预测中的表现。通过统一的监督学习框架，我们预测了涵盖犯罪、收入、健康和出行行为等领域的14项街区级指标，并在全局、分城市、分年度及城市-年度组合四种设定下评估模型性能。结果显示，地球嵌入能够捕捉显著的城市空间变异，对于与建成环境结构关联更紧密的指标（如慢性健康负担和主导通勤模式）具有最优预测能力；而受细粒度行为和地方政策影响更强的指标（如自行车出行）则仍难以推断。预测性能在不同城市间差异显著，但在跨年度对比中相对稳定，表明其具有强烈的空间异质性同时具备时间鲁棒性。探索性分析揭示，城市间预测性能的差异与城市形态存在任务特异性的关联。控制维度实验表明表征效率至关重要：64维的AlphaEarth紧凑嵌入仍比降维至同等维度的Prithvi和Clay嵌入包含更多信息。本研究为评估城市遥感中的地球嵌入建立了基准，并证明了其作为符合可持续发展目标的可扩展、低成本特征，在街区尺度城市监测中的应用潜力。

title: Lightweight Query Routing for Adaptive RAG: A Baseline Study on RAGRouter-Bench
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines span a wide range of retrieval strategies that differ substantially in token cost and capability. Selecting the right strategy per query is a practical efficiency problem, yet no routing classifiers have been trained on RAGRouter-Bench \citep{wang2026ragrouterbench}, a recently released benchmark of $7,727$ queries spanning four knowledge domains, each annotated with one of three canonical query types: factual, reasoning, and summarization. We present the first systematic evaluation of lightweight classifier-based routing on this benchmark. Five classical classifiers are evaluated under three feature regimes, namely, TF-IDF, MiniLM sentence embeddings \citep{reimers2019sbert}, and hand-crafted structural features, yielding 15 classifier feature combinations. Our best configuration, TF-IDF with an SVM, achieves a macro-averaged F1 of $\mathbf{0.928}$ and an accuracy of $\mathbf{93.2\%}$, while simulating $\mathbf{28.1\%}$ token savings relative to always using the most expensive paradigm. Lexical TF-IDF features outperform semantic sentence embeddings by $3.1$ macro-F1 points, suggesting that surface keyword patterns are strong predictors of query-type complexity. Domain-level analysis reveals that medical queries are hardest to route and legal queries most tractable. These results establish a reproducible query-side baseline and highlight the gap that corpus-aware routing must close.
tldr: This paper introduces a systematic evaluation of lightweight classifiers for routing queries within Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines to improve token efficiency, establishing a baseline on a new benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了在检索增强生成系统中使用轻量级分类器进行查询路由以提高token效率的方法，在一个新基准上建立了基线。
summary_zh: 检索增强生成流程涵盖多种检索策略，这些策略在计算代价与能力上存在显著差异。针对每个查询选择合适的策略是一个实际效率问题，但当前尚未有路由分类器在RAGRouter-Bench基准上进行训练——该基准新近发布，包含7,727个覆盖四大知识领域的查询样本，每个查询均标注为事实性、推理性或总结性三类典型查询类型之一。我们首次在此基准上系统评估了基于轻量级分类器的路由方案。通过三种特征机制（TF-IDF、MiniLM句子嵌入及手工构建的结构特征）对五种经典分类器进行测试，共形成15种分类器-特征组合。我们的最佳配置（采用SVM结合TF-IDF特征）实现了**0.928**的宏观平均F1分数与**93.2%**的准确率，同时模拟出相较于始终使用最昂贵策略可节省**28.1%**计算量的效果。词汇级TF-IDF特征以3.1个宏观F1点的优势超越语义句子嵌入特征，表明表层关键词模式是查询类型复杂度的强预测指标。领域级分析显示医疗查询最难路由，法律查询最易处理。这些结果建立了可复现的查询侧基线，并揭示了语料感知型路由技术需突破的现存差距。

title: Adaptive Threshold-Driven Continuous Greedy Method for Scalable Submodular Optimization
summary: Submodular maximization under matroid constraints is a fundamental problem in combinatorial optimization with applications in sensing, data summarization, active learning, and resource allocation. While the Sequential Greedy (SG) algorithm achieves only a $\frac{1}{2}$-approximation due to irrevocable selections, Continuous Greedy (CG) attains the optimal $\bigl(1-\frac{1}{e}\bigr)$-approximation via the multilinear relaxation, at the cost of a progressively dense decision vector that forces agents to exchange feature embeddings for nearly every ground-set element. We propose \textit{ATCG} (\underline{A}daptive \underline{T}hresholded \underline{C}ontinuous \underline{G}reedy), which gates gradient evaluations behind a per-partition progress ratio $η_i$, expanding each agent's active set only when current candidates fail to capture sufficient marginal gain, thereby directly bounding which feature embeddings are ever transmitted. Theoretical analysis establishes a curvature-aware approximation guarantee with effective factor $τ_{\mathrm{eff}}=\max\{τ,1-c\}$, interpolating between the threshold-based guarantee and the low-curvature regime where \textit{ATCG} recovers the performance of CG. Experiments on a class-balanced prototype selection problem over a subset of the CIFAR-10 animal dataset show that \textit{ATCG} achieves objective values comparable to those of the full CG method while substantially reducing communication overhead through adaptive active-set expansion.
tldr: The paper proposes ATCG, an adaptive thresholded continuous greedy algorithm for scalable submodular optimization under matroid constraints, which reduces communication overhead compared to the standard continuous greedy method while maintaining approximation guarantees. It is evaluated on a class-balanced prototype selection task using the CIFAR-10 dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ATCG，一种用于在拟阵约束下进行可扩展子模块优化的自适应阈值连续贪心算法，与标准连续贪心方法相比，它在保持近似保证的同时减少了通信开销。该方法在CIFAR-10数据集上的类平衡原型选择任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 在拟阵约束下的子模最大化是组合优化中的一个基础性问题，在感知、数据摘要、主动学习和资源分配等领域具有广泛应用。虽然由于不可撤销选择的性质，序列贪心算法仅能实现$\frac{1}{2}$近似比，而连续贪心算法通过多线性松弛可达到最优的$\bigl(1-\frac{1}{e}\bigr)$近似比，但其代价是产生逐渐稠密的决策向量，迫使智能体需要为几乎每个基础集元素交换特征嵌入向量。我们提出\textit{ATCG}（\underline{自适}应\underline{阈}值\underline{连续贪}心算法），该算法将梯度计算过程置于每个分区的进度比$η_i$阈值控制下，仅当当前候选集无法捕获足够边际增益时才扩展各智能体的活跃集，从而直接限制需要传输的特征嵌入向量范围。理论分析建立了一个具有有效因子$τ_{\mathrm{eff}}=\max\{τ,1-c\}$的曲率感知近似保证，该算法在基于阈值的保证机制与低曲率区域之间平滑过渡，当处于低曲率区域时，\textit{ATCG}能够恢复连续贪心算法的性能表现。在CIFAR-10动物数据集子集上进行的类平衡原型选择问题实验表明，\textit{ATCG}在保持与完整连续贪心方法相当的目标函数值的同时，通过自适应活跃集扩展机制显著降低了通信开销。

title: Beauty in the Eye of AI: Aligning LLMs and Vision Models with Human Aesthetics in Network Visualization
summary: Network visualization has traditionally relied on heuristic metrics, such as stress, under the assumption that optimizing them leads to aesthetic and informative layouts. However, no single metric consistently produces the most effective results. A data-driven alternative is to learn from human preferences, where annotators select their favored visualization among multiple layouts of the same graphs. These human-preference labels can then be used to train a generative model that approximates human aesthetic preferences. However, obtaining human labels at scale is costly and time-consuming. As a result, this generative approach has so far been tested only with machine-labeled data. In this paper, we explore the use of large language models (LLMs) and vision models (VMs) as proxies for human judgment. Through a carefully designed user study involving 27 participants, we curated a large set of human preference labels. We used this data both to better understand human preferences and to bootstrap LLM/VM labelers. We show that prompt engineering that combines few-shot examples and diverse input formats, such as image embeddings, significantly improves LLM-human alignment, and additional filtering by the confidence score of the LLM pushes the alignment to human-human levels. Furthermore, we demonstrate that carefully trained VMs can achieve VM-human alignment at a level comparable to that between human annotators. Our results suggest that AI can feasibly serve as a scalable proxy for human labelers.
tldr: This paper explores using LLMs and vision models as scalable proxies for human aesthetic judgment in network visualization, aiming to learn from human preferences without extensive manual labeling.
tldr_zh: 本文探索使用大语言模型和视觉模型作为网络可视化中人类审美判断的可扩展代理，旨在无需大量人工标注的情况下学习人类偏好。
summary_zh: 网络可视化传统上依赖于启发式指标（如压力），其假设是优化这些指标能带来美观且信息丰富的布局。然而，没有单一指标能持续产生最有效的效果。一种数据驱动的方法是从人类偏好中学习，即标注者在同一图表的多种布局中选择偏好的可视化形式。这些人类偏好标签随后可用于训练生成模型，以近似人类的美学偏好。但大规模获取人类标注成本高昂且耗时，因此该生成方法迄今为止仅在机器标注数据上进行了测试。本文探索使用大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉模型（VM）作为人类判断的替代。通过一项涉及27名参与者的精心设计的用户研究，我们收集了大量人类偏好标签数据。这些数据既用于深入理解人类偏好，也用于引导LLM/VM标注模型。研究表明，结合少样本示例与多样化输入格式（如图像嵌入）的提示工程显著提升了LLM与人类标注的一致性，而基于LLM置信度分数的进一步筛选可将一致性推至人类标注者间的水平。此外，我们证明经过精心训练的视觉模型可实现与人类标注者间相当水平的VM-人类一致性。这些结果表明，人工智能可作为人类标注者的可扩展替代方案。

title: Scalable Variational Bayesian Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Orthogonalized Low-Rank Adapters
summary: When deploying large language models (LLMs) to safety-critical applications, uncertainty quantification (UQ) is of utmost importance to self-assess the reliability of the LLM-based decisions. However, such decisions typically suffer from overconfidence, particularly after parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for downstream domain-specific tasks with limited data. Existing methods to alleviate this issue either rely on Laplace approximation based post-hoc framework, which may yield suboptimal calibration depending on the training trajectory, or variational Bayesian training that requires multiple complete forward passes through the entire LLM backbone at inference time for Monte Carlo estimation, posing scalability challenges for deployment. To address these limitations, we build on the Bayesian last layer (BLL) model, where the LLM-based deterministic feature extractor is followed by random last layer parameters for uncertainty reasoning. Since existing low-rank adapters (LoRA) for PEFT have limited expressiveness due to rank collapse, we address this with Polar-decomposed Low-rank Adapter Representation (PoLAR), an orthogonalized parameterization paired with Riemannian optimization to enable more stable and expressive adaptation. Building on this PoLAR-BLL model, we leverage the variational (V) inference framework to put forth a scalable Bayesian fine-tuning approach which jointly seeks the PoLAR parameters and approximate posterior of the last layer parameters via alternating optimization. The resulting PoLAR-VBLL is a flexible framework that nicely integrates architecture-enhanced optimization with scalable Bayesian inference to endow LLMs with well-calibrated UQ. Our empirical results verify the effectiveness of PoLAR-VBLL in terms of generalization and uncertainty estimation on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data for various common-sense reasoning tasks.
tldr: Proposes PoLAR-VBLL, a scalable Bayesian fine-tuning method using orthogonalized low-rank adapters and variational inference for last-layer uncertainty quantification in LLMs, addressing calibration issues after PEFT.
tldr_zh: 提出PoLAR-VBLL，一种可扩展的贝叶斯微调方法，利用正交化低秩适配器和变分推理为LLMs的最后一层进行不确定性量化，解决PEFT后的校准问题。
summary_zh: 在将大型语言模型（LLM）部署至安全关键应用时，不确定性量化（UQ）对于自我评估基于LLM决策的可靠性至关重要。然而，此类决策通常存在过度自信的问题，尤其是在针对数据有限的下游领域特定任务进行参数高效微调（PEFT）后尤为明显。现有缓解该问题的方法或依赖基于拉普拉斯近似的后处理框架（其校准效果可能因训练轨迹的不同而欠佳），或采用变分贝叶斯训练（在推理时需对完整LLM主干进行多次前向传播以进行蒙特卡洛估计），导致部署面临可扩展性挑战。为突破这些局限，我们基于贝叶斯末层（BLL）模型进行改进，该模型在LLM确定性特征提取器后引入随机末层参数以实现不确定性推理。由于现有用于PEFT的低秩适配器（LoRA）因秩崩溃问题表达能力受限，我们提出极分解低秩适配器表示（PoLAR）——通过正交化参数化结合黎曼优化，实现更稳定且更具表达力的适应。基于此PoLAR-BLL模型，我们利用变分（V）推理框架提出一种可扩展的贝叶斯微调方法，通过交替优化联合求解PoLAR参数与末层参数的近似后验分布。由此形成的PoLAR-VBLL框架灵活融合了架构增强优化与可扩展贝叶斯推理，使LLM具备良好校准的不确定性量化能力。实验结果表明，在多种常识推理任务中，PoLAR-VBLL在分布内与分布外数据上均表现出优异的泛化性能与不确定性估计效果。

title: CountsDiff: A Diffusion Model on the Natural Numbers for Generation and Imputation of Count-Based Data
summary: Diffusion models have excelled at generative tasks for both continuous and token-based domains, but their application to discrete ordinal data remains underdeveloped. We present CountsDiff, a diffusion framework designed to natively model distributions on the natural numbers. CountsDiff extends the Blackout diffusion framework by simplifying its formulation through a direct parameterization in terms of a survival probability schedule and an explicit loss weighting. This introduces flexibility through design parameters with direct analogues in existing diffusion modeling frameworks. Beyond this reparameterization, CountsDiff introduces features from modern diffusion models, previously absent in counts-based domains, including continuous-time training, classifier-free guidance, and churn/remasking reverse dynamics that allow non-monotone reverse trajectories. We propose an initial instantiation of CountsDiff and validate it on natural image datasets (CIFAR-10, CelebA), exploring the effects of varying the introduced design parameters in a complex, well-studied, and interpretable data domain. We then highlight biological count assays as a natural use case, evaluating CountsDiff on single-cell RNA-seq imputation in a fetal cell and heart cell atlas. Remarkably, we find that even this simple instantiation matches or surpasses the performance of a state-of-the-art discrete generative model and leading RNA-seq imputation methods, while leaving substantial headroom for further gains through optimized design choices in future work.
tldr: A diffusion model framework designed for generating and imputing count-based data, with applications demonstrated on image datasets and single-cell RNA-seq data.
tldr_zh: 一个用于生成和填充计数数据的扩散模型框架，在图像数据集和单细胞RNA-seq数据上进行了应用验证。
summary_zh: 扩散模型在连续和基于令牌的领域生成任务中表现出色，但其在离散序数数据上的应用仍显不足。我们提出了CountsDiff框架——一种专为自然数分布建模设计的扩散框架。CountsDiff通过生存概率调度的直接参数化与显式损失加权，简化了Blackout扩散框架的表述，从而引入了与现有扩散模型框架直接对应的设计参数灵活性。在此重参数化基础上，CountsDiff进一步引入了现代扩散模型的特征（这些特征在基于计数的领域先前尚未应用），包括连续时间训练、无分类器指导，以及支持非单调反向轨迹的搅动/重掩蔽反向动力学机制。我们提出了CountsDiff的初步实现方案，并在自然图像数据集（CIFAR-10、CelebA）上验证其有效性，通过在复杂、可解释且经过充分研究的数域中调整设计参数来探索其影响。随后，我们聚焦生物计数检测这一天然应用场景，在胎儿细胞与心脏细胞图谱的单细胞RNA-seq数据插补任务中评估CountsDiff的性能。值得注意的是，即使在此基础实现版本中，该框架已能匹配或超越当前最先进的离散生成模型与主流RNA-seq插补方法，同时为未来工作中通过优化设计选择实现更大性能提升留下了充足空间。

title: Automated Attention Pattern Discovery at Scale in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models have found success by scaling up capabilities to work in general settings. The same can unfortunately not be said for interpretability methods. The current trend in mechanistic interpretability is to provide precise explanations of specific behaviors in controlled settings. These often do not generalize, or are too resource intensive for larger studies. In this work we propose to study repeated behaviors in large language models by mining completion scenarios in Java code datasets, through exploiting the structured nature of code. We collect the attention patterns generated in the attention heads to demonstrate that they are scalable signals for global interpretability of model components. We show that vision models offer a promising direction for analyzing attention patterns at scale. To demonstrate this, we introduce the Attention Pattern - Masked Autoencoder(AP-MAE), a vision transformer-based model that efficiently reconstructs masked attention patterns. Experiments on StarCoder2 show that AP-MAE (i) reconstructs masked attention patterns with high accuracy, (ii) generalizes across unseen models with minimal degradation, (iii) reveals recurring patterns across inferences, (iv) predicts whether a generation will be correct without access to ground truth, with accuracies ranging from 55% to 70% depending on the task, and (v) enables targeted interventions that increase accuracy by 13.6% when applied selectively, but cause collapse when applied excessively. These results establish attention patterns as a scalable signal for interpretability and demonstrate that AP-MAE provides a transferable foundation for both analysis and intervention in large language models. Beyond its standalone value, AP-MAE also serves as a selection procedure to guide fine-grained mechanistic approaches. We release code and models to support future work in large-scale interpretability.
tldr: This paper proposes a method called AP-MAE for analyzing attention patterns in large language models at scale, using a vision model to understand and intervene in model behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为AP-MAE的方法，用于大规模分析大语言模型中的注意力模式，使用视觉模型来理解和干预模型行为。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型通过扩展能力在通用场景中取得成功，可解释性方法却未能实现同样的突破。当前机制可解释性研究的趋势是在受控环境中对特定行为进行精确解释，但此类方法往往缺乏普适性，或在大规模研究中消耗资源过多。本研究提出利用代码的结构化特性，在Java代码数据集中挖掘补全场景，以系统研究大型语言模型中的重复行为。通过收集注意力头生成的注意力模式，我们证明其可作为模型组件全局可解释性的可扩展信号。研究表明视觉模型为大规模分析注意力模式提供了可行方向：我们提出注意力模式-掩码自编码器（AP-MAE），这是一种基于视觉Transformer的模型，能高效重建掩码注意力模式。在StarCoder2上的实验表明，AP-MAE具有以下特性：（1）高精度重建掩码注意力模式；（2）在未见模型上泛化时性能衰减极小；（3）揭示跨推理过程的重复模式；（4）无需真实标签即可预测生成结果正确性，任务准确率介于55%至70%；（5）支持定向干预——选择性应用可使准确率提升13.6%，但过度应用会导致性能崩溃。这些结果确立了注意力模式作为可扩展可解释性信号的有效性，并证明AP-MAE为大型语言模型的分析与干预提供了可迁移的基础框架。除独立价值外，AP-MAE还可作为指导细粒度机制研究的筛选工具。我们公开了相关代码与模型，以支持未来大规模可解释性研究。

title: CREBench: Evaluating Large Language Models in Cryptographic Binary Reverse Engineering
summary: Reverse engineering (RE) is central to software security, particularly for cryptographic programs that handle sensitive data and are highly prone to vulnerabilities. It supports critical tasks such as vulnerability discovery and malware analysis. Despite its importance, RE remains labor-intensive and requires substantial expertise, making large language models (LLMs) a potential solution for automating the process. However, their capabilities for RE remain systematically underexplored. To address this gap, we study the cryptographic binary RE capabilities of LLMs and introduce \textbf{CREBench}, a benchmark comprising 432 challenges built from 48 standard cryptographic algorithms, 3 insecure crypto key usage scenarios, and 3 difficulty levels. Each challenge follows a Capture-the-Flag (CTF) RE challenge, requiring the model to analyze the underlying cryptographic logic and recover the correct input. We design an evaluation framework comprising four sub-tasks, from algorithm identification to correct flag recovery. We evaluate eight frontier LLMs on CREBench. GPT-5.4, the best-performing model, achieves 64.03 out of 100 and recovers the flag in 59\% of challenges. We also establish a strong human expert baseline of 92.19 points, showing that humans maintain an advantage in cryptographic RE tasks. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/wangyu-ovo/CREBench.
tldr: The paper introduces CREBench, a new benchmark for evaluating the cryptographic binary reverse engineering capabilities of large language models, assessing their performance in automated software security analysis.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CREBench，一个用于评估大语言模型在加密二进制逆向工程能力的新基准，用于评估其在自动化软件安全分析中的性能。
summary_zh: 逆向工程（RE）是软件安全的核心领域，尤其对于处理敏感数据且极易出现漏洞的加密程序而言更是如此。它支撑着漏洞发现和恶意软件分析等关键任务。尽管重要性显著，逆向工程仍属劳动密集型工作且需要大量专业知识，这使得大型语言模型（LLMs）成为实现该过程自动化的潜在解决方案。然而，它们在逆向工程领域的能力仍未被系统性地充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们研究了大型语言模型在加密二进制逆向工程中的能力，并推出了 **CREBench**——一个包含 432 个挑战的基准测试集，这些挑战基于 48 种标准加密算法、3 种不安全的加密密钥使用场景以及 3 个难度级别构建而成。每个挑战均采用夺旗赛（CTF）形式的逆向工程题目，要求模型分析底层加密逻辑并恢复正确的输入。我们设计了一个包含四个子任务的评估框架，涵盖从算法识别到正确旗帜恢复的全过程。我们在 CREBench 上对八个前沿大型语言模型进行了评估。表现最佳的 GPT-5.4 模型获得了 100 分中的 64.03 分，并在 59% 的挑战中成功恢复旗帜。同时我们建立了高达 92.19 分的人类专家基准线，表明人类在加密逆向工程任务中仍保持优势。我们的代码与数据集已公开于 https://github.com/wangyu-ovo/CREBench。

title: Learning Superpixel Ensemble and Hierarchy Graphs for Melanoma Detection
summary: Graph signal processing (GSP) is becoming a major tool in biomedical signal and image analysis. In most GSP techniques, graph structures and edge weights have been typically set via statistical and computational methods. More recently, graph structure learning methods offered more reliable and flexible data representations. In this work, we introduce a graph learning approach for melanoma detection in dermoscopic images based on two graph-theoretic representations: superpixel ensemble graphs (SEG) and superpixel hierarchy graphs (SHG). For these two types of graphs, superpixel maps of a skin lesion image are respectively generated at multiple levels without and with parentchild constraints among superpixels at adjacent levels, where each level corresponds to a subgraph with a different number of nodes (20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 nodes). Two edge weight assignment techniques are explored: handcrafted Gaussian weights and learned weights based on optimization methods. The graph nodal signals are assigned based on texture, geometric, and color superpixel features. In addition, the effect of graph edge thresholding is investigated by applying different thresholds (25%, 50%, and 75%) to prune the weakest edges and analyze the impact of pruning on the melanoma detection performance. Experimental evaluation of the proposed method is performed with different classifiers trained and tested on the publicly available ISIC2017 dataset. Data augmentation is applied to alleviate class imbalance by adding more melanoma images from the ISIC archive. The results show that learned superpixel ensemble graphs with textural nodal signals give the highest performance reaching an accuracy of 99.00% and an AUC of 99.59%.
tldr: This paper proposes a graph learning method for melanoma detection in dermoscopic images, using superpixel ensemble and hierarchy graphs with different edge weight assignments and thresholding techniques.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于皮肤镜图像中黑色素瘤检测的图学习方法，采用超像素集合图和层次图，并探索了不同的边权重分配和阈值技术。
summary_zh: 图信号处理正逐渐成为生物医学信号和图像分析的重要工具。在大多数图信号处理技术中，通常通过统计和计算方法设定图结构及边权重。近年来，图结构学习方法提供了更可靠、更灵活的数据表征方式。本研究提出一种基于两种图论表征的皮肤镜图像黑色素瘤检测图学习方法：超像素集合图与超像素层级图。针对这两种图类型，皮肤病变图像的超像素地图分别在不包含和包含相邻层级超像素间父子约束的条件下，在多个层级（每层对应包含20、40、60、80或100个节点的子图）生成。本文探索了两种边权重分配技术：手工设计的高斯权重与基于优化方法的学习权重。图节点信号通过超像素的纹理、几何和颜色特征进行赋值。此外，通过应用不同阈值（25%、50%和75%）修剪最弱边，研究图边阈值处理对黑色素瘤检测性能的影响。在公开可用的ISIC2017数据集上，使用不同分类器对所提方法进行训练与测试的实证评估。为缓解类别不平衡问题，从ISIC档案库中补充更多黑色素瘤图像进行数据增强。实验结果表明，采用纹理节点信号的学习型超像素集合图达到最佳性能，准确率与AUC值分别达到99.00%和99.59%。

title: RDEx-CMOP: Feasibility-Aware Indicator-Guided Differential Evolution for Fixed-Budget Constrained Multiobjective Optimization
summary: Constrained multiobjective optimisation requires fast feasibility attainment together with stable convergence and diversity preservation under strict evaluation budgets. This report documents RDEx-CMOP, the differential evolution variant used in the IEEE CEC 2025 numerical optimisation competition (C06 special session) constrained multiobjective track. RDEx-CMOP integrates an ε-level feasibility schedule, a SPEA2-style indicator-driven fitness assignment, and a fitness-oriented current-to-pbest/1 mutation operator. We evaluate RDEx-CMOP on the official CEC 2025 CMOP benchmark using the median-target U-score framework and the released trace data. Experimental results show that RDEx-CMOP achieves the highest total score and the best overall average rank among all released comparison algorithms, with strong target-attainment behaviour and near-zero final violation on most problems.
tldr: Presents a differential evolution algorithm for constrained multiobjective optimization, designed for a numerical optimization competition, featuring feasibility scheduling and indicator-guided selection.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于约束多目标优化的差分进化算法，专为数值优化竞赛设计，结合了可行性调度和指标引导选择机制。
summary_zh: 约束多目标优化需要在严格的评估预算下快速达成可行性，同时保持稳定的收敛性和多样性。本报告记录了RDEx-CMOP——即用于IEEE CEC 2025数值优化竞赛（C06特别会议）约束多目标赛道的差分进化变体。RDEx-CMOP融合了ε-层级可行性调度机制、SPEA2风格的指标驱动适应度分配策略，以及面向适应度的current-to-pbest/1变异算子。我们通过中位数目标U分数框架和公布的轨迹数据，在官方CEC 2025 CMOP基准测试集上对RDEx-CMOP进行评估。实验结果表明，在所有已公布的对比算法中，RDEx-CMOP获得了最高的总分和最佳的综合平均排名，在多数问题上展现出强大的目标达成能力及接近零的最终违反度。

title: A Generative Foundation Model for Multimodal Histopathology
summary: Accurate diagnosis and treatment of complex diseases require integrating histological, molecular, and clinical data, yet in practice these modalities are often incomplete owing to tissue scarcity, assay cost, and workflow constraints. Existing computational approaches attempt to impute missing modalities from available data but rely on task-specific models trained on narrow, single source-target pairs, limiting their generalizability. Here we introduce MuPD (Multimodal Pathology Diffusion), a generative foundation model that embeds hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained histology, molecular RNA profiles, and clinical text into a shared latent space through a diffusion transformer with decoupled cross-modal attention. Pretrained on 100 million histology image patches, 1.6 million text-histology pairs, and 10.8 million RNA-histology pairs spanning 34 human organs, MuPD supports diverse cross-modal synthesis tasks with minimal or no task-specific fine-tuning. For text-conditioned and image-to-image generation, MuPD synthesizes histologically faithful tissue architectures, reducing Fréchet inception distance (FID) scores by 50% relative to domain-specific models and improving few-shot classification accuracy by up to 47% through synthetic data augmentation. For RNA-conditioned histology generation, MuPD reduces FID by 23% compared with the next-best method while preserving cell-type distributions across five cancer types. As a virtual stainer, MuPD translates H&E images to immunohistochemistry and multiplex immunofluorescence, improving average marker correlation by 37% over existing approaches. These results demonstrate that a single, unified generative model pretrained across heterogeneous pathology modalities can substantially outperform specialized alternatives, providing a scalable computational framework for multimodal histopathology.
tldr: This paper introduces a generative foundation model for multimodal histopathology, supporting cross-modal synthesis tasks like text-conditioned histology generation and image-to-image translation, demonstrating strong performance across diverse tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多模态病理学的生成基础模型，支持跨模态合成任务，如基于文本的病理学生成和图像到图像转换，在多项任务中表现优异。
summary_zh: 复杂疾病的准确诊断与治疗需要整合组织学、分子与临床数据，但在实践中这些模态常因组织稀缺性、检测成本及工作流程限制而不完整。现有计算方法试图从已有数据中补全缺失模态，但依赖于在单一狭窄的源-目标对上训练的任务特定模型，限制了其泛化能力。本文提出MuPD（多模态病理扩散模型），该生成式基础模型通过解耦跨模态注意力机制的扩散变换器，将苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色组织切片、分子RNA谱与临床文本嵌入共享隐空间。基于覆盖34种人体器官的1亿个组织图像块、160万组文本-组织配对数据及1080万组RNA-组织配对数据进行预训练，MuPD能以极少量或无需任务特定微调的方式支持多样化跨模态合成任务。在文本条件生成与图像到图像生成任务中，MuPD合成的组织结构具有高度组织学保真度，其Fréchet起始距离分数较领域特定模型降低50%，且通过合成数据增强将少样本分类准确率提升最高达47%。在RNA条件组织合成任务中，相较于次优方法，MuPD将FID降低23%，同时在五种癌症类型中保持细胞类型分布特征。作为虚拟染色器，MuPD能将H&E图像转换为免疫组化与多重免疫荧光图像，其标志物相关性较现有方法平均提升37%。这些结果表明，在异质病理多模态数据上预训练的单一统一生成模型，能显著超越专用替代方案，为多模态病理学提供了可扩展的计算框架。

title: A Multimodal Foundation Model of Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology for Biological Discovery and Clinical Prediction
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables gene expression mapping within anatomical context but remains costly and low-throughput. Hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) staining offers rich morphology yet lacks molecular resolution. We present \textbf{\ours} (\textbf{S}patial \textbf{T}ranscriptomics and hist\textbf{O}logy \textbf{R}epresentation \textbf{M}odel), a foundation model trained on 1.2 million spatially resolved transcriptomic profiles with matched histology across 18 organs. Using a hierarchical architecture integrating morphological features, gene expression, and spatial context, STORM bridges imaging and omics through robust molecular--morphological representations. STORM enhances spatial domain discovery, producing biologically coherent tissue maps, and outperforms existing methods in predicting spatial gene expression from H\&E images across 11 tumor types. The model is platform-agnostic, performing consistently across Visium, Xenium, Visium HD, and CosMx. Applied to 23 independent cohorts comprising 7,245 patients, STORM significantly improves immunotherapy response prediction and prognostication over established biomarkers, providing a scalable framework for spatially informed discovery and clinical precision medicine.
tldr: This paper introduces STORM, a multimodal foundation model that bridges histology images and spatial transcriptomics data for enhanced biological discovery and clinical prediction in healthcare, with no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了STORM，一个多模态基础模型，通过整合组织学图像和空间转录组数据，用于增强生物发现和临床预测，与机器人学或具身AI无关。
summary_zh: 空间转录组学技术能够在解剖学背景下实现基因表达图谱构建，但其成本高昂且通量有限。苏木精-伊红染色虽能提供丰富的形态学信息，却缺乏分子层面的解析度。本研究提出**STORM**（**S**patial **T**ranscriptomics and hist**O**logy **R**epresentation **M**odel）基础模型，该模型基于涵盖18个器官的120万个空间分辨转录组数据及其匹配的组织学图像进行训练。通过整合形态学特征、基因表达与空间背景的层次化架构，STORM构建出稳健的分子-形态学表征体系，成功搭建了影像学与组学之间的桥梁。该模型在空间域识别方面表现优异，能生成具有生物学一致性的组织图谱，并在11种肿瘤类型的H&E图像预测空间基因表达任务中超越现有方法。STORM具备平台通用性，在Visium、Xenium、Visium HD和CosMx等平台上均保持稳定性能。通过对包含7,245例患者的23个独立队列进行验证，STORM在免疫治疗反应预测和预后评估方面显著优于现有生物标志物，为空间信息驱动的科学发现和临床精准医疗提供了可扩展的框架。

title: Toward Executable Repository-Level Code Generation via Environment Alignment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on code generation, but existing methods still struggle with repository-level code generation under executable validation. Under this evaluation setting, success is determined not by the plausibility of isolated code fragments, but by whether a generated multi-file repository can be successfully installed, have its dependencies and internal references resolved, be launched, and be validated in a real execution environment. To address this challenge, we propose EnvGraph, a framework for repository-level code generation that formulates repository executability as an environment alignment problem. EnvGraph jointly models two coupled conditions for successful repository execution, namely external dependency satisfaction and repository-internal reference resolution. It maintains a dual-layer environment representation, uses execution evidence to perform execution-evidence-based attribution, and guides repository generation through a unified targeted revision mechanism within an iterative alignment loop. We evaluate EnvGraph on repository-level code generation with three representative backbone LLMs and compare it against representative environment-aware and repository-level baselines. Experimental results show that EnvGraph consistently achieves the best performance on these repository-level benchmarks. In particular, it outperforms the strongest non-EnvGraph baseline by an absolute margin of 5.72--5.87 percentage points in Functional Correctness and 4.58--8.66 percentage points in Non-Functional Quality.
tldr: This paper proposes EnvGraph, a framework for generating executable, multi-file code repositories by modeling external dependencies and internal references as an environment alignment problem. It aims to improve the functional correctness and quality of repository-level code generation validated in real execution environments.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了EnvGraph框架，通过将可执行性建模为环境对齐问题来生成可执行的多文件代码仓库。该方法旨在改善在真实执行环境中验证的仓库级代码生成的功能正确性和质量。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面已取得显著成效，但现有方法在需经可执行性验证的仓库级代码生成任务中仍面临挑战。在此评估设定下，成功与否并非取决于孤立代码片段的可信度，而是取决于生成的多文件仓库能否成功安装、解决其依赖项与内部引用、顺利启动，并在真实执行环境中通过验证。为应对这一挑战，我们提出EnvGraph——一种面向仓库级代码生成的框架，其将仓库可执行性建模为环境对齐问题。EnvGraph联合建模了仓库成功执行的两个耦合条件：外部依赖满足与仓库内部引用解析。该框架通过维护双层环境表示，利用执行证据进行基于证据的归因分析，并在迭代对齐循环中借助统一的定向修订机制指导仓库生成。我们在仓库级代码生成任务上，使用三种代表性骨干LLM对EnvGraph进行评估，并将其与典型的环境感知及仓库级基线方法进行比较。实验结果表明，EnvGraph在这些仓库级基准测试中始终取得最优性能。具体而言，在功能正确性指标上，EnvGraph较最强非EnvGraph基线方法绝对提升5.72–5.87个百分点；在非功能性质量指标上，绝对提升4.58–8.66个百分点。

title: Unveiling Language Routing Isolation in Multilingual MoE Models for Interpretable Subnetwork Adaptation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models exhibit striking performance disparities across languages, yet the internal mechanisms driving these gaps remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of expert routing patterns in MoE models, revealing a phenomenon we term Language Routing Isolation, in which high- and low-resource languages tend to activate largely disjoint expert sets. Through layer-stratified analysis, we further show that routing patterns exhibit a layer-wise convergence-divergence pattern across model depth. Building on these findings, we propose RISE (Routing Isolation-guided Subnetwork Enhancement), a framework that exploits routing isolation to identify and adapt language-specific expert subnetworks. RISE applies a tripartite selection strategy, using specificity scores to identify language-specific experts in shallow and deep layers and overlap scores to select universal experts in middle layers. By training only the selected subnetwork while freezing all other parameters, RISE substantially improves low-resource language performance while preserving capabilities in other languages. Experiments on 10 languages demonstrate that RISE achieves target-language F1 gains of up to 10.85% with minimal cross-lingual degradation.
tldr: This paper analyzes and mitigates performance disparities in multilingual Mixture-of-Experts models by identifying 'Language Routing Isolation' and proposing a subnetwork adaptation method to improve low-resource language performance.
tldr_zh: 本文通过分析多语言混合专家模型中的'语言路由隔离'现象，提出一种子网络适配方法，以提升低资源语言的性能。
summary_zh: 专家混合模型在不同语言间表现出显著性能差异，但其内在机制尚未得到充分理解。本研究通过系统分析专家路由模式，揭示了"语言路由隔离"现象：高资源语言与低资源语言倾向于激活近乎互斥的专家集合。通过分层分析，我们进一步发现路由模式在模型深度上呈现层间"收敛-发散"的演化规律。基于这些发现，我们提出RISE框架——通过路由隔离识别并适配语言特异性专家子网络。该框架采用三重选择策略：利用特异性分数选取浅层与深层的语言特异性专家，基于重叠分数选择中间层的通用性专家。通过仅训练选定子网络并冻结其余参数，RISE在保持其他语言能力的同时，显著提升了低资源语言性能。在10种语言上的实验表明，RISE使目标语言F1值最高提升10.85%，且跨语言性能退化微乎其微。

title: Selective Forgetting for Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate structured chains of thought (CoTs) before producing final answers, making them especially vulnerable to knowledge leakage through intermediate reasoning steps. Yet, the memorization of sensitive information in the training data such as copyrighted and private content has led to ethical and legal concerns. To address these issues, selective forgetting (also known as machine unlearning) has emerged as a potential remedy for LRMs. However, existing unlearning methods primarily target final answers and may degrade the overall reasoning ability of LRMs after forgetting. Additionally, directly applying unlearning on the entire CoTs could degrade the general reasoning capabilities. The key challenge for LRM unlearning lies in achieving precise unlearning of targeted knowledge while preserving the integrity of general reasoning capabilities. To bridge this gap, we in this paper propose a novel LRM unlearning framework that selectively removes sensitive reasoning components while preserving general reasoning capabilities. Our approach leverages multiple LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to analyze CoT traces, identify forget-relevant segments, and replace them with benign placeholders that maintain logical structure.
