We also introduce a new feature replacement unlearning loss for LRMs, which can simultaneously suppress the probability of generating forgotten content while reinforcing structurally valid replacements. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and medical datasets verify the desired properties of our proposed method.
tldr: This paper proposes a selective forgetting (machine unlearning) framework for Large Reasoning Models that removes sensitive information from reasoning chains while preserving general reasoning capabilities.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对大型推理模型的选择性遗忘（机器反学习）框架，旨在从推理链中移除敏感信息，同时保留通用的推理能力。
summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在生成最终答案前会先输出结构化的思维链，这一特性使其尤其容易通过中间推理步骤泄露敏感信息。然而，训练数据中受版权保护内容和私人信息等敏感信息的记忆问题已引发伦理与法律层面的担忧。为应对这些挑战，选择性遗忘（亦称机器遗忘）技术已成为LRMs的潜在解决方案。然而，现有遗忘方法主要针对最终答案进行干预，可能导致模型在遗忘后整体推理能力下降。同时，若直接对整个思维链实施遗忘操作，亦会损害模型的通用推理能力。LRM遗忘技术的核心挑战在于实现目标知识的精准遗忘，同时保持通用推理能力的完整性。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一种创新的LRM遗忘框架，能够选择性移除敏感推理成分，同时保留通用推理能力。该方法通过集成检索增强生成技术的多LLM系统，对思维链轨迹进行分析，识别需遗忘的关联片段，并将其替换为保持逻辑结构的良性占位符。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的特征替换遗忘损失函数，可同步抑制生成遗忘内容的概率，同时强化结构有效的替换内容。基于合成数据集与医疗数据集的广泛实验验证了所提方法具备预期特性。

title: Automated Analysis of Global AI Safety Initiatives: A Taxonomy-Driven LLM Approach
summary: We present an automated crosswalk framework that compares an AI safety policy document pair under a shared taxonomy of activities. Using the activity categories defined in Activity Map on AI Safety as fixed aspects, the system extracts and maps relevant activities, then produces for each aspect a short summary for each document, a brief comparison, and a similarity score. We assess the stability and validity of LLM-based crosswalk analysis across public policy documents. Using five large language models, we perform crosswalks on ten publicly available documents and visualize mean similarity scores with a heatmap. The results show that model choice substantially affects the crosswalk outcomes, and that some document pairs yield high disagreements across models. A human evaluation by three experts on two document pairs shows high inter-annotator agreement, while model scores still differ from human judgments. These findings support comparative inspection of policy documents.
tldr: This paper presents an automated framework that uses LLMs to analyze and compare AI safety policy documents according to a shared taxonomy, assessing the impact of model choice and comparing model outputs to human expert judgments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用LLM基于共享分类法对AI安全政策文件进行自动分析和比较的框架，评估了模型选择的影响，并将模型输出与人类专家判断进行了对比。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种自动化交叉比对框架，用于在统一活动分类体系下比较人工智能安全政策文件对。该系统以"人工智能安全活动图谱"定义的活动类别为固定维度，抽取并映射相关活动内容，随后为每个维度生成单份文件的摘要说明、简要对比分析及相似度评分。我们通过公共政策文件评估了基于大语言模型的交叉比对分析方法的稳定性与有效性。使用五种大语言模型对十份公开文件进行交叉比对，并通过热力图可视化平均相似度得分。结果表明，模型选择会显著影响交叉比对结果，且某些文件对在不同模型间存在较高分歧。三位专家对两对文件的人工评估显示出较高标注者一致性，而模型评分仍与人工判断存在差异。这些发现为政策文件的比较研究提供了支持。

title: LangFIR: Discovering Sparse Language-Specific Features from Monolingual Data for Language Steering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show strong multilingual capabilities, yet reliably controlling the language of their outputs remains difficult. Representation-level steering addresses this by adding language-specific vectors to model activations at inference time, but identifying language-specific directions in the residual stream often relies on multilingual or parallel data that can be expensive to obtain. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual activations into interpretable, sparse feature directions and offer a natural basis for this search, yet existing SAE-based approaches face the same data constraint. We introduce LangFIR (Language Feature Identification via Random-token Filtering), a method that discovers language-specific SAE features using only a small amount of monolingual data and random-token sequences. Many SAE features consistently activated by target-language inputs do not encode language identity. Random-token sequences surface these language-agnostic features, allowing LangFIR to filter them out and isolate a sparse set of language-specific features. We show that these features are extremely sparse, highly selective for their target language, and causally important: directional ablation increases cross-entropy loss only for the corresponding language. Using these features to construct steering vectors for multilingual generation control, LangFIR achieves the best average accuracy BLEU across three models (Gemma 3 1B, Gemma 3 4B, and Llama 3.1 8B), three datasets, and twelve target languages, outperforming the strongest monolingual baseline by up to and surpassing methods that rely on parallel data. Our results suggest that language identity in multilingual LLMs is localized in a sparse set of feature directions discoverable with monolingual data. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LangFIR-C0F5/.
tldr: LangFIR is a method for discovering sparse, language-specific features in LLM activations using only monolingual data and random-token filtering, enabling more effective language control during inference without parallel data.
tldr_zh: LangFIR是一种仅使用单语数据和随机标记序列来发现LLM激活中稀疏语言特定特征的方法，用于改进推理时的语言控制，无需平行数据。
summary_zh: 大语言模型展现出强大的多语言能力，但可靠控制其输出语言仍具挑战性。表示层引导方法通过在推理时向模型激活中添加语言特定向量来解决此问题，但在残差流中识别语言特定方向通常依赖于昂贵且难以获取的多语言或平行数据。稀疏自编码器将残差激活分解为可解释的稀疏特征方向，为此类搜索提供了自然基础，但现有基于稀疏自编码器的方法仍面临相同的数据约束。我们提出LangFIR（基于随机令牌过滤的语言特征识别方法），该方法仅需少量单语数据和随机令牌序列即可发现语言特定的稀疏自编码器特征。许多被目标语言输入持续激活的稀疏自编码器特征并不编码语言身份信息。随机令牌序列能够筛选出这些语言无关特征，使LangFIR得以滤除它们并分离出稀疏的语言特定特征集合。研究表明这些特征具有极强稀疏性、对目标语言的高度选择性以及因果重要性：方向性消融仅会提升对应语言的交叉熵损失。利用这些特征构建多语言生成控制的引导向量后，LangFIR在三个模型（Gemma 3 1B、Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.1 8B）、三个数据集和十二种目标语言上取得了最佳平均准确率BLEU值，较最强单语基线方法提升最高达，且优于依赖平行数据的方法。我们的研究结果表明，多语言大语言模型中的语言身份信息定位于可通过单语数据发现的稀疏特征方向集合中。代码发布于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LangFIR-C0F5/。

title: Structural Rigidity and the 57-Token Predictive Window: A Physical Framework for Inference-Layer Governability in Large Language Models
summary:
Current AI safety relies on behavioral monitoring and post-training alignment, yet empirical measurement shows these approaches produce no detectable pre-commitment signal in a majority of instruction-tuned models tested. We present an energy-based governance framework connecting transformer inference dynamics to constraint-satisfaction models of neural computation, and apply it to a seven-model cohort across five geometric regimes.
  Using trajectory tension (rho = ||a|| / ||v||), we identify a 57-token pre-commitment window in Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct under greedy decoding on arithmetic constraint probes. This result is model-specific, task-specific, and configuration-specific, demonstrating that pre-commitment signals can exist but are not universal.
  We introduce a five-regime taxonomy of inference behavior: Authority Band, Late Signal, Inverted, Flat, and Scaffold-Selective. Energy asymmetry (Σ\r{ho}_misaligned / Σ\r{ho}_aligned) serves as a unifying metric of structural rigidity across these regimes.
  Across seven models, only one configuration exhibits a predictive signal prior to commitment; all others show silent failure, late detection, inverted dynamics, or flat geometry.
  We further demonstrate that factual hallucination produces no predictive signal across 72 test conditions, consistent with spurious attractor settling in the absence of a trained world-model constraint.
  These results establish that rule violation and hallucination are distinct failure modes with different detection requirements. Internal geometry monitoring is effective only where resistance exists; detection of factual confabulation requires external verification mechanisms.
  This work provides a measurable framework for inference-layer governability and introduces a taxonomy for evaluating deployment risk in autonomous AI systems.
tldr: This paper proposes an energy-based framework and taxonomy to analyze the internal geometry and 'pre-commitment' signals of LLMs during inference for AI safety and governance, but finds these signals are not universal.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于能量的框架和分类法，用于分析大语言模型在推理过程中内部几何结构及'预承诺'信号，以实现AI安全和治理，但发现这些信号并不普遍。
summary_zh:
当前的人工智能安全依赖行为监控与训练后对齐，但实证测量表明这些方法在多数被测指令微调模型中未能产生可检测的预先承诺信号。我们提出一种基于能量的治理框架，将Transformer推理动力学与神经计算的约束满足模型相连接，并将其应用于跨越五种几何机制下的七个模型队列。

通过轨迹张力（ρ = ||a|| / ||v||）分析，我们在算术约束探针任务下采用贪婪解码的Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct模型中识别出57个令牌长度的预先承诺窗口。该结果具有模型特异性、任务特异性和配置特异性，表明预先承诺信号可能存在但并非普遍存在。

我们提出推理行为的五机制分类体系：权威带、迟滞信号、反转型、平坦型及支架选择型。能量不对称性（Σρ_未对齐 / Σρ_已对齐）作为统一度量指标，用于刻画这些机制间的结构刚性差异。

在七个模型的测试中，仅有一种配置在承诺前呈现预测性信号；其余所有配置均表现为静默失败、延迟检测、反向动力学或平坦几何特征。

我们进一步证明，在72组测试条件下，事实性幻觉未产生任何预测信号，这与缺乏训练完善的世界模型约束时产生的伪吸引子沉降现象相符。

这些结果表明规则违反与幻觉是两种具有不同检测需求的失效模式。内部几何监控仅在存在抵抗力的场景下有效；事实性虚构的检测则需要外部验证机制。

本研究为推理层可治理性提供了可测量的框架，并建立了评估自主人工智能系统部署风险的分类型系。

title: BioAlchemy: Distilling Biological Literature into Reasoning-Ready Reinforcement Learning Training Data
summary: Despite the large corpus of biology training text, the impact of reasoning models on biological research generally lags behind math and coding. In this work, we show that biology questions from current large-scale reasoning datasets do not align well with modern research topic distributions in biology, and that this topic imbalance may negatively affect performance. In addition, we find that methods for extracting challenging and verifiable research problems from biology research text are a critical yet underdeveloped ingredient in applying reinforcement learning for better performance on biology research tasks. We introduce BioAlchemy, a pipeline for sourcing a diverse set of verifiable question-and-answer pairs from a scientific corpus of biology research text. We curate BioAlchemy-345K, a training dataset containing over 345K scientific reasoning problems in biology. Then, we demonstrate how aligning our dataset to the topic distribution of modern scientific biology can be used with reinforcement learning to improve reasoning performance. Finally, we present BioAlchemist-8B, which improves over its base reasoning model by 9.12% on biology benchmarks. These results demonstrate the efficacy of our approach for developing stronger scientific reasoning capabilities in biology. The BioAlchemist-8B model is available at: https://huggingface.co/BioAlchemy.
tldr: This paper introduces BioAlchemy, a pipeline for creating biology question-answering datasets to train and improve scientific reasoning models via reinforcement learning, specifically for biology research tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了BioAlchemy，一个用于从生物学研究文本中创建问答数据集以通过强化学习训练和改进科学推理模型、专门用于生物学研究任务的流程。
summary_zh: 尽管生物学训练文本库规模庞大，但推理模型对生物学研究的影响普遍滞后于数学和编程领域。本研究发现，当前大规模推理数据集中的生物学问题与当代生物学研究主题分布存在显著偏差，这种主题失衡可能对模型性能产生负面影响。此外，我们指出从生物学研究文本中提取具有挑战性且可验证的科研问题的方法，是运用强化学习提升生物学研究任务性能的关键但尚不成熟的技术环节。为此，我们提出BioAlchemy流程——一种从生物学研究文献科学语料库中获取多样化可验证问答对的技术框架，并据此构建了包含超过34.5万个生物学科学推理问题的训练数据集BioAlchemy-345K。研究进一步证明，通过将数据集与当代生物学科学主题分布对齐，结合强化学习方法可有效提升推理性能。最终，我们推出BioAlchemist-8B模型，该模型在生物学基准测试中较其基础推理模型性能提升9.12%。这些成果验证了本方法在增强生物学科学推理能力方面的有效性。BioAlchemist-8B模型已在https://huggingface.co/BioAlchemy发布。

title: Evolutionary Search for Automated Design of Uncertainty Quantification Methods
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for large language models are predominantly designed by hand based on domain knowledge and heuristics, limiting their scalability and generality. We apply LLM-powered evolutionary search to automatically discover unsupervised UQ methods represented as Python programs. On the task of atomic claim verification, our evolved methods outperform strong manually-designed baselines, achieving up to 6.7% relative ROC-AUC improvement across 9 datasets while generalizing robustly out-of-distribution. Qualitative analysis reveals that different LLMs employ qualitatively distinct evolutionary strategies: Claude models consistently design high-feature-count linear estimators, while Gpt-oss-120B gravitates toward simpler and more interpretable positional weighting schemes. Surprisingly, only Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5 reliably leverage increased method complexity to improve performance -- Opus 4.6 shows an unexpected regression relative to its predecessor. Overall, our results indicate that LLM-powered evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for automated, interpretable hallucination detector design.
tldr: The paper uses LLM-powered evolutionary search to automatically design unsupervised uncertainty quantification methods for large language models, specifically for atomic claim verification tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用基于大语言模型的进化搜索，为大型语言模型自动设计无监督的不确定性量化方法，特别针对原子声明验证任务。
summary_zh: 针对大语言模型的不确定性量化方法主要依靠领域知识与启发式规则进行人工设计，这限制了其可扩展性与通用性。本研究应用基于大语言模型的进化搜索技术，自动发现以Python程序形式表示的无监督不确定性量化方法。在原子事实核查任务中，我们演化出的方法显著超越了强人工设计的基线模型，在9个数据集上实现了最高6.7%的相对ROC-AUC提升，并展现出优异的分布外泛化能力。定性分析表明，不同大语言模型采用了本质差异化的进化策略：Claude系列模型持续设计出高特征维度的线性估计器，而Gpt-oss-120B更倾向于简洁且可解释的位置加权方案。值得注意的是，仅Sonnet 4.5和Opus 4.5能有效利用方法复杂度提升性能——Opus 4.6竟意外出现了相对于前代版本的性能倒退。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，基于大语言模型的进化搜索为自动化、可解释的幻觉检测器设计提供了富有前景的研究范式。

title: Measuring LLM Trust Allocation Across Conflicting Software Artifacts
summary: LLM-based software engineering assistants fail not only by producing incorrect outputs, but also by allocating trust to the wrong artifact when code, documentation, and tests disagree. Existing evaluations focus mainly on downstream outcomes and therefore cannot reveal whether a model recognized degraded evidence, identified the unreliable source, or calibrated its trust across artifacts. We present TRACE (Trust Reasoning over Artifacts for Calibrated Evaluation), a framework that elicits structured artifact-level trust traces over Javadoc, method signatures, implementations, and test prefixes under blind perturbations. Using 22,339 valid traces from seven models on 456 curated Java method bundles, we evaluate per-artifact quality assessment, inconsistency detection, affected artifact attribution, and source prioritization. Across all models, quality penalties are largely localized to the perturbed artifact and increase with severity, but sensitivity is asymmetric across artifact types: documentation bugs induce a substantially larger heavy-to-subtle gap than implementation faults (0.152-0.253 vs. 0.049-0.123). Models detect explicit documentation bugs well (67-94%) and Javadoc and implementation contradictions at 50-91%, yet show a systematic blind spot when only the implementation drifts while the documentation remains plausible, with detection dropping by 7-42 percentage points. Confidence is poorly calibrated for six of seven models. These findings suggest that current LLMs are better at auditing natural-language specifications than at detecting subtle code-level drift, motivating explicit artifact-level trust reasoning before correctness-critical downstream use.
tldr: The paper introduces TRACE, a framework for evaluating how LLMs allocate trust across conflicting software artifacts (code, documentation, tests) in programming tasks, revealing systematic blind spots and poor calibration.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了TRACE框架，用于评估大语言模型在编程任务中如何处理相互冲突的软件工件（代码、文档、测试），揭示了系统性的盲点与校准不佳的问题。
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的软件工程助手不仅会在产生错误输出时失效，更会在代码、文档和测试存在矛盾时错误分配信任。现有评估主要关注下游结果，因而无法揭示模型是否识别了质量降级的证据、确定了不可靠来源或在各工件间校准了信任度。我们提出TRACE（基于工件的信任推理校准评估框架），该框架通过盲态扰动在Javadoc文档、方法签名、实现和测试前缀上提取结构化工件级信任轨迹。利用七个模型在456个精选Java方法包上生成的22,339条有效轨迹，我们评估了各工件质量评估、不一致性检测、受影响工件归因和来源优先级排序能力。所有模型中，质量惩罚主要集中于被扰动工件且随严重程度增加，但对不同工件的敏感度呈现非对称性：文档缺陷引发的重度与轻度惩罚差距（0.152-0.253）显著大于实现错误（0.049-0.123）。模型能有效检测显性文档缺陷（67-94%）及Javadoc与实现矛盾（50-91%），但在实现逻辑漂移而文档保持合理时存在系统性盲区，检测率下降7-42个百分点。七个模型中有六个的置信度校准表现不佳。这些发现表明，当前大语言模型在审计自然语言规范方面优于检测细微代码级漂移，需要在执行关键性下游任务前进行显式的工件级信任推理。

title: MetaSAEs: Joint Training with a Decomposability Penalty Produces More Atomic Sparse Autoencoder Latents
summary:
Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used for safety-relevant applications including alignment detection and model steering. These use cases require SAE latents to be as atomic as possible. Each latent should represent a single coherent concept drawn from a single underlying representational subspace. In practice, SAE latents blend representational subspaces together. A single feature can activate across semantically distinct contexts that share no true common representation, muddying an already complex picture of model computation. We introduce a joint training objective that directly penalizes this subspace blending. A small meta SAE is trained alongside the primary SAE to sparsely reconstruct the primary SAE's decoder columns; the primary SAE is penalized whenever its decoder directions are easy to reconstruct from the meta dictionary. This occurs whenever latent directions lie in a subspace spanned by other primary directions. This creates gradient pressure toward more mutually independent decoder directions that resist sparse meta-compression.
  On GPT-2 large (layer 20), the selected configuration reduces mean $|\varphi|$ by 7.5% relative to an identical solo SAE trained on the same data. Automated interpretability (fuzzing) scores improve by 7.6%, providing external validation of the atomicity gain independent of the training and co-occurrence metrics. Reconstruction overhead is modest. Results on Gemma 2 9B are directional. On not-fully-converged SAEs, the same parameterization yields the best results, a $+8.6\%$ $Δ$Fuzz. Though directional, this is an encouraging sign that the method transfers to a larger model. Qualitative analysis confirms that features firing on polysemantic tokens are split into semantically distinct sub-features, each specializing in a distinct representational subspace.
tldr: Proposes a joint training method with a meta-SAE to penalize subspace blending, producing more atomic, interpretable features in sparse autoencoders. Shows improvements in feature interpretability and atomicity on GPT-2 and Gemma 2 models.
tldr_zh: 提出一种联合训练方法，通过引入元稀疏自编码器并惩罚子空间混合，使得稀疏自编码器产生更原子化、可解释的特征。在GPT-2和Gemma 2模型上展示了特征可解释性和原子性的改进。
summary_zh:
稀疏自编码器（SAE）正越来越多地用于安全性相关应用，包括对齐检测和模型引导。这些应用场景要求SAE的潜在表征尽可能具备原子性。每个潜在表征应代表从单个底层表征子空间提取的单一连贯概念。然而，在实际应用中，SAE的潜在表征往往将多个表征子空间混合在一起。单个特征可能激活于语义不同、不存在真实共同表征的上下文环境中，这进一步模糊了本已复杂的模型计算图景。我们引入了一种联合训练目标函数，直接惩罚这种子空间混合现象。该方法训练一个小型元SAE与主SAE并行运行，以稀疏重构主SAE的解码器列向量；当主SAE的解码器方向能够被元字典轻易重构时，主SAE就会受到惩罚。这种情况发生在潜在方向位于由其他主方向张成的子空间中时。由此产生的梯度压力会促使解码器方向更加相互独立，从而抵抗稀疏元压缩。

在GPT-2大模型（第20层）的实验中，选定配置相对于使用相同数据训练的相同独立SAE，平均$|\varphi|$值降低了7.5%。自动化可解释性（模糊测试）评分提升了7.6%，这为原子性增益提供了独立于训练指标和共现度量的外部验证。重构开销保持在适度水平。在Gemma 2 9B模型上的实验结果具有方向性意义。对于未完全收敛的SAE，相同参数配置取得了最佳结果，实现$+8.6\%$的$Δ$Fuzz增益。虽然仅为方向性验证，但该结果表明方法可迁移至更大规模模型，这具有积极意义。定性分析进一步证实，原先在多义词单元上激活的特征被分解为语义不同的子特征，每个子特征专门对应独立的表征子空间。

title: AEGIS: Scaling Long-Sequence Homomorphic Encrypted Transformer Inference via Hybrid Parallelism on Multi-GPU Systems
summary:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables privacy-preserving Transformer inference, but long-sequence encrypted Transformers quickly exceed single-GPU memory capacity because encoded weights are already large and encrypted activations grow rapidly with sequence length. Multi-GPU execution therefore becomes unavoidable, yet scaling remains challenging because communication is jointly induced by application-level aggregation and encryption-level RNS coupling. Existing approaches either synchronize between devices frequently or replicate encrypted tensors across devices, leading to excessive communication and latency.
  We present AEGIS, an Application-Encryption Guided Inference System for scalable long-sequence encrypted Transformer inference on multi-GPU platforms. AEGIS derives device placement from ciphertext dependencies jointly induced by Transformer dataflow and CKKS polynomial coupling, co-locating modulus-coherent and token-coherent data so that communication is introduced only when application dependencies require it, while reordering polynomial operators to overlap the remaining collectives with computation.
  On 2048-token inputs, AEGIS reduces inter-GPU communication by up to 57.9% in feed-forward networks and 81.3% in self-attention versus prior state-of-the-art designs. On four GPUs, it achieves up to 96.62% scaling efficiency, 3.86x end-to-end speedup, and 69.1% per-device memory reduction. These results establish coordinated application-encryption parallelism as a practical foundation for scalable homomorphic Transformer inference.
tldr: AEGIS is a system for scaling long-sequence encrypted Transformer inference on multi-GPU systems by co-designing parallelism with the application's dataflow and the encryption scheme's requirements, significantly reducing communication overhead.
tldr_zh: AEGIS 是一个用于在多GPU系统上扩展长序列加密Transformer推理的系统，通过联合设计应用程序数据流和加密方案要求的并行性，显著减少了通信开销。
summary_zh:
全同态加密能够实现隐私保护的Transformer推理，但长序列加密Transformer模型会迅速超出单GPU内存容量——因为编码后的权重本已庞大，而加密激活值又随序列长度快速增长。因此多GPU执行成为必然选择，但扩展性仍面临挑战：应用层聚合与加密层剩余数系统耦合共同引发了通信需求。现有方法要么频繁进行设备间同步，要么在设备间复制加密张量，导致通信开销和延迟居高不下。

本文提出AEGIS——一种面向多GPU平台可扩展长序列加密Transformer推理的应用-加密协同引导推理系统。AEGIS通过联合分析Transformer数据流与CKKS多项式耦合产生的密文依赖关系，推导出设备布局策略，将模数一致与令牌一致的数据就近放置，使得仅当应用层依赖需要时才引入通信，同时通过重排多项式算子将剩余的集合通信与计算过程重叠。

针对2048个令牌的输入，AEGIS在前馈网络中相比现有最优设计可减少57.9%的GPU间通信，在自注意力机制中可减少81.3%。在四GPU配置下，系统实现了最高96.62%的扩展效率，端到端加速比达3.86倍，单设备内存占用降低69.1%。这些成果表明，协同应用-加密并行机制为可扩展的同态加密Transformer推理奠定了实用基础。

title: TABQAWORLD: Optimizing Multimodal Reasoning for Multi-Turn Table Question Answering
summary: Multimodal reasoning has emerged as a powerful framework for enhancing reasoning capabilities of reasoning models. While multi-turn table reasoning methods have improved reasoning accuracy through tool use and reward modeling, they rely on fixed text serialization for table state readouts. This introduces representation errors in table encoding that significantly accumulate over multiple turns. Such accumulation is alleviated by tabular grounding methods in the expense of inference compute and cost, rendering real world deployment impractical. To address this, we introduce TABQAWORLD, a table reasoning framework that jointly optimizes tabular action through representation and estimation. For representation, TABQAWORLD employs an action-conditioned multimodal selection policy, which dynamically switches between visual and textual representations to maximize table state readout reliability. For estimation, TABQAWORLD optimizes stepwise reasoning trajectory through table metadata including dimension, data types and key values, safely planning trajectory and compressing low-complexity actions to reduce conversation turns and latency. Designed as a training-free framework, empirical evaluations show that TABQAWORLD achieves state-of-the-art performance with 4.87% accuracy improvements over baselines, with 5.42% accuracy gain and 33.35% inference latency reduction over static settings, establishing a new standard for reliable and efficient table reasoning.
tldr: The paper introduces TABQAWORLD, a training-free framework for multi-turn table question answering that jointly optimizes tabular action representation and estimation to improve accuracy and reduce latency, without any mention of robotics or embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TABQAWORLD，一个用于多轮表格问答的训练无关框架，通过联合优化表格动作的表征和估计来提高精度并降低延迟，未提及机器人或具身智能体。
summary_zh: 多模态推理已成为增强推理模型能力的强大框架。虽然多轮表格推理方法通过工具使用和奖励建模提高了推理准确性，但它们依赖固定的文本序列化方式进行表格状态读取。这在表格编码中引入了表征误差，并随着推理轮次显著累积。表格接地方法通过增加推理计算和成本缓解了这种累积，但导致实际部署难以实现。为此，我们提出了TABQAWORLD——一种通过表征与估计联合优化表格操作的推理框架。在表征层面，TABQAWORLD采用动作条件化的多模态选择策略，动态切换视觉与文本表征以最大化表格状态读取的可靠性。在估计层面，TABQAWORLD通过维度、数据类型及关键值等表格元数据优化逐步推理轨迹，安全规划路径并压缩低复杂度操作，从而减少对话轮次与延迟。该免训练框架的实证评估表明：TABQAWORLD以4.87%的准确率提升超越基线，较静态设置实现5.42%的准确率增益和33.35%的推理延迟降低，为可靠高效的表格推理确立了新标准。

title: Bridging Restoration and Diagnosis: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Retinal Fundus Enhancement
summary: Over the past decade, generative models have demonstrated success in enhancing fundus images. However, the evaluation of these models remains a challenge. A benchmark for fundus image enhancement is needed for three main reasons:(1) Conventional denoising metrics such as PSNR and SSIM fail to capture clinically relevant features, such as lesion preservation and vessel morphology consistency, limiting their applicability in real-world settings; (2) There is a lack of unified evaluation protocols that address both paired and unpaired enhancement methods, particularly those guided by clinical expertise; and (3) An evaluation framework should provide actionable insights to guide future advancements in clinically aligned enhancement models. To address these gaps, we introduce EyeBench-V2, a benchmark designed to bridge the gap between enhancement model performance and clinical utility. Our work offers three key contributions:(1) Multi-dimensional clinical-alignment through downstream evaluations: Beyond standard enhancement metrics, we assess performance across clinically meaningful tasks including vessel segmentation, diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading, generalization to unseen noise patterns, and lesion segmentation. (2) Expert-guided evaluation design: We curate a novel dataset enabling fair comparisons between paired and unpaired enhancement methods, accompanied by a structured manual assessment protocol by medical experts, which evaluates clinically critical aspects such as lesion structure alterations, background color shifts, and the introduction of artificial structures. (3) Actionable insights: Our benchmark provides a rigorous, task-oriented analysis of existing generative models, equipping clinical researchers with the evidence needed to make informed decisions, while also identifying limitations in current methods to inform the design of next-generation enhancement models.
tldr: The paper introduces EyeBench-V2, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus image enhancement models, focusing on clinical utility through multi-dimensional tasks and expert-guided assessment.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EyeBench-V2，这是一个用于评估视网膜眼底图像增强模型的综合基准，通过多维任务和专家指导的评估来关注临床实用性。
summary_zh: 在过去十年中，生成模型在增强眼底图像方面取得了显著成功。然而，这些模型的评估仍面临挑战。建立眼底图像增强基准的必要性主要基于以下三点原因：(1) 传统去噪指标如PSNR和SSIM无法捕捉临床相关特征，如病灶保留和血管形态一致性，限制了其在实际应用中的有效性；(2) 缺乏统一的评估框架来同时处理配对与非配对增强方法，尤其是缺乏临床专业知识指导的评估方法；(3) 评估框架应提供可操作的见解，以指导临床导向增强模型的未来发展。为弥补这些不足，我们推出了EyeBench-V2基准，旨在弥合增强模型性能与临床效用之间的差距。本研究包含三个关键贡献：(1) 通过下游任务实现多维临床对齐评估：除标准增强指标外，我们评估了临床相关任务的表现，包括血管分割、糖尿病视网膜病变分级、对未见噪声模式的泛化能力及病灶分割；(2) 专家指导的评估设计：我们构建了一个新颖数据集，支持对配对与非配对增强方法进行公平比较，并引入医学专家制定的结构化人工评估方案，重点评估病灶结构变化、背景色偏移及人工结构引入等临床关键维度；(3) 可操作见解：本基准对现有生成模型进行了严格的任务导向分析，为临床研究者提供决策依据，同时揭示了当前方法的局限性，为下一代增强模型的设计指明方向。

title: Shower-Aware Dual-Stream Voxel Networks for Structural Defect Detection in Cosmic-Ray Muon Tomography
summary: We present SA-DSVN, a 3D convolutional architecture for voxel-level segmentation of structural defects in reinforced concrete using cosmic-ray muon tomography. Unlike conventional reconstruction methods (POCA, MLSD) that rely solely on muon scattering angles, our approach jointly processes scattering kinematics (9 channels) and secondary electromagnetic shower multiplicities (40 channels) through independent encoder streams fused via cross-attention. Training data were generated using Vega, a cloud-native Geant4 simulation framework, producing 4.5 million muon events across 900 volumes containing four defect types - honeycombing, shear fracture, corrosion voids, and delamination - embedded within a dense 7x7 rebar cage. A five-variant ablation study demonstrates that the shower multiplicity stream alone accounts for the majority of discriminative power, raising defect-mean Dice from 0.535 (scattering only) to 0.685 (shower only). On 60 independently simulated validation volumes, the model achieves 96.3% voxel accuracy, per-defect Dice scores of 0.59-0.81, and 100% volume-level detection sensitivity at 10 ms inference per volume. These results establish secondary shower multiplicity as a previously unexploited but highly effective feature for learned muon tomographic reconstruction.
tldr: This paper introduces a 3D convolutional neural network for detecting structural defects in concrete using cosmic-ray muon tomography data, focusing on the novel use of secondary electromagnetic shower information.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于宇宙射线μ子断层扫描的结构缺陷检测的3D卷积神经网络，重点关注了二次电磁簇射信息这一新颖特征的使用。
summary_zh: 本文提出SA-DSVN，一种基于宇宙射线μ子成像的钢筋混凝土结构缺陷体素级分割三维卷积架构。与传统仅依赖μ子散射角的重建方法（POCA、MLSD）不同，该方法通过独立编码器流分别处理散射运动学（9通道）与次级电磁簇射多重数（40通道），并借助交叉注意力机制进行特征融合。训练数据由云原生Geant4模拟框架Vega生成，包含嵌入密集7×7钢筋笼中的蜂窝、剪切断裂、腐蚀空洞与层离四类缺陷，共900个体积中450万个μ子事件。五项消融实验表明，簇射多重数流单独贡献了大部分判别力，将缺陷平均Dice系数从纯散射流的0.535提升至纯簇射流的0.685。在60个独立模拟验证体上，该模型实现了96.3%的体素精度、0.59-0.81的逐类缺陷Dice系数，以及100%的体级检测灵敏度，单个体积推理时间仅需10毫秒。这些结果证实次级簇射多重数是μ子成像学习重建中一项尚未开发但极具效力的特征。

title: CGHair: Compact Gaussian Hair Reconstruction with Card Clustering
summary: We present a compact pipeline for high-fidelity hair reconstruction from multi-view images. While recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods achieve realistic results, they often require millions of primitives, leading to high storage and rendering costs. Observing that hair exhibits structural and visual similarities across a hairstyle, we cluster strands into representative hair cards and group these into shared texture codebooks. Our approach integrates this structure with 3DGS rendering, significantly reducing reconstruction time and storage while maintaining comparable visual quality. In addition, we propose a generative prior accelerated method to reconstruct the initial strand geometry from a set of images. Our experiments demonstrate a 4-fold reduction in strand reconstruction time and achieve comparable rendering performance with over 200x lower memory footprint.
tldr: The paper presents a method for reconstructing realistic 3D hair models from multi-view images using a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting approach with clustering techniques to reduce memory and time requirements.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种从多视角图像重建逼真3D头发模型的方法，使用紧凑的3D高斯溅射技术及聚类方法，以降低内存和时间需求。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种从多视角图像重建高保真头发模型的紧凑流程。现有基于三维高斯溅射（3DGS）的方法虽能实现逼真效果，但通常需要数百万基元，导致存储与渲染成本高昂。我们观察到同一发型中的发丝具有结构和视觉相似性，通过将发丝聚类为代表性发片并将这些发片组织到共享纹理编码本中，将这一结构与3DGS渲染相结合，在保持相当视觉质量的同时显著降低了重建时间和存储需求。此外，我们提出一种基于生成先验的加速方法，可从图像集快速重建初始发丝几何结构。实验表明，该方法将发丝重建时间缩短至原有四分之一，并以超过200倍的内存压缩率实现了相当的渲染性能。

title: ResGuard: Enhancing Robustness Against Known Original Attacks in Deep Watermarking
summary: Deep learning-based image watermarking commonly adopts an "Encoder-Noise Layer-Decoder" (END) architecture to improve robustness against random channel distortions, yet it often overlooks intentional manipulations introduced by adversaries with additional knowledge. In this paper, we revisit this paradigm and expose a critical yet underexplored vulnerability: the Known Original Attack (KOA), where an adversary has access to multiple original-watermarked image pairs, enabling various targeted suppression strategies. We show that even a simple residual-based removal approach, namely estimating an embedding residual from known pairs and subtracting it from unseen watermarked images, can almost completely remove the watermark while preserving visual quality. This vulnerability stems from the insufficient image dependency of residuals produced by END frameworks, which makes them transferable across images. To address this, we propose ResGuard, a plug-and-play module that enhances KOA robustness by enforcing image-dependent embedding. Its core lies in a residual specificity enhancement loss, which encourages residuals to be tightly coupled with their host images and thus improves image dependency. Furthermore, an auxiliary KOA noise layer injects residual-style perturbations during training, allowing the decoder to remain reliable under stronger embedding inconsistencies. Integrated into existing frameworks, ResGuard boosts KOA robustness, improving average watermark extraction accuracy from 59.87% to 99.81%.
tldr: This paper addresses a vulnerability in deep learning-based image watermarking to Known Original Attacks (KOA) and proposes a plug-and-play module, ResGuard, to improve robustness by making the embedding residuals image-dependent.
tldr_zh: 本文针对深度学习图像水印中的“已知原图攻击”漏洞，提出了一种即插即用模块ResGuard，通过增强嵌入残差对图像的依赖性来提高水印的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 基于深度学习的图像水印技术通常采用“编码器-噪声层-解码器”（END）架构以提升对随机信道失真的鲁棒性，却往往忽视了掌握额外知识的对手可能施加的故意篡改。本文重新审视这一范式，揭示了一个关键但尚未被充分探索的脆弱性：已知原图攻击（KOA）。在此攻击中，攻击者能够获取多对原始图像与水印图像的配对，从而实施多种有针对性的抑制策略。我们证明，即便采用一种基于残差的简单去除方法——即通过已知图像对估算嵌入残差，并将其从未知水印图像中减去——也能在保持视觉质量的同时几乎完全去除水印。这种脆弱性源于END框架生成的残差对图像的依赖性不足，导致残差在不同图像间具有可转移性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种即插即用模块ResGuard，通过增强图像依赖的嵌入来提升对KOA的鲁棒性。其核心在于一种残差特异性增强损失，该损失促使残差与宿主图像紧密耦合，从而提高图像依赖性。此外，辅助的KOA噪声层在训练过程中注入残差式扰动，使解码器在更强的嵌入不一致性下仍能保持可靠性。将ResGuard集成到现有框架中，可显著提升对KOA的鲁棒性，将平均水印提取准确率从59.87%提升至99.81%。

title: SciLT: Long-Tailed Classification in Scientific Image Domains
summary: Long-tailed recognition has benefited from foundation models and fine-tuning paradigms, yet existing studies and benchmarks are mainly confined to natural image domains, where pre-training and fine-tuning data share similar distributions. In contrast, scientific images exhibit distinct visual characteristics and supervision signals, raising questions about the effectiveness of fine-tuning foundation models in such settings. In this work, we investigate scientific long-tailed recognition under a purely visual and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) paradigm. Experiments on three scientific benchmarks show that fine-tuning foundation models yields limited gains, and reveal that penultimate-layer features play an important role, particularly for tail classes. Motivated by these findings, we propose SciLT, a framework that exploits multi-level representations through adaptive feature fusion and dual-supervision learning. By jointly leveraging penultimate- and final-layer features, SciLT achieves balanced performance across head and tail classes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SciLT consistently outperforms existing methods, establishing a strong and practical baseline for scientific long-tailed recognition and providing valuable guidance for adapting foundation models to scientific data with substantial domain shifts.
tldr: Proposes SciLT, a framework for long-tailed classification in scientific image domains using adaptive feature fusion and dual-supervision to improve foundation model adaptation.
tldr_zh: 针对科学图像领域的长尾分类问题，提出了SciLT框架，通过自适应特征融合和双监督学习，提升基础模型在显著域偏移下的适应能力。
summary_zh:
摘要：
长尾识别受益于基础模型与微调范式，但现有研究和基准主要局限于自然图像领域，其预训练与微调数据分布相近。相比之下，科学图像具有独特的视觉特征与监督信号，这引发了在此类场景下微调基础模型有效性的质疑。本研究探究了纯视觉且参数高效微调（PEFT）范式下的科学长尾识别问题。在三个科学基准数据集上的实验表明，微调基础模型带来的增益有限，并揭示出倒数第二层特征——尤其是对尾部类别——具有重要作用。基于此发现，我们提出了SciLT框架，该框架通过自适应特征融合与双监督学习机制，充分利用多层次特征表示。通过联合利用倒数第二层与最终层特征，SciLT在头部和尾部类别上实现了均衡的性能表现。大量实验证明，SciLT始终优于现有方法，为科学长尾识别建立了坚实且实用的基准，并为适应领域差异显著的科学数据提供了基础模型调优的重要指导。

title: UniSurgSAM: A Unified Promptable Model for Reliable Surgical Video Segmentation
summary: Surgical video segmentation is fundamental to computer-assisted surgery. In practice, surgeons need to dynamically specify targets throughout extended procedures, using heterogeneous cues such as visual selections, textual expressions, or audio instructions. However, existing Promptable Video Object Segmentation (PVOS) methods are typically restricted to a single prompt modality and rely on coupled frameworks that cause optimization interference between target initialization and tracking. Moreover, these methods produce hallucinated predictions when the target is absent and suffer from accumulated mask drift without failure recovery. To address these challenges, we present UniSurgSAM, a unified PVOS model enabling reliable surgical video segmentation through visual, textual, or audio prompts. Specifically, UniSurgSAM employs a decoupled two-stage framework that independently optimizes initialization and tracking to resolve the optimization interference. Within this framework, we introduce three key designs for reliability: presence-aware decoding that models target absence to suppress hallucinations; boundary-aware long-term tracking that prevents mask drift over extended sequences; and adaptive state transition that closes the loop between stages for failure recovery. Furthermore, we establish a multi-modal and multi-granular benchmark from four public surgical datasets with precise instance-level masklets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniSurgSAM achieves state-of-the-art performance in real time across all prompt modalities and granularities, providing a practical foundation for computer-assisted surgery. Code and datasets will be available at https://jinlab-imvr.github.io/UniSurgSAM.
tldr: This paper introduces a unified, multi-modal promptable model for video object segmentation in surgical videos, focusing on addressing issues like optimization interference, hallucination, and mask drift, but it is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于手术视频分割的统一多模态提示模型，专注于解决优化干扰、幻觉预测和掩码漂移等问题，但与机器人或具身人工智能无直接关联。
summary_zh: 手术视频分割是计算机辅助手术的基础。在实际应用中，外科医生需要在长时间手术过程中动态指定目标，并利用视觉选择、文本表达或音频指令等多种提示方式。然而，现有的可提示视频对象分割方法通常局限于单一提示模态，且依赖于耦合框架，导致目标初始化与跟踪之间存在优化干扰。此外，这些方法在目标缺失时会产生幻觉预测，并在无失败恢复机制的情况下遭受掩模漂移的累积影响。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了UniSurgSAM——一个统一的PVOS模型，能够通过视觉、文本或音频提示实现可靠的手术视频分割。具体而言，UniSurgSAM采用解耦的两阶段框架，独立优化初始化与跟踪阶段以消除优化干扰。在该框架中，我们引入了三个提升可靠性的关键设计：通过感知目标存在性的解码机制抑制幻觉预测；采用边界感知的长时跟踪防止长序列中的掩模漂移；以及通过自适应状态转换实现阶段间的闭环失败恢复。此外，我们基于四个公开手术数据集构建了包含精确实例级掩模的多模态多粒度基准测试集。大量实验表明，UniSurgSAM在所有提示模态和粒度上均能实时实现最先进的性能，为计算机辅助手术提供了实用基础。代码与数据集将在https://jinlab-imvr.github.io/UniSurgSAM公开。

title: SBF: An Effective Representation to Augment Skeleton for Video-based Human Action Recognition
summary: Many modern video-based human action recognition (HAR) approaches use 2D skeleton as the intermediate representation in their prediction pipelines. Despite overall encouraging results, these approaches still struggle in many common scenes, mainly because the skeleton does not capture critical action-related information pertaining to the depth of the joints, contour of the human body, and interaction between the human and objects. To address this, we propose an effective approach to augment skeleton with a representation capturing action-related information in the pipeline of HAR. The representation, termed Scale-Body-Flow (SBF), consists of three distinct components, namely a scale map volume given by the scale (and hence depth information) of each joint, a body map outlining the human subject, and a flow map indicating human-object interaction given by pixel-wise optical flow values. To predict SBF, we further present SFSNet, a novel segmentation network supervised by the skeleton and optical flow without extra annotation overhead beyond the existing skeleton extraction. Extensive experiments across different datasets demonstrate that our pipeline based on SBF and SFSNet achieves significantly higher HAR accuracy with similar compactness and efficiency as compared with the state-of-the-art skeleton-only approaches.
tldr: This paper proposes a new representation called Scale-Body-Flow (SBF) to augment skeleton data for human action recognition in videos, and introduces a segmentation network (SFSNet) to predict it without extra annotation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Scale-Body-Flow（SBF）的新表示方法，用于增强视频中人体动作识别的骨架数据，并引入了一种无需额外标注的分割网络（SFSNet）来预测SBF。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
众多基于视频的现代人体动作识别（HAR）方法在预测流程中采用二维骨架作为中间表示。尽管整体结果令人鼓舞，但这些方法在许多常见场景中仍然面临挑战，主要原因在于骨架未能捕捉到关节深度、人体轮廓以及人与物体互动等关键动作相关信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种有效方法，在HAR流程中通过增强骨架表示来捕捉动作相关信息。该表示称为尺度-身体-流（Scale-Body-Flow, SBF），由三个独立组件构成：基于各关节尺度（即深度信息）生成的尺度映射体积、勾勒人体轮廓的身体映射，以及通过逐像素光流值反映人-物交互的流映射。为预测SBF，我们进一步提出SFSNet——一种新颖的分割网络，其监督信号源自骨架和光流信息，无需在现有骨架提取基础上增加额外标注成本。跨多个数据集的广泛实验表明，与当前最先进的纯骨架方法相比，基于SBF与SFSNet的流程在保持相近紧凑性和效率的同时，实现了显著更高的HAR准确率。

title: On the Efficiency of Sinkhorn-Knopp for Entropically Regularized Optimal Transport
summary:
The Sinkhorn--Knopp (SK) algorithm is a cornerstone method for matrix scaling and entropically regularized optimal transport (EOT). Despite its empirical efficiency, existing theoretical guarantees to achieve a target marginal accuracy $\varepsilon$ deteriorate severely in the presence of outliers, bottlenecked either by the global maximum regularized cost $η\|C\|_\infty$ (where $η$ is the regularization parameter and $C$ the cost matrix) or the matrix's minimum-to-maximum entry ratio $ν$. This creates a fundamental disconnect between theory and practice.
  In this paper, we resolve this discrepancy. For EOT, we introduce the novel concept of well-boundedness, a local bulk mass property that rigorously isolates the well-behaved portion of the data from extreme outliers. We prove that governed by this fundamental notion, SK recovers the target transport plan for a problem of dimension $n$ in $O(\log n - \log \varepsilon)$ iterations, completely independent of the regularized cost $η\|C\|_\infty$. Furthermore, we show that a virtually cost-free pre-scaling step eliminates the dimensional dependence entirely, accelerating convergence to a strictly dimension-free $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.
  Beyond EOT, we establish a sharp phase transition for general $(\boldsymbol{u},\boldsymbol{v})$-scaling governed by a critical matrix density threshold. We prove that when a matrix's density exceeds this threshold, the iteration complexity is strictly independent of $ν$. Conversely, when the density falls below this threshold, the dependence on $ν$ becomes unavoidable; in this sub-critical regime, we construct instances where SK requires $Ω(n/\varepsilon)$ iterations.
tldr: Provides theoretical analysis of the Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm for entropically regularized optimal transport, introducing a 'well-boundedness' concept to isolate outliers and proving improved, dimension-free iteration complexity guarantees.
tldr_zh: 对熵正则化最优传输的Sinkhorn-Knopp算法进行了理论分析，引入'良好有界性'概念以隔离异常值，并证明了改进的、与维度无关的迭代复杂度保证。
summary_zh:
Sinkhorn–Knopp (SK) 算法是矩阵缩放和熵正则化最优运输 (EOT) 的核心方法。尽管其在经验上效率很高，但现有实现目标边际精度 $\varepsilon$ 的理论保证在存在离群值时严重劣化，其瓶颈要么来自全局最大正则化成本 $η\|C\|_\infty$（其中 $η$ 为正则化参数，$C$ 为成本矩阵），要么来自矩阵的最小到最大项比值 $ν$。这导致理论与实际应用之间存在根本性脱节。

本文中，我们解决了这一矛盾。针对 EOT，我们提出了“良有界性”这一新概念，它是一种局部质量集中属性，能够严格地将数据中表现良好的部分与极端离群值分离开来。我们证明，在由这一基本概念所主导的情况下，SK 能在 $O(\log n - \log \varepsilon)$ 次迭代内恢复维度为 $n$ 问题的目标运输计划，且完全独立于正则化成本 $η\|C\|_\infty$。此外，我们证明一个几乎无需成本的前置缩放步骤能完全消除维度依赖性，将收敛加速至严格的维度无关 $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 次迭代。

在 EOT 之外，我们针对一般 $(\boldsymbol{u},\boldsymbol{v})$-缩放建立了一个尖锐的相变现象，其由一个临界矩阵密度阈值决定。我们证明，当矩阵的密度超过该阈值时，迭代复杂度与 $ν$ 严格无关；反之，当密度低于该阈值时，对 $ν$ 的依赖将不可避免，在此亚临界状态下，我们构造出 SK 需要 $Ω(n/\varepsilon)$ 次迭代的实例。

title: Evaluation of Bagging Predictors with Kernel Density Estimation and Bagging Score
summary: For a larger set of predictions of several differently trained machine learning models, known as bagging predictors, the mean of all predictions is taken by default. Nevertheless, this proceeding can deviate from the actual ground truth in certain parameter regions. An approach is presented to determine a representative y_BS from such a set of predictions using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) in nonlinear regression with Neural Networks (NN) which simultaneously provides an associated quality criterion beta_BS, called Bagging Score (BS), that reflects the confidence of the obtained ensemble prediction. It is shown that working with the new approach better predictions can be made than working with the common use of mean or median. In addition to this, the used method is contrasted to several approaches of nonlinear regression from the literatur, resulting in a top ranking in each of the calculated error values without using any optimization or feature selection technique.
tldr: The paper proposes a novel method for improving ensemble predictions from bagging predictors using Kernel Density Estimation, generating a better representative prediction and a confidence score (Bagging Score). The method outperforms using the mean or median without optimization or feature selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用核密度估计改进袋装预测器集合预测的新方法，它生成一个更好的代表性预测和一个置信度分数（Bagging Score），该方法在不使用优化或特征选择的情况下，其性能优于使用均值或中位数的方法。
summary_zh: 对于一个由多个不同训练机器学习模型的预测结果组成的较大集合（即袋装预测器），通常默认采用所有预测值的平均值。然而，这种方法在某些参数区域可能会偏离实际真值。本文提出一种方法，通过核密度估计（KDE）在神经网络（NN）非线性回归中，从这类预测集合中确定代表性值y_BS，并同时提供与之相关的质量指标β_BS（称为袋装评分），该指标反映了所获集成预测的置信度。研究表明，采用这种新方法比使用常见的均值或中位数方法能获得更优的预测效果。此外，该方法与文献中多种非线性回归方法进行对比，在无需任何优化或特征选择技术的情况下，所有计算误差指标均达到最优排名。

title: Simple yet Effective: Low-Rank Spatial Attention for Neural Operators
summary: Neural operators have emerged as data-driven surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), and their success hinges on efficiently modeling the long-range, global coupling among spatial points induced by the underlying physics. In many PDE regimes, the induced global interaction kernels are empirically compressible, exhibiting rapid spectral decay that admits low-rank approximations. We leverage this observation to unify representative global mixing modules in neural operators under a shared low-rank template: compressing high-dimensional pointwise features into a compact latent space, processing global interactions within it, and reconstructing the global context back to spatial points. Guided by this view, we introduce Low-Rank Spatial Attention (LRSA) as a clean and direct instantiation of this template. Crucially, unlike prior approaches that often rely on non-standard aggregation or normalization modules, LRSA is built purely from standard Transformer primitives, i.e., attention, normalization, and feed-forward networks, yielding a concise block that is straightforward to implement and directly compatible with hardware-optimized kernels. In our experiments, such a simple construction is sufficient to achieve high accuracy, yielding an average error reduction of over 17\% relative to second-best methods, while remaining stable and efficient in mixed-precision training.
tldr: The paper introduces Low-Rank Spatial Attention (LRSA), a simple and efficient Transformer-based module for neural operators that improves accuracy in solving PDEs by compressing and processing global interactions in a low-rank latent space.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了低秩空间注意力（LRSA），这是一种用于神经算子的简单高效的Transformer模块，通过在低秩潜在空间中压缩和处理全局交互，提高了求解偏微分方程的准确性。
summary_zh: 神经算子已成为求解偏微分方程的数据驱动替代方法，其成功关键在于高效建模由底层物理规律引发的空间点之间长程、全局耦合关系。在许多偏微分方程体系中，经验表明所诱导的全局相互作用核具有可压缩性，表现出快速的光谱衰减特征，从而允许低秩近似。我们基于这一观察，将神经算子中代表性的全局混合模块统一到一个共享的低秩模板下：将高维逐点特征压缩至紧凑的潜在空间，在该空间内处理全局相互作用，并将全局上下文重构回空间点。在此框架指导下，我们提出了低秩空间注意力机制作为该模板的简洁直接实现。关键之处在于，与以往常依赖非标准聚合或归一化模块的方法不同，低秩空间注意力机制完全由标准Transformer基本构件（即注意力机制、归一化层和前馈网络）构建而成，形成了一个易于实现且可直接兼容硬件优化内核的简洁模块。实验结果表明，这种简单构造足以实现高精度，相较于次优方法的平均误差降低超过17%，同时在混合精度训练中保持稳定高效。

title: Choosing the Right Regularizer for Applied ML: Simulation Benchmarks of Popular Scikit-learn Regularization Frameworks
summary: This study surveys the historical development of regularization, tracing its evolution from stepwise regression in the 1960s to recent advancements in formal error control, structured penalties for non-independent features, Bayesian methods, and l0-based regularization (among other techniques). We empirically evaluate the performance of four canonical frameworks -- Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, and Post-Lasso OLS -- across 134,400 simulations spanning a 7-dimensional manifold grounded in eight production-grade machine learning models. Our findings demonstrate that for prediction accuracy when the sample-to-feature ratio is sufficient (n/p >= 78), Ridge, Lasso, and ElasticNet are nearly interchangeable. However, we find that Lasso recall is highly fragile under multicollinearity; at high condition numbers (kappa) and low SNR, Lasso recall collapses to 0.18 while ElasticNet maintains 0.93. Consequently, we advise practitioners against using Lasso or Post-Lasso OLS at high kappa with small sample sizes. The analysis concludes with an objective-driven decision guide to assist machine learning engineers in selecting the optimal scikit-learn-supported framework based on observable feature space attributes.
tldr: This paper surveys and benchmarks classical linear regularization techniques (Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet) for applied machine learning, providing guidelines for selecting the right method based on dataset characteristics like sample size and multicollinearity.
tldr_zh: 本文对经典线性正则化技术（Ridge、Lasso、ElasticNet）进行了调查和基准测试，基于样本量和多重共线性等数据集特征，为选择合适的方法提供了指导。
summary_zh: 本研究系统回顾了正则化方法的历史发展，梳理了其从1960年代逐步回归到近期在形式化误差控制、非独立特征结构化惩罚、贝叶斯方法及基于l0的正则化（及其他技术）等方面的演进脉络。通过对八个生产级机器学习模型构建的七维参数空间进行134,400次模拟实验，我们实证评估了四种经典框架——岭回归、套索回归、弹性网络及后套索最小二乘法的性能表现。研究结果表明，在样本特征比充足（n/p ≥ 78）时，岭回归、套索回归和弹性网络在预测精度上几乎可互换。然而我们发现，套索回归的召回率在多重共线性条件下极为脆弱：在高条件数（κ）和低信噪比场景下，套索回归召回率会骤降至0.18，而弹性网络仍能保持0.93的召回率。因此，我们建议从业者在高条件数、小样本量的场景下避免使用套索回归或后套索最小二乘法。最后，本文提出基于目标导向的决策指南，以帮助机器学习工程师根据可观测的特征空间属性，选择最优的scikit-learn支持框架。

title: Online learning of smooth functions on $\mathbb{R}$
summary:
We study adversarial online learning of real-valued functions on $\mathbb{R}$. In each round the learner is queried at $x_t\in\mathbb{R}$, predicts $\hat y_t$, and then observes the true value $f(x_t)$; performance is measured by cumulative $p$-loss $\sum_{t\ge 1}|\hat y_t-f(x_t)|^p$. For the class \[ \mathcal{G}_q=\Bigl\{f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\ \text{absolutely continuous}:\ \int_{\mathbb{R}}|f'(x)|^q\,dx\le 1\Bigr\}, \] we show that the standard model becomes ill-posed on $\mathbb{R}$: for every $p\ge 1$ and $q>1$, an adversary can force infinite loss. Motivated by this obstruction, we analyze three modified learning scenarios that limit the influence of queries that are far from previously observed inputs. In Scenario 1 the adversary must choose each new query within distance $1$ of some past query. In Scenario 2 the adversary may query anywhere, but the learner is penalized only on rounds whose query lies within distance $1$ of a past query. In Scenario 3 the loss in round $t$ is multiplied by a weight $g(\min_{j<t}|x_t-x_j|)$.
  We obtain sharp characterizations for Scenarios 1-2 in several regimes. For Scenario 3 we identify a clean threshold phenomenon: if $g$ decays too slowly, then the adversary can force infinite weighted loss. In contrast, for rapidly decaying weights such as $g(z)=e^{-cz}$ we obtain finite and sharp guarantees in the quadratic case $p=q=2$. Finally, we study a natural multivariable slice generalization $\mathcal{G}_{q,d}$ of $\mathcal{G}_q$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ and show a sharp dichotomy: while the one-dimensional case admits finite opt-values in certain regimes, for every $d\ge 2$ the slice class $\mathcal{G}_{q,d}$ is too permissive, and even under Scenarios 1-3 an adversary can force infinite loss.
tldr: This paper is a theoretical study of adversarial online learning for real-valued functions on the real line and its multi-dimensional generalization, focusing on establishing conditions under which finite loss is possible when query points are constrained to be near previous observations.
tldr_zh: 本文是关于实值函数在实数域上进行对抗性在线学习的理论研究，重点探讨了当查询点被限制在之前观测点附近时，有限损失可能性的条件。
summary_zh:
我们研究 $\mathbb{R}$ 上实值函数的对抗性在线学习。在每一轮中，学习器在 $x_t\in\mathbb{R}$ 处被询问，预测 $\hat y_t$，随后观测到真实值 $f(x_t)$；性能通过累积 $p$ 损失 $\sum_{t\ge 1}|\hat y_t-f(x_t)|^p$ 来衡量。对于函数类  
\[ 
\mathcal{G}_q=\Bigl\{f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\ \text{绝对连续}:\ \int_{\mathbb{R}}|f'(x)|^q\,dx\le 1\Bigr\}, 
\]  
我们证明标准模型在 $\mathbb{R}$ 上是不适定的：对于任意 $p\ge 1$ 和 $q>1$，对手可以迫使损失达到无穷大。受此障碍启发，我们分析了三种改进的学习场景，以限制远离已有观测输入的查询点的影响。在场景 1 中，对手必须选择每个新查询点位于距离某过往查询点 $1$ 的范围内。在场景 2 中，对手可以在任意位置查询，但学习器仅在其查询点位于距离某过往查询点 $1$ 范围内的轮次中受到惩罚。在场景 3 中，第 $t$ 轮的损失乘以权重 $g(\min_{j<t}|x_t-x_j|)$。

我们在多个参数范围内对场景 1-2 获得了精确的刻画。对于场景 3，我们发现了一个清晰的阈值现象：若 $g$ 衰减过慢，则对手可以迫使加权损失达到无穷大。相反，对于快速衰减的权重（如 $g(z)=e^{-cz}$），我们在二次情形 $p=q=2$ 下得到了有限且精确的保证。最后，我们研究了 $\mathcal{G}_q$ 在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上一个自然的多元切片推广 $\mathcal{G}_{q,d}$，并发现一个尖锐的二分现象：尽管一维情形在某些参数范围内存在有限的最优值，但对任意 $d\ge 2$，切片类 $\mathcal{G}_{q,d}$ 过于宽松，即使在场景 1-3 下，对手仍能迫使损失达到无穷大。

title: Adversarial Robustness of Deep State Space Models for Forecasting
summary: State-space model (SSM) for time-series forecasting have demonstrated strong empirical performance on benchmark datasets, yet their robustness under adversarial perturbations is poorly understood. We address this gap through a control-theoretic lens, focusing on the recently proposed Spacetime SSM forecaster. We first establish that the decoder-only Spacetime architecture can represent the optimal Kalman predictor when the underlying data-generating process is autoregressive - a property no other SSM possesses. Building on this, we formulate robust forecaster design as a Stackelberg game against worst-case stealthy adversaries constrained by a detection budget, and solve it via adversarial training. We derive closed-form bounds on adversarial forecasting error that expose how open-loop instability, closed-loop instability, and decoder state dimension each amplify vulnerability - offering actionable principles towards robust forecaster design. Finally, we show that even adversaries with no access to the forecaster can nonetheless construct effective attacks by exploiting the model's locally linear input-output behavior, bypassing gradient computations entirely. Experiments on the Monash benchmark datasets highlight that model-free attacks, without any gradient computation, can cause at least 33% more error than projected gradient descent with a small step size.
tldr: This paper analyzes the adversarial robustness of deep state-space models for time-series forecasting, establishing theoretical connections to Kalman predictors and deriving principles for robust design against model-free attacks.
tldr_zh: 本研究分析了深度状态空间模型在时间序列预测中的对抗鲁棒性，建立了与卡尔曼预测器的理论联系，并推导了针对免模型攻击的鲁棒设计原则。
summary_zh: 时间序列预测的状态空间模型（SSM）在基准数据集上展现出强大的实证性能，但其在对抗性扰动下的鲁棒性尚不明确。本研究从控制理论视角出发，填补了这一空白，重点关注近期提出的Spacetime SSM预测模型。我们首先证明：当底层数据生成过程为自回归时，仅解码器结构的Spacetime架构能够表示最优卡尔曼预测器——这是其他SSM模型所不具备的特性。基于此发现，我们将鲁棒预测器设计构建为受检测预算约束的最坏情况隐蔽对抗性攻击下的Stackelberg博弈，并通过对抗训练求解该问题。我们推导出对抗性预测误差的闭式边界，揭示了开环不稳定性、闭环不稳定性与解码器状态维度如何分别放大系统脆弱性，从而为鲁棒预测器设计提供可操作的指导原则。最后，我们证明即使攻击者无法接触预测器内部，仍可通过利用模型局部线性输入输出特性构建有效攻击，完全绕过梯度计算。在Monash基准数据集上的实验表明，无需梯度计算的无模型攻击，其造成的预测误差比小步长投影梯度下降法至少高出33%。
